And he walked in every way that his father had walked And he served the idols that his father had served and he prostrated himself to them
And he abandoned Yahweh the God of his fathers and he did not walk in the way of Yahweh
And the servants of Amon conspired against him and they killed the king in his house
But the people of the land struck all having conspired against King Amon and the people of the land made Josiah his son reign in his place
Now the rest of the matters of Amon that he did are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah
And one buried him in his tomb in the garden of Uzza And Josiah his son reigned in his place

22.t: Josiah was a son of 8 years when he reigned and he reigned 31 years in Jerusalem And the name of his mother was Yedidah the daughter of Adaiah from Bozkath
And he did right in the eyes of Yahweh and he walked in every way of David his father and he did not turn away right or left
And it happened in the eighteenth year of King Josiah the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam the scribe to the house of Yahweh saying
Go up to Hilkiah the great priest and he shall complete the silver having been brought into the house of Yahweh which the keepers of the threshold have collected from the people

And let them give it into the hand of the doers of the work the ones appointed over the house of Yahweh And they shall give it to the doers of the work that is in the house of Yahweh to strengthen the damage of the house
to the craftsmen and to the builders and to the masons and to buy wood and stones of hewing to strengthen the house
However the silver given to their hand shall not be reckoned with them because they are acting in faithfulness
And Hilkiah the great priest said to Shaphan the scribe I have found a scroll of the Law in the house of Yahweh And Hilkiah gave the scroll to Shaphan and he read it

And Shaphan the scribe went to the king and he brought a word back to the king and said Your servants have poured out the silver found in the house and they have given it into the hand of the doers of the work the ones appointed over the house of Yahweh
And Shaphan the scribe declared to the king saying Hilkiah the priest has given a scroll to me And Shaphan read it to the face of the king
And it happened when the king heard the words of the scroll of the Law that he tore his clothes
And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest and Ahikam the son of Shaphan and Akbor the son of Micaiah and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah the servant of the king saying

Go seek Yahweh for me and for the people and for all of Judah concerning the words of this scroll having been found For great is the heat of Yahweh that which is kindled against us because our fathers did not listen to the words of this scroll to act according to everything written concerning us

And Hilkiah the priest went with Ahikam and Akbor and Shaphan and Asaiah to Huldah the prophetess the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah the son of Harhas the keeper of the clothes now she was living in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter and they spoke to her
And she said to them Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel Say to the man who sent you to me
Thus says Yahweh Behold me bringing disaster to this place and upon its inhabitants all of the words of the scroll that the king of Judah has read
because they abandoned me and burned incense to other gods so that they made me angry by all of the works of their hands So my heat is kindled against this place and it will not extinguish
But to the king of Judah the one having sent you to seek Yahweh thus you shall say to him Thus says Yahweh the God of Israel about the words that you heard

Because your heart is tender and you humbled yourself from the face of Yahweh when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its dwellers that they would become a horror and a curse and you tore your clothes and wept to my face now I I have also heard The declaration of Yahweh

Therefore behold me gathering you to your fathers and you will be gathered to your graves in peace and your eyes will not see all of the disaster that I am bringing upon this place And they brought a word back to the king

23.t: And the king sent and they gathered to him all of the elders of Judah and Jerusalem

And the king went up to the house of Yahweh and every man of Judah and all of the dwellers of Jerusalem with him and the priests and the prophets and all of the people from small and to great And he read in their ears all of the words of the scroll of the covenant having been found in the house of Yahweh

And the king stood by the pillar and he cut a covenant to the face of Yahweh to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all of the heart and with all of the soul to raise up the words of this covenant written on that scroll And all of the people stood in the covenant

And the king commanded Hilkiah the great priest and the priests of the second rank and the keepers of the threshold to bring out from the temple of Yahweh all of the vessels having been made for Baal and for Asherah and for the whole army of the heavens And he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and he brought their ashes to Bethel

And he made cease the idol priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed that one should burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and the environs of Jerusalem and the ones burning incense to Baal to the sun and to the moon and to the constellations and to the whole army of the heavens

And he brought out the Asherah from the house of Yahweh to outside of Jerusalem to the Valley of Kidron and he burned it in the Valley of Kidron And he crushed it to dust and he threw its dust over the grave of the sons of the people
And he tore down the houses of the cultic prostitutes that were by the house of Yahweh where women were weaving houses there for Asherah

And he brought all of the priests from the cities of Judah and he defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense there from Geba to Beersheba And he tore down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the commander of the city which was on the left of a man at the gate of the city
However the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of Yahweh in Jerusalem Rather they ate unleavened bread in the midst of their brothers
And he defiled Topheth which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom so that a man could not make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Molech

And he removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun from the entrance of the house of Yahweh by the chamber of Nathan Melech the eunuch which was in the precincts And he burned the chariots of the sun with fire

And the king tore down the altars that were on the roof the upper chamber of Ahaz that the kings of Judah had made and the altars that Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of Yahweh And he ran from there and threw their dust into the Valley of Kidron

And the king defiled the high places that were on the face of Jerusalem which were on the right of the Mount of Destruction which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab and for Milcom the abomination of the sons of Ammon
And he shattered the pillars and he cut down the Asherahs and he filled their place with bones of man

And also the altar that was in Bethel the high place that Jeroboam the son of Nebat made who caused Israel to sin both that altar and the high place he tore down and he burned the high place He crushed them to dust and he burned the Asherah

And Josiah turned and saw the graves that were there on the mountain and he sent and took bones from the graves and burned them on the altar So he defiled it according to the word of Yahweh that the man of God proclaimed who had proclaimed these things

And he said What is this monument that I am seeing And the men of the city said to him The grave of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel
And he said Let him stay Let not a man disturb his bones And they rescued his bones with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria

And Josiah also removed all of the houses of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria which the kings of Israel had made provoking anger And he did to them like all of the works that he had done in Bethel
And he sacrificed on the altars all of the priests of the high places who were there and he burned bones of man on them Then he returned to Jerusalem
And the king commanded all of the people saying Do Passover for Yahweh your God as written in this scroll of the covenant
Now like this Passover was not done from the days of the judges who judged Israel or all of the days of the kings of Israel or the kings of Judah
except in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was done for Yahweh in Jerusalem

And Josiah also removed the ritual pits and the familiar spirits and the teraphim and the idols and all of the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem in order to raise up the words of the Law written in the scroll that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of Yahweh

And to his face a king was not like him who returned to Yahweh with all of his heart and with all of his soul and with all of his strength according to all of the Law of Moses And after him one has not arisen like him
However Yahweh did not turn from the great burning of his nose with which his nose burned against Judah because of all of the provocations by which Manasseh had provoked him
And Yahweh had said I will also remove Judah away from my face just as I removed Israel And I will reject this city that I chose Jerusalem and the house about which I said My name will be there
Now the rest of the matters of Josiah and all that he did are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah
In his days Pharaoh Neco the king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River And King Josiah went to meet him but he killed him at Megiddo when he saw him

And his servants caused him to ride dead from Megiddo and brought him to Jerusalem And they buried him in his grave And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and they anointed him and made him king in place of his father
Jehoahaz was a son of 23 years when he reigned and he reigned three months in Jerusalem And the name of his mother was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like all that his fathers had done
And Pharaoh Neco bound him in Riblah in the land of Hamath from reigning in Jerusalem And he imposed tribute on the land 100 kikkars of silver and a kikkar of gold
And Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah reign in place of Josiah his father and he changed his name to Jehoiakim But he took Jehoahaz and he came to Egypt and he died there

And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh but he assessed the land to give the silver according to the mouth of Pharoah From a man according to his assessment he exacted the silver and the gold from the people of the land to give to Pharoah Neco
Jehoiakim was a son of 25 years when he reigned and he reigned 11 years in Jerusalem And the name of his mother was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like all that his fathers had done

24.t: In his days Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came up and Jehoiakim was a servant to him for three years Then he returned and rebelled against him

And Yahweh sent against him raiding bands of Chaldeans and raiding bands of Aram and raiding bands of Moab and raiding bands of the sons of Ammon And he sent them against Judah to destroy it according to the word of Yahweh that he had spoken by the hand of his servants the prophets
Surely at the mouth of Yahweh it was against Judah to remove them away from his face for the sins of Manasseh according to all that he did
and also for the innocent blood that he poured out for he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood and Yahweh was not willing to forgive
Now the rest of the matters of Jehoiakim and all that he did are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah
And Jehoiakim lay down with his fathers and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place
And the king of Egypt did not resume again to go out from his land because the king of Babylon took all that had been to the king of Egypt from the wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River
Jehoiachin was a son of 18 years when he reigned and he reigned in Jerusalem three months And the name of his mother was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like all that his father had done
At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem and the city entered into siege
And Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging against it

And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon he and his mother and his servants and his commanders and his eunuchs And the king of Babylon took him in the year of eight to his reigning

And he brought out from there all of the treasuries of the house of Yahweh and the treasuries of the house of the king and he cut off all of the furnishings of gold that Solomon the king of Israel had made for the temple of Yahweh just as Yahweh had spoken
And he exiled all of Jerusalem and all of the commanders and all of the mighty of valor exiling 10 000 and every craftsman and smith One was not left except the poor of the people of the land
And he exiled Jehoiachin to Babylon And the mother of the king and the wives of the king and his eunuchs and the leaders of the land he led into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon
and all of the men of valor 7 000 and the craftsman and the smith 1 000 the whole the mighty the makers of war And the king of Babylon brought them into exile to Babylon
And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his uncle king in his place and he changed his name to Zedekiah
Zedekiah was a son of 21 years when he reigned and he reigned 11 years in Jerusalem And the name of his mother was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah
And he did evil in the eyes of Yahweh like all that Jehoiakim had done
For because of the nose of Yahweh it was against Jerusalem and against Judah until he cast them away from his face And Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon

25.t: And it happened in the ninth year of his reigning in the tenth month on ten of the month Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon came he and all of his army against Jerusalem And he encamped against it and they built a siege mound against it all around
And the city entered into siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah
On nine of the month then famine seized the city and there was no bread for the people of the land

And the city was breached and all of the men of war at night the way of the gate between the two walls that were near the garden of the king now the Chaldeans were against the city all around and he went the way of the Arabah
But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king and they overtook him in the plains of Jericho And all of his army were scattered away from him
And they captured the king and they brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah And they pronounced judgment on him
And they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah to his eyes And he blinded the eyes of Zedikiah and he bound him with two bronze chains and he brought him to Babylon

And in the fifth month on seven of the month it was the year of 19 the year to King Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon Nebuzaradan the chief of the guards the servant of the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem
And he burned the house of Yahweh and the house of the king And all of the houses of Jerusalem and every house of the great he burned with fire
And all of the army of the Chaldeans who were with the chief of the guards tore down the walls of Jerusalem all around
But the rest of the people left in the city and the ones having fallen who had fallen to the king of Babylon and the rest of the multitude Nebuzaradan the chief of the guards exiled
But the chief of the guards let some of the poor of the land remain as vinedressers and as farmers
And the Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the house of Yahweh and the stands and the sea of bronze that were in the house of Yahweh and they carried their bronze to Babylon
And they took the pots and the shovels and the trimmers and the palms and all of the articles of bronze with which they served
And the chief of the guards took the firepans and the bowls that were gold gold and that were silver silver
The two pillars the one sea and the stands that Solomon had made for the house of Yahweh a weight was not for the bronze of all of these vessels

The height of one pillar was 18 cubits and the capital on it was bronze And the height of the capital was three cubits and a network and pomegranates were on the capital all around The whole was bronze And like these were to the second pillar with a network
And the chief of the guards took Seraiah the high priest and Zephaniah the priest of the second rank and the three guards of the threshold

And from the city he took a eunuch because he was the overseer over the men of war and five men from the seers of the face of the king who were found in the city and the scribe the commander of the army the one mustering the people of the land and 60 men from the people of the land found in the city
And Nebuzaradan the chief of the guards took them and made them go to the king of Babylon to Riblah
And the king of Babylon struck them and killed them in Riblah in the land of Hamath And Judah went into exile away from its land
Now as for the people having been left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon left he appointed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan over them

And all of the captains of the armies they and the men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and Johanan the son of Kareah and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite they and their men
And Gedaliah swore to them and to their men and said to them Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon and it will be well with you

But it happened in the seventh month Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama from the seed of the kingdom came and ten men with him and he struck Gedaliah and he died and the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah
Then all of the people from small and to great and the captains of the armies arose and went to Egypt for they were afraid from the face of the Chaldeans

And it happened in year 37 of the exile of Jehoiachin the king of Judah in month 12 on 27 of the month Evil Merodach the king of Babylon in the year of his reigning lifted the head of Jehoiachin the king of Judah from the house of imprisonment
And he spoke good things to him and he put his seat above the seat of the kings who were with him in Babylon
And he changed the clothes of his imprisonment and he ate bread regularly to his face all of the days of his life
And his allowance a continual allowance was given to him from the king a matter of a day in its day all of the days of his life

1.t: Adam Seth Enosh
Kenan Mahalalel Jared
Enoch Methuselah Lamech
Noah Shem Ham and Japheth
The sons of Japheth Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras
And the sons of Gomer Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah
And the sons of Javan Elishah and Tarshish Kittim and Rodanim
The sons of Ham Cush and Egypt Put and Canaan
And the sons of Cush Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raamah and Sabteca And the sons of Raamah Sheba and Dedan
And Cush fathered Nimrod he he began to be a warrior on the earth
And Egypt fathered Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim
and Pathrusim and Casluhim from whom the Philistines came forth from there and Caphtorim
And Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn and Heth
and the Jebusites and the Amorites and the Girgashites
and the Hivites and the Arkites and the Sinites
and the Arvadites and the Zemarites and the Hamathites
The sons of Shem Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech
And Arpachshad fathered Shelah and Shelah fathered Eber
And to Eber were born two sons The name of the one was Peleg for in his days the earth was divided And the name of his brother was Joktan
And Joktan fathered Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah
and Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah
and Obal and Abimael and Sheba
and Ophir and Havilah and Jobab All of these were the sons of Joktan
Shem Arpachshad Shelah
Eber Peleg Reu
Serug Nahor Terah
Abram he is Abraham
The sons of Abraham Isaac and Ishmael
These are their generations The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam
Mishma and Dumah Massa Hadad and Tema
Jetur Naphish and Kedemah These are they the sons of Ishmael
And the sons of Keturah the concubine of Abraham she bore Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah And the sons of Jokshan Sheba and Dedan
And the sons of Midian Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah All of these were the sons of Keturah
And Abraham fathered Isaac The sons of Isaac Esau and Israel
The sons of Esau Eliphaz Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah
The sons of Eliphaz Teman and Omar Zepho and Gatam Kenaz and Timna and Amalek
The sons of Reuel Nahath Zerah Shammah and Mizzah
And the sons of Seir Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan
And the sons of Lotan Hori and Hemam And the sister of Lotan Timna
The sons of Shobal Alvan and Manahath and Ebal Shepho and Onam And the sons of Zibeon Aiah and Anah
The sons of Anah Dishon And the sons of Dishon Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran
The sons of Ezer Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan The sons of Dishan Uz and Aran
Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom to the face of the reigning of a king over the sons of Israel Bela the son of Beor And the name of his city was Dinhabah
And Bela died and Jobab the son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place
And Jobab died and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place
And Husham died and Hadad the son of Bedad the one having struck Midian in the field of Moab reigned in his place And the name of his city Avith
And Hadad died and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place
And Samlah died and Shaul from Rehoboth of the River reigned in his place
And Shaul died and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place
And Baal Hanan died and Hadad reigned in his place And the name of his city was Pai And the name of his wife was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred the daughter of Mezahab
And Hadad died And the chiefs of Edom were Chief Timna Chief Alvah Chief Jetheth
Chief Oholibamah Chief Elah Chief Pinon
Chief Kenaz Chief Teman Chief Mibzar
Chief Magdiel Chief Iram These were the chiefs of Edom

2.t: These were the sons of Israel Reuben Simeon Levi and Judah Issachar and Zebulun
Dan Joseph and Benjamin Naphtali Gad and Asher
The sons of Judah Er and Onan and Shelah Three were born to him by Bath Shua the Canaanitess And Er the firstborn of Judah was wicked in the eyes of Yahweh and he killed him
And Tamar his daughter in law bore to him Perez and Zerah All of the sons of Judah were five
The sons of Perez Hezron and Hamul
And the sons of Zerah Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara All of them were five
And the sons of Carmi Achan the troubler of Israel who transgressed against the devoted thing
And the sons of Ethan Azariah
And the sons of Hezron who were born to him Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai
And Ram fathered Amminadab and Amminadab fathered Nahshon the leader of the sons of Judah
And Nahshon fathered Salmon and Salmon fathered Boaz
And Boaz fathered Obed and Obed fathered Jesse
And Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab and Abinadab the second and Shimea the third
Nethanel the fourth Raddai the fifth
Ozem the sixth David the seventh
And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail And the sons of Zeruiah Abishai and Joab and Asahel three
And Abigail bore Amasa and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite
And Caleb the son of Hezron fathered with Azubah a wife and with Jerioth And these were her sons Jesher and Shobab and Ardon
And Azubah died and Caleb took for himself Ephrath And she bore Hur to him
And Hur fathered Uri and Uri fathered Bezalel
And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead Now he he had taken her when he was a son of 60 years And she bore Segub to him
And Segub fathered Jair And 23 cities were to him in the land of Gilead
And Geshur and Aram took from them Havvoth Jair Kenath and its daughters 60 cities All of these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead
And after the death of Hezron in Caleb Ephrathah then the wife of Hezron Abijah then she bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa
And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah
And another wife was to Jerahmeel and her name was Atarah She was the mother of Onam
And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz and Jamin and Eker
And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada And the sons of Shammai Nadab and Abishur
And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail And she bore Ahban and Molid to him
And the sons of Nadab Seled and Appaim And Seled died without sons
And the sons of Appaim Ishi And the sons of Ishi Sheshan And the sons of Sheshan Ahlai
And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai Jether and Jonathan And Jether died without sons
And the sons of Jonathan Peleth and Zaza These were the sons of Jerahmeel
And sons were not to Sheshan but only daughters And a servant was to Sheshan an Egyptian and his name was Jarha
And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant for a wife And she bore Attai to him
And Attai fathered Nathan and Nathan fathered Zabad
And Zabad fathered Ephlal and Ephlal fathered Obed
And Obed fathered Jehu and Jehu fathered Azariah
And Azariah fathered Helez and Helez fathered Eleasah
And Eleasah fathered Sismai and Sismai fathered Shallum
And Shallum fathered Jekamiah and Jekamiah fathered Elishama
And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel Mareshah his firstborn he was the father of Ziph And the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron
And the sons of Hebron Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema
And Shema fathered Raham the father of Jorkeam And Rekem fathered Shammai
And the son of Shammai was Maon and Maon was the father of Beth Zur
And Ephah the concubine of Caleb bore Haran and Moza and Gazez And Haran fathered Gazez
And the sons of Jahdai Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph
The concubine of Caleb Maacah bore Sheber and Tirhanah
And she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah and Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea And the daughter of Caleb was Achsah
These were the sons of Caleb The son of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim
Salma the father of Bethlehem Hareph the father of Beth Gader
And the sons of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were Haroeh half of Menuhoth
and the clans of Kiriath Jearim the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites From these came forth the Zorathites and Eshtaolites
The sons of Salma Bethlehem and the Netophathites Atroth Beth Joab and half of the Manahathites the Zorites
and the clans of the scribes living in Jabez the Tirathites the Shimeathites and the Sucathites These were the Kenites having come from Hammath the father of the house of Rechab

3.t: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron the firstborn Amnon by Ahinoam the Jezreelitess the second Daniel by Abigail the Carmelitess
the third Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai the king of Geshur the fourth Adonijah the son of Haggith
the fifth Shephatiah by Abital the sixth Ithream by Eglah his wife
Six were born to him in Hebron and he reigned there seven years and six months Then he reigned 33 years in Jerusalem
And these were born to him in Jerusalem Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon four by Bath Shua the daughter of Ammiel
and Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet
and Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia
and Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet nine
All of the sons of David besides sons of concubines and Tamar was their sister
And the son of Solomon Rehoboam Abijah his son Asa his son Jehoshaphat his son
Joram his son Ahaziah his son Joash his son
Amaziah his son Azariah his son Jotham his son
Ahaz his son Hezekiah his son Manasseh his son
Amon his son Josiah his son
And the sons of Josiah the firstborn Johanan the second Jehoiakim the third Zedekiah the fourth Shallum
And the sons of Jehoiakim Jeconiah his son Zedekiah his son
And the sons of Jeconiah a prisoner Shealtiel his son
and Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar Jekamiah Hoshama and Nedabiah
And the sons of Pedaiah Zerubbabel and Shimei And the son of Zerubbabel Meshullam and Hananiah and Shelomith was their sister
and Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah Jushab Hesed five
And the son of Hananiah Pelatiah and Jeshaiah the sons of Rephaiah the sons of Arnan the sons of Obadiah the sons of Shecaniah
And the sons of Shecaniah Shemaiah and the sons of Shemaiah Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat six
And the son of Neariah Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam three
And the sons of Elioenai Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani seven

4.t: The sons of Judah Perez Hezron and Carmi and Hur and Shobal
And Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath And Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad These are the clans of the Zorathites
And these were the father of Etam Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash And the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi
And Penuel the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah these were the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah the father of Bethlehem
And to Ashhur the father of Tekoa were two wives Helah and Naarah
And Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari These were the sons of Naarah
And the sons of Helah Zereth and Izhar and Ethnan
and Koz who fathered Anub and Zobebah and the clans of Aharhel the son of Harum
Now Jabez was honored more than his brothers And his mother called his name Jabez saying Because I bore in pain

And Jabez called to the God of Israel saying If blessing you would bless me and you would enlarge my border and your hand would be with me and you would act not in harm so as not to pain me And God brought what he asked
And Chelub the brother of Shuhah fathered Mehir He was the father of Eshton
And Eshton fathered Beth Rapha and Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash These were the men of Recah
And the sons of Kenaz Othniel and Seraiah And the sons of Othniel Hathath
And Meonothai fathered Ophrah and Seraiah fathered Joab the father of Ge Harashim for they were craftsmen
And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh Iru Elah and Naam And the sons of Elah Kenaz
And the sons of Jehallelel Ziph and Ziphah Tiria and Asarel
And the sons of Ezrah Jether and Mered and Epher and Jalon And she conceived Miriam and Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa
And his Judahite wife bore Jered the father of Gedor and Heber the father of Soco and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah But those were the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took
And the sons of the wife of Hodiah the sister of Naham were the father of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite
And the sons of Shimon Amnon and Rinnah Ben Hanan and Tilon And the sons of Ishi Zoheth and Ben Zoheth
The sons of Shelah the son of Judah Er the father of Lecah and Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the house of the service of linen at Beth Ashbea
and Jokim and the men of Cozeba and Joash and Saraph who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem And the words are ancient
These were the potters and the dwellers of Netaim and Gederah They dwelled there with the king in his work
The sons of Simeon Nemuel and Jamin Jarib Zerah Shaul
Shallum his son Mibsam his son Mishma his son
And the sons of Mishma Hammuel his son Zaccur his son Shimei his son
And to Shimei were 16 sons and 6 daughters but to his brothers were not many sons so all of their clan did not multiply as much as the sons of Judah
And they dwelled in Beersheba and Moladah and Hazar Shual
and in Bilhah and in Ezem and in Tolad
and in Bethuel and in Hormah and in Ziklag
and in Beth Marcaboth and in Hazar Susim and in Beth Biri and in Shaaraim These were their cities unto the reign of David
And their villages Etam and Ain and Rimmon and Tochen and Ashan five cities
and all of their villages that were around these cities unto Baal These were their settlements and their genealogy was to them
And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah the son of Amaziah
and Joel and Jehu the son of Joshibiah the son of Seraiah the son of Asiel
and Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah
and Ziza the son of Shiphi the son of Allon the son of Jedaiah the son of Shimri the son of Shemaiah
these coming by names were leaders in their clans for the house of their fathers broke through into a multitude
And they went to the entrance of Gedor unto to the east of the valley to seek pasture for their flock
And they found rich and good pasture and the land was broad of hands and quiet and peaceful for those from Ham were living there to their faces

And these written by names came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and they struck their tents and the Meunites who were found there And they devoted them to this day and they dwelled in their place because pasture for their flock was there
And 500 men from them from the sons of Simeon went to Mount Seir and Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel the sons of Ishi were their heads
and they struck the remnant of the escape of Amalek and they have dwelled there to this day

5.t: And the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel for he was the firstborn but when he defiled the couches of his father his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel so he is not enrolled according to the birthright
though Judah was great among his brothers and a leader was from him yet the birthright was to Joseph
the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel Hanoch and Pallu Hezron and Carmi
The sons of Joel Shemaiah his son Gog his son Shimei his son
Micah his son Reaiah his son Baal his son
Beerah his son whom Tiglath Pileser the king of Assyria exiled He was a leader of the Reubenites
And his brothers by his clans in the genealogy of their generations Jeiel the head and Zechariah
and Bela the son of Azaz the son of Shema the son of Joel He was dwelling in Aroer and unto Nebo and Baal Meon
and to the east he dwelled unto the entrance of the wilderness to near the Euphrates River for their livestock multiplied in the land of Gilead
And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagrites and they fell into their hand And they dwelled in their tents upon all of the face of the east of Gilead
And the sons of Gad dwelled to the front of them in the land of Bashan unto Salecah
Joel the head and Shapham the second and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan
And their brothers according to the house of their fathers Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber seven
These were the sons of Abihail the son of Huri the son of Jaroah the son of Gilead the son of Michael the son of Jeshishai the son of Jahdo the son of Buz
Ahi the son of Abdiel the son of Guni was the head of the house of their fathers
And they dwelled in Gilead in Bashan and in its daughters and in all of the pasturelands of Sharon unto their borders
All of them were enrolled in the days of Jotham the king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam the king of Israel

The sons of Reuben and the Gadites and half of the tribe of Manasseh from sons of valor men carriers of the shield and sword and treaders of the bow and taught of battle were 44 760 going out as an army
And they made war with the Hagrites and Jetur and Naphish and Nodab
And they were helped against them and the Hagrites were given into their hand and all who were with them For they cried out to God in the battle and he was entreated by them for they trusted in him
And they captured their livestock their camels 50 000 and sheep 250 000 and donkeys 2 000 and soul of man 100 000
For many fell slain for the battle was from God And they dwelled in place of them until the exile
And the sons of half of the tribe of Manasseh dwelled in the land from Bashan unto Baal Hermon and Senir and Mount Hermon They they multiplied

And these were the heads of the house of their fathers even Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel men warriors of strength men of names heads of the house of their fathers
But they transgressed against the God of their fathers and they whored after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God had destroyed from their faces

So the God of Israel awakened the spirit of Pul the king of Assyria and the spirit of Tiglath Pileser the king of Assyria And he exiled them namely the Reubenites and the Gadites and half of the tribe of Manasseh And he brought them to Halah and Habor and Hara and the river of Gozan unto this day

6.t: The sons of Levi Gershon Kohath and Merari
And the sons of Kohath Amram Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel
And the sons of Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam And the sons of Aaron Nadab and Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar
Eleazar fathered Phinehas Phinehas fathered Abishua
And Abishua fathered Bukki and Bukki fathered Uzzi
And Uzzi fathered Zerahiah and Zerahiah fathered Meraioth
Meraioth fathered Amariah and Amariah fathered Ahitub
And Ahitub fathered Zadok and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz
And Ahimaaz fathered Azariah and Azariah fathered Johanan
And Johanan fathered Azariah he who served as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem
And Azariah fathered Amariah and Amariah fathered Ahitub
And Ahitub fathered Zadok and Zadok fathered Shallum
And Shallum fathered Hilkiah and Hilkiah fathered Azariah
And Azariah fathered Seraiah and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak
And Jehozadak went when Yahweh exiled Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar
The sons of Levi Gershom Kohath and Merari
And these are the names of the sons of Gershom Libni and Shimei
And the sons of Kohath Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel
The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi And these are the clans of the Levites according to their fathers
Of Gershom Libni his son Jahath his son Zimmah his son
Joah his son Iddo his son Zerah his son Jeatherai his son
The sons of Kohath Amminadab his son Korah his son Assir his son
Elkanah his son and Ebiasaph his son and Assir his son
Tahath his son Uriel his son Uzziah his son and Shaul his son
And the sons of Elkanah Amasai and Ahimoth
Elkanah his son Elkanah Zophai his son and Nahath his son
Eliab his son Jeroham his son Elkanah his son
And the sons of Samuel Joel the firstborn and the second Abijah
The sons of Merari Mahli Libni his son Shimei his son Uzzah his son
Shimea his son Haggiah his son Asaiah his son
And it was these whom David made stand over the hands of song in the house of Yahweh after the resting of the Box

And they were ministering to the face of the tabernacle the tent of meeting with song until Solomon built the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem And they stood according to their regulations over their service
And these were the ones standing and their sons From the sons of the Kohathites Heman the singer the son of Joel the son of Samuel
the son of Elkanah the son of Jeroham the son of Eliel the son of Toah
the son of Zuph the son of Elkanah the son of Mahath the son of Amasai
the son of Elkanah the son of Joel the son of Azariah the son of Zephaniah
the son of Tahath the son of Assir the son of Ebiasaph the son of Korah
the son of Izhar the son of Kohath the son of Levi the son of Israel
And his brother Asaph the one standing at his right hand Asaph the son of Berechiah the son of Shimea
the son of Michael the son of Baaseiah the son of Malchijah
the son of Ethni the son of Zerah the son of Adaiah
the son of Ethan the son of Zimmah the son of Shimei
the son of Jahath the son of Gershom the son of Levi
And the sons of Merari their brothers on the left Ethan the son of Kishi the son of Abdi the son of Malluch
the son of Hashabiah the son of Amaziah the son of Hilkiah
the son of Amzi the son of Bani the son of Shemer
the son of Mahli the son of Mushi the son of Merari the son of Levi
And their brothers the Levites were appointed to all of the service of the tabernacle of the house of God

And Aaron and his sons were offering on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense for all of the work of the Holy of Holies and to cover over Israel according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded
And these were the sons of Aaron Eleazar his son Phinehas his son Abishua his son
Bukki his son Uzzi his son Zerahiah his son
Meraioth his son Amariah his son Ahitub his son
Zadok his son Ahimaaz his son
And these were their dwellings according to their habitations in their border To the sons of Aaron to the clan of the Kohathite for to them was the lot
and they gave to them Hebron in the land of Judah and its pasturelands around it
but the field of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh
And to the sons of Aaron they gave cities of refuge Hebron and Libnah and its pasturelands and Jattir and Eshtemoa and its pasturelands
and Hilen and its pasturelands Debir and its pasturelands
and Ashan and its pasturelands and Beth Shemesh and its pasturelands
And from the tribe of Benjamin Geba and its pasturelands and Alemeth and its pasturelands and Anathoth and its pasturelands All of their cities among their clans were 13 cities
And to the sons of Kohath the remaining from the clan of the tribe they gave ten cities by lot from the half tribe half of Manasseh
And to the sons of Gershom for their clans from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan they gave 13 cities
To the sons of Merari for their clans from the tribe of Reuben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zebulun they gave 12 cities by lot
And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their pasturelands
And they gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin these cities which they called them by names
And some of the clans of the sons of Kohath cities of their border were from the tribe of Ephraim
And they gave to them cities of refuge Shechem and its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim and Gezer and its pasturelands
and Jokmeam and its pasturelands and Beth Horon and its pasturelands
and Aijalon and its pasturelands and Gath Rimmon and its pasturelands
And from the half tribe of Manasseh Aner and its pasturelands and Bileam and its pasturelands for the remaining clan of the sons of Kohath
To the sons of Gershom from the clans of the half tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan and its pasturelands and Ashtaroth and its pasturelands
And from the tribe of Issachar Kedesh and its pasturelands Daberath and its pasturelands
and Ramoth and its pasturelands and Anem and its pasturelands
And from the tribe of Asher Mashal and its pasturelands and Abdon and its pasturelands
and Hukok and its pasturelands and Rehob and its pasturelands
And from the tribe of Naphtali Kedesh in Galilee and its pasturelands and Hammon and its pasturelands and Kiriathaim and its pasturelands
To the remaining sons of Merari from the tribe of Zebulun Rimmono and its pasturelands Tabor and its pasturelands
and from across the Jordan at Jericho to the east of the Jordan from the tribe of Reuben Bezer in the wilderness and its pasturelands and Jahzah and its pasturelands
and Kedemoth and its pasturelands and Mephaath and its pasturelands
And from the tribe of Gad Ramoth in Gilead and its pasturelands and Mahanaim and its pasturelands
and Heshbon and its pasturelands and Jazer and its pasturelands

7.t: And to the sons of Issachar Tola and Puah Jashub and Shimron four

And the sons of Tola Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Ibsam and Shemuel heads of the house of their fathers from Tola warriors of valor in their generations Their number in the days of David was 22 600
And the sons of Uzzi Izrahiah And the sons of Izrahiah Michael and Obadiah and Joel Isshiah The five were heads all of them
And with them according to their generations in the house of their fathers warriors of an army of battle 36 000 for they multiplied wives and sons
And their brothers from all of the clans of Issachar warriors of valors 87 000 all enrolled
Benjamin Bela and Becher and Jediael three
And the sons of Bela Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri The five were heads of the house of their fathers warriors of valors and enrolled 22 034
And the sons of Becher Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jeremoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth All of these were the sons of Becher
and they were enrolled according to their generations heads of the house of their fathers warriors of valor 20 200
And the sons of Jediael Bilhan And the sons of Bilhan Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Chenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar
All of these sons of Jediael were heads of their fathers warriors of valors 17 200 going out as an army to battle
And Shuppim and Huppim were sons of Ir Hushim of the sons of Aher
The sons of Naphtali Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum sons of Bilhah
The sons of Manasseh Asriel whom his Aramean concubine bore She bore Machir the father of Gilead
And Machir took a wife of Huppim and of Shuppim And the name of his sister was Maacah And the name of the second Zelophehad And daughters were to Zelophehad
And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son and she called his name Peresh And the name of his brother was Sheresh and his sons were Ulam and Rakem
And the sons of Ulam Bedan These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir the son of Manasseh
And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah
And the sons of Shemida were Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam
And the sons of Ephraim Shuthelah and Bered his son and Tahath his son and Eleadah his son and Tahath his son
and Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son and Ezer and Elead But the men of Gath born in the land killed them because they came down to take their livestock
And Ephraim their father mourned many days and his brothers came to comfort him
And he went in to his wife and she conceived and she bore a son And he called his name Beriah because disaster was in his house
And his daughter was Sheerah And she built Beth Horon Lower and Upper and Uzzen Sheerah
And Rephah his son and Resheph and Telah his son and Tahan his son
Ladan his son Ammihud his son Elishama his son
Non his son Joshua his son
And their holdings and their dwellings were Bethel and its daughters And to the east Naaran And to the west Gezer and its daughters and Shechem and its daughters unto Ayyah and its daughters
And at the hands of the sons of Manasseh Beth Shean and its daughters Taanach and its daughters Megiddo and its daughters Dor and its daughters In these the sons of Joseph the son of Israel lived
The sons of Asher Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah and Serah was their sister
And the sons of Beriah Heber and Malchiel he was the father of Birzaith
And Heber fathered Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua was their sister
And the sons of Japhlet Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath These were the sons of Japhlet
And the sons of Shemer Ahi and Rohgah and Jehubbah and Aram
And the sons of Helem his brother Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal
And the sons of Zophah Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah
Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera
And the sons of Jether Jephunneh and Pispa and Ara
And the sons of Ulla Arah and Hanniel and Rizia
All of these were sons of Asher heads of the house of their fathers chosen warriors of valor heads of chiefs enrolled in the army for battle Their number was 26 000 men

8.t: And Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn Ashbel the second and Aharah the third
Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth
And sons were to Bela Addar and Gera and Abihud
and Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah
and Gera and Shephuphan and Huram
And these were the sons of Ehud these they were heads of fathers among the dwellers of Geba but they exiled them to Manahath
even Naaman and Ahijah and Gera He he exiled them and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud
And Shaharaim fathered in the field of Moab after he sent them away Hushim and Baara his wives
And by Hodesh his wife he fathered Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam
and Jeuz and Sachia and Mirmah These his sons were heads of fathers
And by Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal
And the sons of Elpaal Eber and Misham and Shemed he he built Ono and Lod and its daughters
and Beriah and Shema They were heads of the fathers to the dwellers of Aijalon they they made the dwellers of Gath flee
And Ahio Shashak and Jeremoth
and Zebadiah and Arad and Eder
and Michael and Ishpah and Joha were the sons of Beriah
And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber
and Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal
And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi
and Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel
and Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei
And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel
and Abdon and Zichri and Hanan
and Hananiah and Elam and Anthothijah
and Iphdeiah and Penuel were the sons of Shashak
And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah
and Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham
These were heads of fathers according to their generations heads These dwelled in Jerusalem
And they dwelled in Gibeon Jeiel the father of Gibeon and the name of his wife was Maacah
And his firstborn son was Abdon and Zur and Kish and Baal and Nadab
and Gedor and Ahio and Zecher
And Mikloth fathered Shimeah And they too opposite their brothers they dwelled in Jerusalem with their brothers
And Ner fathered Kish and Kish fathered Saul and Saul fathered Jonathan and Malchi Shua and Abinadab and Esh Baal
And the son of Jonathan Merib Baal And Merib Baal fathered Micah
And the sons of Micah Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz
And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah And Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri And Zimri fathered Moza
And Moza fathered Binea Raphah his son Eleasah his son Azel his son
And to Azel were six sons And these were their names Azrikam Bocheru and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan All of these were the sons of Azel
And the sons of Eshek his brother Ulam his firstborn Jeush the second and Eliphelet the third
And the sons of Ulam were men warriors of valor treaders of the bow and multipliers of sons and sons of sons 150 All of these were from the sons of Benjamin

9.t: And all of Israel were enrolled and behold they are written on the scroll of the kings of Israel And Judah were exiled to Babylon because of their transgression
And the first dwellers who were in their holding in their cities were Israel priests Levites and temple servants
And they dwelled in Jerusalem from the sons of Judah and from the sons of Benjamin and from the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh
Uthai the son of Ammihud the son of Omri the son of Imri the son of Bani from the sons of Perez the son of Judah
And from the Shilonite Asaiah the firstborn and his sons
And from the sons of Zerah Jeuel and their brothers 690
And from the sons of Benjamin Sallu the son of Meshullam the son of Hodaviah the son of Hassenuah
and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham and Elah the son of Uzzi the son of Michri and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah the son of Reuel the son of Ibnijah
and their brothers according to their generations 956 All of these men were heads of fathers according to the house of their fathers
And from the priests Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jachin
and Azariah the son of Hilkiah the son of Meshullam the son of Zadok the son of Meraioth the son of Ahitub the leader of the house of God
and Adaiah the son of Jeroham the son of Pashhur the son of Malchijah and Maasai the son of Adiel the son of Jahzerah the son of Meshullam the son of Meshillemith the son of Immer
and their brothers heads of the house of their fathers 1 760 warriors of valor for the work of the service of the house of God
And from the Levites Shemaiah the son of Hasshub the son of Azrikam the son of Hashabiah from the sons of Merari
and Bakbakkar Heresh and Galal and Mattaniah the son of Mica the son of Zichri the son of Asaph
and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah the son of Galal the son of Jeduthun and Berechiah the son of Asa the son of Elkanah a dweller in the villages of the Netophathite
And the gatekeepers Shallum and Akkub and Talmon and Ahiman and their brothers Shallum was the head
And until now at the gate of the king from the east they are gatekeepers for the camps of the sons of Levi

And Shallum the son of Kore the son of Ebiasaph the son of Korah and his brothers of the house of his father the Korahites were over the work of the service keepers of the thresholds of the tent and their fathers were over the camp of Yahweh keepers of the entrance
And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was leader over them to their faces Yahweh was with him
Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper of the entrance to the tent of meeting
All of them were chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds 212 They were enrolled in their villages They David and Samuel the seer established in their trust
And they and their sons were over the gates of the house of Yahweh of the house of the tent as guards
The gatekeepers were to the four winds east west north and south
And their brothers in their villages were to come for seven days from time to time with these
For in their trust they the four chiefs of the gatekeepers they were Levites and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God
And they lodged around the house of God for the watch was upon them And they were over the opening and to morning to morning
And from them were over the utensils of the service for by number they brought them in and by number they brought them out
And from them were ones appointed over the vessels even over all of the vessels of the Holy Place and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the frankincense and the spices
And from the sons of the priests were mixers of the ointment for the spices
And Mattithiah from the Levites he was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite was in trust over the work of the flat cakes
And from the sons of the Kohathite from their brothers were over the bread of the arrangement to prepare it Sabbath Sabbath
And these the singers heads of fathers of the Levites in the chambers were free for day and by night they were over them in the work
These heads of fathers of the Levites according to their generations were heads These dwelled in Jerusalem
And they dwelled in Gibeon the father of Gibeon Jeiel and the name of his wife was Maacah
And his firstborn son was Abdon and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab
and Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth
And Mikloth fathered Shimeam And also they opposite their brothers lived in Jerusalem with their brothers
And Ner fathered Kish And Kish fathered Saul And Saul fathered Jonathan and Malchi Shua and Abinadab and Esh Baal
And the son of Jonathan Merib Baal And Merib Baal fathered Micah
And the sons of Micah Pithon and Melech and Tahrea
And Ahaz fathered Jarah And Jarah fathered Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri And Zimri fathered Moza
And Moza fathered Binea And Rephaiah was his son Eleasah his son Azel his son
And to Azel were six sons and these were their names Azrikam Bocheru and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan These were the sons of Azel

10.t: Now the Philistines fought with Israel and the men of Israel fled from the face of the Philistines and they fell slain on Mount Gilboa
And the Philistines pursued after Saul and after his sons And the Philistines struck Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi Shua the sons of Saul
And the battle was heavy against Saul And the shooters with the bow found him And he writhed from the shooters

And Saul said to the carrier of his equipment Draw your sword and stab me with it lest these uncircumcised ones come and abuse me But the carrier of his equipment was not willing for he feared greatly So Saul took the sword and fell on it
And the carrier of his equipment saw that Saul had died so he fell he also on his sword and he died
So Saul died and three of his sons even all of his house died together
And all of the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled and that Saul and his sons had died And they abandoned their cities and fled And the Philistines came and dwelled in them
And it happened on the next day that the Philistines came to strip the slain And they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa
And they stripped him and they carried away his head and his weapons And they sent into the land of the Philistines all around to proclaim to their idols and to the people
And they put his weapons in the house of their gods and they fastened his head in the house of Dagon
And all of Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul

And all of the men of valor arose and carried away the corpse of Saul and the corpses of his sons and they brought them to Jabesh And they buried their bones under the oak tree in Jabesh And they fasted seven days
And Saul died because of his transgression that he transgressed against Yahweh because of the word of Yahweh that he did not keep and also for having inquired of a ritual pit for seeking
For he did not seek Yahweh so he killed him And he turned the kingdom to David the son of Jesse

11.t: And all of Israel gathered to David at Hebron saying Behold we are your bone and your flesh

Both yesterday and the third day even when Saul was king you were bringing out and bringing in Israel And Yahweh your God said to you You you will shepherd my people Israel and you you will become the ruler over my people Israel

And all of the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron and David cut for them a covenant in Hebron to the face of Yahweh And they anointed David as king over Israel according to the word of Yahweh by the hand of Samuel
And David and all of Israel went to Jerusalem that is Jebus And the Jebusite the dwellers of the land were there
And the dwellers of Jebus said to David You will not come here But David captured the stronghold of Zion that is the City of David
And David said Anyone striking the Jebusite first will become the head and the chief And Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first and he became the head
And David dwelled in the stronghold therefore they called to it the City of David
And he built the city from around from the Millo and to around And Joab restored the rest of the city
And David went going and becoming great and Yahweh of Armies was with him

Now these are the heads of the warriors who were to David the ones strengthening themselves with him in his kingdom with all of Israel to make him king according to the word of Yahweh concerning Israel
And these are the recounting of the warriors who were to David Jashobeam the son of the Hachmonite was the head of the Three He was awakening his spear against 300 slain at one time
And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite He was among the three warriors
He was with David at Pas Dammim Now the Philistines had assembled themselves there for battle and a portion of the field was full of barley And the people fled from the face of the Philistines
But they stationed themselves in the midst of the portion and they delivered it and they struck the Philistines And Yahweh saved a great salvation
And three from the head Thirty went down to the rock to David to the cave of Adullam And the camp of Philistines encamped in the Valley of the Raphaites
And David was then in the stronghold and a garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem
And David desired and he said Who will give me waters from the well of Bethlehem that is at the gate

And the three broke through the camp of the Philistines and they drew waters from the well of Bethlehem that is at the gate And they carried them away and brought them to David But David was not willing to drink them and he poured them out to Yahweh

And he said Profane to me from God from doing this Shall I drink the blood of these men with their lives For they brought them with their lives And he was not willing to drink them The three warriors did these things
And Abishai the brother of Joab he was the head of the Three and he was awakening his spear against 300 slain And to him was a name among the Three
From the Three in the second he was honored And he became a commander to them But he did not come to the Three
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a son of a man of valor many of deeds from Kabzeel He he struck the two Ariel of Moab And he he went down and struck a lion in the midst of the pit on a day of snow

And he he struck a man of Egypt a man of measure five by the cubit Now in the hand of the Egyptian was a spear like a beam of weavers and he went down against him with a staff But he seized the spear from the hand of the Egyptian and he killed him with his spear
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things And to him was a name among the three warriors
More than the Thirty behold him being honored him but to the Three he did not come And David put him over his bodyguard
And the warriors of valors were Asahel the brother of Joab Elhanan the son of Dodo from Bethlehem
Shammoth the Harorite Helez the Pelonite
Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite Abiezer the Anathothite
Sibbekai the Hushathite Ilai the Ahohite
Maharai the Netophathite Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite
Ithai the son of Ribai from Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin Benaiah the Pirathonite
Hurai from the valleys of Gaash Abiel the Arbathite
Azmaveth the Baharumite Eliahba the Shaalbonite
the sons of Hashem the Gizonite Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite
Ahiam the son of Sakar the Hararite Eliphal the son of Ur
Hepher the Mekerathite Ahijah the Pelonite
Hezro the Carmelite Naarai the son of Ezbai
Joel the brother of Nathan Mibhar the son of Hagri
Zelek the Ammonite Naharai the Beerothite the carrier of the equipment of Joab the son of Zeruiah
Ira the Ithrite Gareb the Ithrite
Uriah the Hittite Zabad the son of Ahlai
Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite a head of the Reubenite and 30 with him
Hanan the son of Maacah and Joshaphat the Mithnite
Uzzia the Ashterathite Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite
Jediael the son of Shimri and Joha his brother the Tizite
Eliel the Mahavite and Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam and Ithmah the Moabite
Eliel and Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite

12.t: Now these are the ones having come to David at Ziklag while he was restrained from the face of Saul the son of Kish And they were among the warriors helpers of the battle
Kissers of the bow being right handed and being left handed with stones and with arrows with the bow from the brothers of Saul from Benjamin
The head Ahiezer and Joash sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite and Jeziel and Pelet sons of Azmaveth and Berakah and Jehu the Anathothite
and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite a warrior among the 30 and over the 30 and Jeremiah and Jahaziel and Johanan and Jozabad the Gederathite
Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Shemariah Shephatiah the Haruphite
Elkanah and Isshiah and Azarel and Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites
and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor

And from the Gadite they separated themselves to David at the stronghold in the wilderness warriors of valor men of the army for battle arrayers of the shield and spear and faces of lions were their faces and like gazelles on the hills for hastening
Ezer the head Obadiah the second Eliab the third
Mishmannah the fourth Jeremiah the fifth
Attai the sixth Eliel the seventh
Johanan the eighth Elzabad the ninth
Jeremiah the tenth Makbannai the eleventh
These were from the sons of Gad heads of the army One the least was for 100 and the greatest was for 1 000
These are they who passed over the Jordan in the first month and it was filling over all of its banks and they made all of the valleys flee to the east and to the west
And some from the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David

And David went out to their faces and he answered and said to them If you have come to me in peace to help me a heart will be to me toward you for unity But if to betray me to my adversaries with no violence in my palms may the God of our fathers see and judge

And the Spirit clothed Amasai the head of the 30 For you David and with you son of Jesse Peace peace to you and peace to the one helping you for your God helps you And David accepted them and he appointed them as heads of a troop

And some from Manasseh fell to David when he came with the Philistines to battle against Saul But they did not help them for by counsel the lords of the Philistines sent him away saying By our heads he will fall to his master Saul
When he went to Ziklag they fell to him from Manasseh Adnah and Jozabad and Jediael and Michael and Jozabad and Elihu and Zillethai heads of thousands that were to Manasseh
And they they helped with David against the troop for all of them were warriors of valor and they were commanders in the army
For at the time of day by day they were coming to David to help him until to a great camp like the camp of God
And these are the numbers of the heads of the equipped for war They came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him according to the mouth of Yahweh
The sons of Judah carriers of the shield and the spear 6 800 equipped of war
From the sons of Simeon warriors of valor for war 7 100
From the sons of Levi 4 600
And Jehoiada the leader from Aaron and with him 3 700
And Zadok a young man a warrior of valor and the house of his father 22 commanders
And from the sons of Benjamin the brothers of Saul 3 000 And until then the majority of them were keeping the keeping of the house of Saul
And from the sons of Ephraim 20 800 warriors of valor men of names according to the house of their fathers
And from the half of the tribe of Manasseh 18 000 who were designated by names to come to make David king
And from the sons of Issachar knowers of understanding of the times to know what Israel should do their heads 200 and all of their brothers at their mouth
From Zebulun goers out of war arrayers of battle with all of the weapons of battle 50 000 and to keep rank without a heart and a heart
And from Naphtali 1 000 commanders and with them with shield and spear 37 000
And from the Danite arrayers of battle 28 600
And from Asher goers out of war to array for battle 40 000
And from across the Jordan from the Reubenite and the Gadite and half of tribe of Manasseh with all of the weapons of war for battle 120 000
All of these men of battle keepers of the array came with a whole heart to Hebron to make David king over all of Israel And also all of the rest of Israel had one heart to make David king
And they were there with David three days eating and drinking for their brothers had prepared for them

And also the ones near to them unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali were bringing bread on donkeys and on camels and on mules and on oxen food of flour fig cakes and raisins cakes and wine and oil and oxen and sheep in abundance for joy was in Israel

13.t: And David consulted with the commanders of thousands and hundreds with every leader

And David said to all of the assembly of Israel If it is good to you and from Yahweh our God let us spread let us send to our remaining brothers in all of the lands of Israel and with them the priests and the Levites in the cities of their pasturelands and let them be gathered to us
And let us return the Box of our God to us for we did not seek it in the days of Saul
And all of the assembly said to do thus for the matter was right in the eyes of all of the people
And David assembled all of Israel from Shihor of Egypt and unto Lebo Hamath to bring the Box of God from Kiriath Jearim
And David went up and all of Israel to Baalah to Kiriath Jearim which is to Judah to bring up from there the Box of God Yahweh sitter of the cherubs which is called by the name
And they made the Box of God ride on a new cart from the house of Abinadab and Uzzah and Ahio were driving the cart
And David and all of Israel were rejoicing to the face of God with all might and with songs and with harps and with lyres and with tambourines and with cymbals and with trumpets
And they came to the threshing floor of Kidon and Uzzah sent out his hand to hold the Box for the oxen stumbled
And the nose of Yahweh burned against Uzzah and he struck him because he had sent his hand upon the Box And he died there to the face of God
And it burned to David because Yahweh had broken out a breaking out against Uzzah And he called to that place Perez Uzzah to this day
And David feared God on that day saying How shall I bring the Box of God to me
So David did not turn the Box to himself to the city of David but he turned it aside to the house of Obed Edom the Gittite
And the Box of God dwelled with the house of Obed Edom in his house three months And Yahweh blessed the house of Obed Edom and all that was to him

14.t: And Hiram the king of Tyre sent messengers to David and trees of cedar and craftsmen of a wall and craftsmen of wood to build a house for him
Then David knew that Yahweh had established him as king over Israel that his kingdom had been lifted to the height for the sake of his people Israel
And David took more wives in Jerusalem and David fathered more sons and daughters
And these are the names of the ones born who were to him in Jerusalem Shammua and Shobab Nathan and Solomon
and Ibhar and Elishua and Elpelet
and Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia
and Elishama and Beeliada and Eliphelet
Now the Philistines heard that David had been anointed as king over all of Israel and all of the Philistines went up to seek David And David heard and he went out to their faces
And the Philistines came and they spread out in the Valley of the Raphaites
Then David asked God saying Shall I go up against the Philistines And will you give them into my hand And Yahweh said to him Go up for I will give them into your hand

And they went up to Baal Perazim and David struck them there And David said God has broken through my enemies by my hand like the breaking through of waters Therefore they call the name of that place Baal Perazim
And they abandoned their gods there and David spoke and they were burned with fire
And the Philistines added again and they spread out in the valley
And David asked God again And God said to him Do not go up after them circle around from upon them and come at them from opposite the balsam trees
And it will be when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees then you shall go out in battle for God has gone out to your face to strike the camp of the Philistines
And David did according to what God had commanded And he struck the camp of the Philistines from Gibeon and unto Gezer
And the name of David went out into all of the lands and Yahweh put the fear of him on all of the nations

15.t: And he made houses for himself in the City of David And he prepared a place for the Box of God and he stretched out a tent for it
Then David said One is not to carry the Box of God except the Levites For Yahweh chose them to carry the Box of Yahweh and to serve him forever
And David assembled all of Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the Box of Yahweh to its place which he had prepared for it
And David assembled the sons of Aaron and the Levites
Of the sons of Kohath Uriel the chief and his brothers 120
Of the sons of Merari Asaiah the chief and his brothers 220
Of the sons of Gershom Joel the chief and his brothers 130
Of the sons of Elizaphan Shemaiah the chief and his brothers 200
Of the sons of Hebron Eliel the chief and his brothers 80
Of the sons of Uzziel Amminadab the chief and his brothers 112
And David called for Zadok and for Abiathar the priests and for the Levites for Uriel Asaiah and Joel Shemaiah and Eliel and Amminadab
And he said to them You are the heads of the fathers of the Levites Consecrate yourselves you and your brothers and bring up the Box of Yahweh the God of Israel to where I have prepared for it
For because at the first it was not you Yahweh our God broke out against us for we did not seek him according to the ordinance
And the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the Box of Yahweh the God of Israel
And the sons of Levi carried the Box of God according to what Moses had commanded according to the word of Yahweh on their shoulders with poles on them
And David said to the chiefs of the Levites to station their brothers the singers with instruments of song lyres and harps and cymbals playing to raise a sound of rejoicing
And the Levites stationed Heman the son of Joel and from his brothers Asaph the son of Berechiah and from the sons of Merari their brothers Ethan the son of Kushaiah

and with them their brothers the seconds Zechariah Ben and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed Edom and Jeiel the gatekeepers
And the singers Heman Asaph and Ethan with bronze cymbals to make heard
And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah with lyres according to Alamoth
And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed Edom and Jeiel and Azaziah with lyres to lead according to Sheminith
And Kenaniah the chief of the Levites in lifting up to instruct in lifting up for he was understanding
And Berechiah and Elkanah were keepers for the Box

And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were blowing trumpets to the face of the Box of God And Obed Edom and Jehiah were keepers for the Box
And it happened that David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands were going to bring up the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh from the house of Obed Edom with rejoicing
And it happened when God helped the Levites carrying the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh that they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams
And David was clothed in a robe of fine linen and all of the Levites carrying the Box and the singers and Kenaniah the chief of the lifting up of the singers And an ephod of linen was on David
And all of Israel was bringing up the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh with shouting and with the sound of the shofar and with trumpets and with cymbals playing on lyres and harps

And it happened that the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh was coming to the city of David and Michal the daughter of Saul looked down through a window And she saw King David dancing and celebrating And she despised him in her heart

16.t: And they brought in the Box of God and they placed it in the midst of the tent that David had stretched out for it And they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to the face of God
And David finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings and he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh
And he distributed to each man of Israel from man and to woman to a man a loaf of bread and a date cake and a raisin cake
And he appointed to the face of the Box of Yahweh from the Levites as ministering ones and to make one remember and to thank and to praise Yahweh the God of Israel
Asaph the head and Zechariah his second Jeiel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed Edom and Jeiel with instruments of lyres and harps and Asaph playing on cymbals
and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually to the face of the Box of the Covenant of God
On that day David then first appointed to thank Yahweh by the hand of Asaph and his brothers
Give thanks to Yahweh call on his name make known his deeds among the peoples
Sing to him make music to him meditate on all of his wonderful doings
Glory in the name of his holiness let the heart of the seekers of Yahweh rejoice
Seek Yahweh and his strength search for his face continually
Remember his wonderful doings that he has done his miracles and the judgments of his mouth
seed of Israel his servant sons of Jacob his chosen ones
He is Yahweh our God his judgments are in all of the earth
Remember his covenant forever the word he commanded for a thousand generations
which he cut with Abraham and his oath to Isaac
And he confirmed it to Jacob as a statute to Israel as a covenant forever
saying I will give to you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance
when you were few in number according to a little and sojourners in it
And they wandered from nation to nation and from a kingdom to another people
He did not allow a man to oppress them and he rebuked kings because of them
May you not touch my anointed ones and may you not harm my prophets
Sing to Yahweh all of the earth announce his salvation from day to day
Recount his glory among the nations his wonderful doings among all of the peoples
For Yahweh is great and is to be praised much and he is to be feared above all gods
For all of the gods of the peoples are idols but Yahweh made the heavens
Splendor and majesty are to his face strength and joy are in his place
Ascribe to Yahweh clans of the peoples ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength
Ascribe to Yahweh the glory of his name bring an offering and come to his face worship Yahweh in the splendor of holiness
Tremble from his face all of the earth Indeed the world is established it will not be shaken
Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad and let them say among the nations Yahweh reigns
Let the sea roar and its fullness let the field rejoice and all that is in it
Then let the trees of the forest shout joyfully from to the face of Yahweh for he is coming to judge the earth
Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And say Save us God of our salvation and gather us and deliver us from the nations to give thanks to the name of your holiness to glory ourselves in your praise
Blessed be Yahweh the God of Israel from everlasting and to everlasting And all of the people said Amen and they praised Yahweh
And he left Asaph and his brothers there to the face of the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh to minister to the face of the Box continually according to the matter of a day in its day
and Obed Edom and their brothers 68 and Obed Edom the son of Jeduthun and Hosah were gatekeepers
and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests to the face of the tabernacle of Yahweh at the high place that was in Gibeon
to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of burnt offering continually by morning and by evening even according to everything written in the law of Yahweh that he commanded to Israel
And with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of the chosen who were designated by names to give thanks to Yahweh for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And with them Heman and Jeduthun to be making heard trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music of God and the sons of Jeduthun for the gate
