And all of the people went a man to his house and David returned to bless his house

17.t: And it happened when David had dwelled in his house that David said to Nathan the prophet Behold I I am dwelling in a house of cedars but the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh is under curtains
And Nathan said to David All that is in your heart do for God is with you
But it happened in that night that the word of God was to Nathan saying
Go and you shall say to David my servant Thus says Yahweh You you shall not build for me a house for dwelling
for I have not dwelled in a house from the day that I brought up Israel until this day but I have been from tent to tent and from a tabernacle
In any place where I went about with all of Israel did I speak a word with one of the scepters of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd my people saying Why have you not built for me a house of cedars
And now thus you shall say to my servant to David Thus says Yahweh of Armies I I took you from the pasture from after the flock to be a leader over my people Israel
And I have been with you in every place where you have gone and I have cut off all of your enemies from your face And I will make a name for you like the name of the great who have been on the earth

And I have established a place for my people Israel and I will plant him that he may dwell under him and he will not tremble anymore And the sons of wickedness will not continue to afflict him as at the first
and from the days when I commanded judges over my people Israel And I will humble all of your enemies And I declare to you that Yahweh will build a house for you
And it will be when your days are full to go with your fathers then I will raise up after you your seed who will be from your sons and I will establish his kingdom
He he will build a house for me and I will establish his throne to forever
I I will be a father to him and he he will be a son to me And I will not turn away my covenant faithfulness from with him as I turned it away from him who was to your face
And I will station him in my house and in my kingdom to forever and his throne will be established to forever
According to all of these words and according to all of this vision thus Nathan spoke to David
And King David came and sat to the face of Yahweh and he said Who am I Yahweh God and what is my house that you have brought me to here
And this was small in your eyes God for you have spoken regarding the house of your servant to afar and you have regarded me according to the rank of a man of ascent Yahweh God
What shall David add more to you about honoring your servant For you you know your servant
Yahweh for the sake of your servant and according to your heart you have done all of this greatness to make known all of the greatnesses
Yahweh there is none like you and no God except you in all that we have heard with our ears

And who is like your people Israel the one nation on the earth whose God went to redeem for himself a people to make for himself a great and feared name to dispossess nations from the face of your people whom you redeemed from Egypt
And you established your people Israel for yourself as a people to forever and you Yahweh you became God to them
And now Yahweh the word that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house may it be confirmed to forever and do just as you have spoken
And may it be confirmed and may your name be great to forever saying Yahweh of Armies the God of Israel is God to Israel and may the house of David your servant be established to your face
For you my God have uncovered the ear of your servant to build a house for him Therefore your servant has found to pray to your face
And now Yahweh you are he God and you have spoken this good concerning your servant
And now you have decided to bless the house of your servant to be to your face forever For you Yahweh you have blessed so it will be blessed forever

18.t: And it happened after this that David struck the Philistines and he subdued them And he took Gath and its daughters from the hand of the Philistines
And he struck Moab and Moab became servants to David lifters of tribute
And David struck Hadadezer the king of Zobah Hamath when he went to establish his hand at the Euphrates River
And David captured from him 1 000 chariots and 7 000 horsemen and 20 000 men on foot And David hamstrung all of the chariots but he left from him 100 chariots
And Aram of Damascus came to help Hadadezer the king of Zobah And David struck 22 000 men among Aram
And David put garrisons in Aram of Damascus and Aram became servants to David lifters of tribute And Yahweh saved David in every place where he went
And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer and he brought them to Jerusalem
And from Tibhath and from Kun cities of Hadadezer David took very much bronze With it Solomon made the sea of bronze and the pillars and the vessels of bronze
And Tou the king of Hamath heard that David had struck all of the army of Hadadezer the king of Zobah

And he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him for peace and to bless him because he had fought with Hadadezer and had struck him For Tou had been a man of war with Hadadezer And all of the vessels of gold and silver and bronze

King David also consecrated them to Yahweh with the silver and the gold that he had lifted from all of the nations from Edom and from Moab and from the sons of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek
And Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck Edom in the Valley of Salt 18 000
And he put garrisons in Edom and all of Edom became servants to David And Yahweh saved David in every place where he went
And David reigned over all of Israel And it happened that he was doing judgment and righteousness for all of his people
And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder
And Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests and Shavasha was the scribe
And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites and the sons of David were heads at the hand of the king

19.t: And it happened after this that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died and his son reigned in place of him

And David said I will do kindness with Hanun the son of Nahash for his father did kindness with me And David sent messengers to console him concerning his father And the servants of David came to the land of the sons of Ammon to Hanun to console him

And the commanders of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun In your eyes is David honoring your father because he has sent comforters to you Is it not in order to explore and to overthrow and to spy on the land that his servants have come to you
So Hanun took the servants of David and he shaved them and he cut their garments in the middle to the buttocks and he sent them away
and they went And they declared to David concerning the men and he sent to meet them for the men were greatly humiliated And the king said Stay in Jericho until when your beards grow then return

And the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves stink with David So Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent 1 000 kikkars of silver to hire chariots and horsemen for themselves from Aram Naharaim and from Aram Maacah and from Zobah

And they hired for themselves 32 000 chariots and the king of Maacah and his people And they came and they encamped to the face of Medeba And the sons of Ammon assembled themselves from their cities and they came for battle
And David heard and he sent Joab and all of the army the warriors
And the sons of Ammon came out and they arrayed for battle at the entrance of the city And the kings who came were by themselves in the field
And Joab saw that the faces of the battle were against him before and behind and he chose from all of the chosen of Israel and he arrayed them to meet Aram
And he put the rest of the people in the hand of Abishai his brother and he arrayed them to meet the sons of Ammon
And he said If Aram is stronger than me then you shall be to me for salvation but if the sons of Ammon are stronger than you then I will save you
Be strong and let us strengthen ourselves for the sake of our people and for the sake of the cities of our God And may Yahweh do the good in his eyes
Then Joab and the people who were with him approached to the face of Aram for battle and they fled from his face
And the sons of Ammon saw that Aram had fled and they fled they also from the face of Abishai his brother And they came to the city and Joab came to Jerusalem

And Aram saw that they had been defeated to the face of Israel And they sent messengers and they brought Aram that was from beyond the River and Shophach the commander of the army of Hadadezer to their faces

And it was declared to David and he assembled all of Israel and he crossed the Jordan and he came to Helam and he arrayed against them And David arrayed to meet Aram in battle and they fought with him
And Aram fled from the face of Israel and David killed from Aram 7 000 charioteers and 40 000 men on foot And he killed Shobach the commander of the army
And the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been struck to the face of Israel and they made peace with David and they served him And Aram was not willing to save the sons of Ammon anymore

20.t: And it happened at the time of the return of the year the time of the going out of kings that Joab led the might of the army and he destroyed the land of the sons of Ammon and he came and besieged against Rabbah But David stayed in Jerusalem And Joab struck Rabbah and he tore it down

And David took the crown of their king from upon his head and he found it the weight a kikkar of gold and in it a precious stone and it was on the head of David And he brought out the plunder of the city being very great

And he brought out the people who were in it and one sawed with the saw and with picks of iron and with saws And thus David did to all of the cities of the sons of Ammon And David and all of the people returned to Jerusalem
And it happened after this that battle arose at Gezer with the Philistines Then Sibbecai the Hushathite struck Saph from the children of the Raphaites and they were subdued
And there was battle again with the Philistines And Elhanan the son of Jair struck Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite and the wood of his spear was like a beam of weavers
And there was battle again at Gath and there was a man of stature and his digits were six and six 24 And he also was born to Rapha
And he taunted Israel and Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David struck him
These were born to Rapha in Gath And they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants

21.t: And the adversary stood up against Israel and he incited David to count Israel
And David said to Joab and to the commanders of the people Go count Israel from Beersheba and to Dan and bring to me that I may know their number
And Joab said May Yahweh add to his people like them 100 times My lord the king are not all of them servants to my lord Why does my lord seek this Why should it be for guilt to Israel
But the word of the king prevailed against Joab So Joab went out and walked about in all of Israel Then he came to Jerusalem
And Joab gave the number of the mustering of the people to David And all of Israel was 1 100 000 men drawing the sword and Judah 470 000 men drawing the sword
But Levi and Benjamin he did not muster in their midst for the word of the king was abhorrent to Joab
And it was evil in the eyes of God concerning this word and he struck Israel
And David said to God I have sinned greatly that I have done this thing And now please make the iniquity of your servant pass away for I have acted very foolishly
And Yahweh spoke to Gad the seer of David saying
Go and you shall speak to David saying Thus says Yahweh Three I I am stretching over you Choose for yourself one from them and I will do it to you
And Gad came to David and he said to him Thus says Yahweh Take for yourself

whether three years of famine or three months of being swept away from the face of your adversaries and the sword of your enemies overtaking you or three days of the sword of Yahweh even a plague in the land and the angel of Yahweh destroying in all of the border of Israel And now see what word shall I return to the one having sent me
And David said to Gad It is narrow to me greatly Let me fall please into the hand of Yahweh for his mercies are very many but into the hand of man let me not fall
And Yahweh put a plague on Israel and 70 000 men from Israel fell

And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it But as he was destroying Yahweh saw and he relented concerning the harm And he said to the destroying angel Enough Now lower your hand And the angel of Yahweh was standing at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite

And David lifted his eyes and saw the angel of Yahweh standing between the earth and between the heavens and his drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem And David fell and the elders covered in sackcloth on their faces

And David said to God Was it not I I who said to muster the people And I am he who sinned and doing wrong I have done wrong But these sheep what have they done Yahweh my God please let your hand be against me and against the house of my father but may a plague not be on your people
And the angel of Yahweh said to Gad to say to David that David should go up to raise an altar to Yahweh at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite
So David went up at the word of Gad who spoke in the name of Yahweh
And Ornan turned and he saw the angel And the four of his sons with him were hiding themselves And Ornan was threshing wheat
And David came to Ornan And Ornan looked and he saw David And he came out from the threshing floor and he prostrated himself to David nostrils to the ground
And David said to Ornan Give to me the place of the threshing floor that I may build an altar to Yahweh on it give it to me for the full silver that the plague may be restrained from upon the people

And Ornan said to David Take for yourself that my lord the king may do the good in his eyes See I give the cattle for the burnt offerings and the threshing sledges for the wood and the wheat for the offering I give everything
And King David said to Ornan No for buying I will buy for the full silver for I will not lift up to Yahweh what is to you and offer a burnt offering without cost
And David gave to Ornan 600 shekels of gold by weight for the place
And David built there an altar to Yahweh and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings And he called to Yahweh and he answered him with fire from the heavens on the altar of the burnt offering
And Yahweh spoke to the angel and he returned his sword to its sheath
At that time when David saw that Yahweh had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite then he sacrificed there
For the tabernacle of Yahweh that Moses made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were at the high place in Gibeon at that time
And David was not able to go to its face to seek God for he was terrified from the face of the sword of the angel of Yahweh

22.t: And David said This it will be the house of Yahweh God and this will be the altar for burnt offering for Israel
And David said to gather the foreigners who were in the land of Israel And he appointed cutters to cut out stones of hewing to build the house of God
And David prepared iron to abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the joinings and bronze to abundance without weighing
And trees of cedar without number for the Sidonians and the Tyrians brought trees of cedar to David to abundance

And David said Solomon my son is a young man and tender and the house to build for Yahweh is to make great for the sake of the name and for beauty in all of the lands Let me now prepare for it And David prepared to abundance to the face of his death
And he called for Solomon his son and he commanded him to build a house for Yahweh the God of Israel
And David said to Solomon My son I it was with my heart to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God
But the word of Yahweh was to me saying You have shed blood to abundance and you have made great wars You shall not build a house for my name for you have shed much blood on the earth to my face

Behold a son being born to you he he will be a man of rest And I will give rest to him from all of his enemies from around For Solomon will be his name and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days
He he will build a house for my name And he he will be a son to me and I will be a father to him And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel to forever
Now my son may Yahweh be with you and may you succeed and may you build a house of Yahweh your God just as he spoke about you
Only may Yahweh give insight and understanding to you and may he give you command over Israel that you may keep the law of Yahweh your God
Then you will succeed if you are careful to do the statutes and the judgments that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning Israel Be strong and be courageous May you not fear and may you not be dismayed

And behold in my trouble I have prepared for the house of Yahweh gold 100 000 kikkars and silver 1 000 000 kikkars and for bronze and for iron without weighing for it is to abundance And I have prepared timbers and stones and you shall add to them
And with you to abundance are doers of work cutters and craftsmen of stone and wood and all wise in all work
in gold in silver and in bronze and in iron without number Arise and work and may Yahweh be with you
And David commanded all of the rulers of Israel to help Solomon his son

Is not Yahweh your God with you and has he not given rest to you from around For he has given the dwellers of the land into my hand and the land has been subdued to the face of Yahweh and to the face of his people

Now give your heart and your soul to seek Yahweh your God and arise and build the sanctuary of Yahweh God to bring the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh and the vessels of holiness of God to the house being built for the name of Yahweh

23.t: And David was old and he was full of days and he made Solomon his son reign over Israel
And he gathered all of the rulers of Israel and the priests and the Levites
And the Levites were counted from sons of 30 years and above and the counting was by their skulls by males 38 000
From these to lead over the work of the house of Yahweh 24 000 and officers and judges 6 000
and 4 000 gatekeepers and 4 000 praisers of Yahweh with the instruments that I made for praising
And David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi of Gershon Kohath and Merari
Of the Gershonite Ladan and Shimei
The sons of Ladan Jehiel the head and Zetham and Joel three
The sons of Shimei Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran three These were the heads of the fathers of Ladan
And the sons of Shimei Jahath and Zina and Jeush and Beriah These were the sons of Shimei four
And Jahath was the head and Zizah the second but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons so they became a house of a father by one assignment
The sons of Kohath Amram Izhar Hebron and Uzziel four

The sons of Amram Aaron and Moses And Aaron was separated for him to consecrate the holy of holies he and his sons to forever to sacrifice to the face of Yahweh to minister to him and to bless his name to forever
And Moses the man of God his sons were called according to the tribe of Levi
The sons of Moses Gershom and Eliezer
The sons of Gershom Shebuel the head
And the sons of Eliezer were Rehabiah the head And other sons were not to Eliezer but the sons of Rehabiah were many to above
The sons of Izhar Shelomith the head
The sons of Hebron Jeriah the head Amariah the second Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth
The sons of Uzziel Micah the head and Isshiah the second
The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi The sons of Mahli Eleazar and Kish
And Eleazar died and sons were not to him but only daughters And the sons of Kish their brothers lifted them
The sons of Mushi Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth three

These were the sons of Levi according to the house of their fathers heads of fathers by their appointments in the numbering of names by their skulls the doer of the work of the service of the house of Yahweh from sons of 20 years and above
For David said Yahweh the God of Israel has given rest to his people And he dwells in Jerusalem to forever
And also for the Levites it is not to carry the tabernacle and all of its vessels for its service
For by the last words of David they were counting the sons of Levi from sons of 20 years and to above

For their service was at the hand of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Yahweh over the courts and over the chambers and over the purifying of all of the holy and the work of the service of the house of God
and for the bread of the arrangement and for the fine flour for the offering and for the wafers of unleavened bread and for the pan and for the mixing and for every measure and size
and to stand by morning by morning to thank and to praise Yahweh and thus in the evening
and for every offering of burnt offerings to Yahweh on the Sabbaths at the new moons and at the annual festivals by number according to the regulation about them continually to the face of Yahweh
And they kept the keeping of the tent of meeting and the keeping of the holy place and the keeping of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the house of Yahweh

24.t: And to the sons of Aaron their divisions The sons of Aaron Nadab and Abihu Eleazar and Ithamar
And Nadab died and Abihu to the face of their father and sons were not to them And Eleazar and Ithamar became priests
And David divided them and Zadok from the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech from the sons of Ithamar according to their appointment in their service

And more sons of Eleazar were found for heads of men than sons of Ithamar so they divided them for the sons of Eleazar heads of a house of fathers sixteen and for the sons of Ithamar for the house of their fathers eight
And they divided them by lots these with these for officials of the holy place and officials of God were from the sons of Eleazar and among the sons of Ithamar

And Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe from the Levites wrote them to the face of the king and the officials and Zadok the priest and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar and the heads of the fathers for the priests and for the Levites One house of a father was taken for Eleazar and was taken was taken for Ithamar
And the first lot came out for Jehoiarib the second for Jedaiah
the third for Harim the fourth for Seorim
the fifth for Malkijah the sixth for Mijamin
the seventh for Hakkoz the eighth for Abijah
the ninth for Jeshua the tenth for Shecaniah
the eleventh for Eliashib the twelfth for Jakim
the thirteenth for Huppah the fourteenth for Jeshebeab
the fifteenth for Bilgah the sixteenth for Immer
the seventeenth for Hezir the eighteenth for Happizzez
the nineteenth for Pethahiah the twentieth for Jehezkel
the twenty first for Jakin the twenty second for Gamul
the twenty third for Delaiah the twenty fourth for Maaziah
These were the appointment for their service to come into the house of Yahweh according to their ordinance by the hand of Aaron their father as Yahweh the God of Israel had commanded him
And of the remaining sons of Levi of the sons of Amram Shubael of the sons of Shubael Jehdeiah
Of Rehabiah of the sons of Rehabiah Ishijah the head
Of the Izharite Shelomoth of the sons of Shelomoth Jahath
And the sons of Jeriah were Amariah the second Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth
The sons of Uzziel Micah of the sons of Micah Shamir
The brother of Micah Ishijah of the sons of Ishijah Zechariah
The sons of Merari Mahli and Mushi The sons of Jaaziah Beno
The sons of Merari of Jaaziah Beno and Shoham and Zaccur and Ibri
Of Mahli Eleazar but sons were not to him
Of Kish the sons of Kish Jerahmeel
And the sons of Mushi Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth These were the sons of the Levites according to the house of their fathers

And they also cast lots beside their brothers the sons of Aaron to the face of King David and Zadok and Ahimelech and the heads of fathers for the priests and for the Levites fathers of the head beside his youngest brother

25.t: And David and the commanders of the army separated for service the sons of Asaph and Heman and Jeduthun prophesying with harps with lyres and with cymbals And the number of the men of work for their service was
From the sons of Asaph Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asharelah the sons of Asaph at the hand of Asaph prophesying at the hands of the king
From Jeduthun the sons of Jeduthun Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah Hashabiah and Mattithiah six at the hands of their father Jeduthun prophesying with the harp in order to thank and to praise Yahweh
Of Heman the sons of Heman Bukkiah Mattaniah Uzziel Shubael and Jerimoth Hananiah Hanani Eliathah Giddalti and Romamti Ezer Joshbekashah Mallothi Hothir Mahazioth
All of these were sons of Heman the seer of the king by the words of God to lift up his horn For God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters

All of these were at the hands of their father in the song of the house of Yahweh with cymbals lyres and harps for the service of the house of God At the hands of the king were Asaph and Jeduthun and Heman
And their number with their brothers having been taught the song of Yahweh all of the ones understanding was 288
And they cast lots for a duty just as like small like great the one understanding with the student
And the first lot came out for Asaph for Joseph the second Gedaliah him and his brothers and his sons 12
the third Zaccur his sons and his brothers 12
the fourth for Izri his sons and his brothers 12
the fifth Nethaniah his sons and his brothers 12
the sixth Bukkiah his sons and his brothers 12
the seventh Jesarelah his sons and his brothers 12
the eighth Jeshaiah his sons and his brothers 12
the ninth Mattaniah his sons and his brothers 12
the tenth Shimei his sons and his brothers 12
the eleventh Azarel his sons and his brothers 12
the twelfth for Hashabiah his sons and his brothers 12
for the thirteenth Shubael his sons and his brothers 12
for the fourteenth Mattithiah his sons and his brothers 12
for the fifteenth for Jerimoth his sons and his brothers 12
for the sixteenth for Hananiah his sons and his brothers 12
for the seventeenth for Joshbekashah his sons and his brothers 12
for the eighteenth for Hanani his sons and his brothers 12
for the nineteenth for Mallothi his sons and his brothers 12
for the twentieth for Eliathah his sons and his brothers 12
for the twenty first for Hothir his sons and his brothers 12
for the twenty second for Giddalti his sons and his brothers 12
for the twenty third for Mahazioth his sons and his brothers 12
for the twenty fourth for Romamti Ezer his sons and his brothers 12

26.t: For the divisions of the gatekeepers From the Korahites Meshelemiah the son of Kore from the sons of Asaph
And sons were to Meshelemiah Zechariah the firstborn Jediael the second Zebadiah the third Jathniel the fourth
Elam the fifth Jehohanan the sixth Eliehoenai the seventh
And sons were to Obed Edom Shemaiah the firstborn Jehozabad the second Joah the third and Sakar the fourth and Nethanel the fifth
Ammiel the sixth Issachar the seventh Peullethai the eighth for God blessed him
And sons were born to Shemaiah his son rulers in the house of their father for they were warriors of valor
The sons of Shemaiah were Othni and Rephael and Obed Elzabad his brothers Elihu and Semakiah were sons of valor
All of these were from the sons of Obed Edom They and their sons and their brothers were men of valor with might for service 62 of Obed Edom
And sons and brothers were to Meshelemiah sons of valor 18
And sons were to Hosah from the sons of Merari Shimri the head although he was not the firstborn yet his father set him as the head
Hilkiah the second Tabaliah the third Zechariah the fourth All of the sons and brothers to Hosah were 13
To these divisions of the gatekeepers to the heads of the men was a duty like their brothers to minister in the house of Yahweh
And they cast lots like small like great according to the house of their fathers for gate and gate
And the eastward lot fell to Shelemiah And Zechariah his son was a counselor with insight they cast lots and his lot came out northward
For Obed Edom southward and for his sons the house of stores
For Shuppim and for Hosah to the west with the gate of Shalleketh on the ascending highway guard beside guard
To the east six Levites to the north four per day to the south four per day and at the stores two two
At the colonnade to the west four at the highway two at the colonnade
These were the divisions of the gatekeepers for the sons of the Korahite and for the sons of Merari
And from the Levites Ahijah was over the treasuries of the house of God and for the treasuries of the holy things
The sons of Ladan the sons of the Gershonite who were to Ladan the heads of fathers who were to Ladan the Gershonite Jehieli
The sons of Jehieli Zetham and Joel his brother were over the treasuries of the house of Yahweh
Of the Amramites of the Izharites of the Hebronites of the Uzzielites
Shubael the son of Gershom the son of Moses was the leader over the treasuries
And his brothers who were to Eliezer were Rehabiah his son and Jeshaiah his son and Joram his son and Zichri his son and Shelomith his son

He Shelomith and his brothers were over all of the treasuries of the holy things that King David consecrated and the heads of fathers who were commanders of thousands and hundreds and commanders of the army
From battles and from plunder they consecrated to strengthen the house of Yahweh
And everything Samuel the seer consecrated and Saul the son of Kish and Abner the son of Ner and Joab the son of Zeruiah all of the holy things were at the hand of Shelomith and his brothers
Of the Izharite Kenaniah and his sons were for the outside work for Israel as officials and judges
Of the Hebronite Hashabiah and his brothers sons of valor 1 700 were upon the oversight of Israel from across the Jordan from the west for all of the work of Yahweh and for the service of the king

Of the Hebronite Jeriah the head of the Hebronite according to his generations of fathers In year 40 of the reign of David they were sought and it was found among them warriors of valor in Jazer of Gilead

And his brothers were sons of valor 2 700 heads of fathers And King David appointed them over the Reubenite and the Gadite and half of the tribe of Manasseh for every matter of God and matter of the king

27.t: And the sons of Israel according to their number the heads of fathers and commanders of thousands and hundreds and their officers ministering to the king for every matter of divisions coming in and going out month by month one division for all months of the year were 24 000
Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel and in his division were 24 000
from the sons of Perez the head of all of the commanders of the armies for the first month
And over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and of his division Mikloth also was a leader and in his division were 24 000
The third commander of the army for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the head priest and in his division were 24 000
He Benaiah was a warrior of the Thirty and over the Thirty and in his division was Ammizabad his son
The fourth for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab and Zebadiah his son was after him and in his division were 24 000
The fifth for the fifth month the commander was Shamhuth the Izrahite and in his division were 24 000
The sixth for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite and in his division were 24 000
The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite from the sons of Ephraim and in his division were 24 000
The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbekai the Hushathite of the Zerahite and in his division were 24 000
The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite of the Benjaminite and in his division were 24 000
The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophahite of the Zerahite and in his division were 24 000
The eleventh for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite from the sons of Ephraim and in his division were 24 000
The twelfth for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophahite of Othniel and in his division were 24 000
And over the tribes of Israel for the Reubenite a leader Eliezer the son of Zichri for the Simeonite Shephatiah the son of Maacah
for the Levite Hashabiah the son of Kemuel for Aaron Zadok
for Judah Elihu from the brothers of David for Issachar Omri the son of Michael
for Zebulun Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah for Naphtali Jerimoth the son of Azriel
for the sons of Ephraim Hoshea the son of Azaziah for half of the tribe of Manasseh Joel the son of Pedaiah
for the half of Manasseh in Gilead Iddo the son of Zechariah for Benjamin Jaasiel the son of Abner
for Dan Azarel the son of Jeroham These were the commanders of the tribes of Israel
And David did not take up the number for a son of 20 years and under for Yahweh had said he would multiply Israel like the stars of the heavens
Joab the son of Zeruiah began to count but he did not finish For because of this wrath was upon Israel And the number did not go up among the number of the matters of the days of King David
And over the treasuries of the king was Azmaveth the son of Adiel And over the treasuries in the field in the cities and in the villages and in the towers was Jonathan the son of Uzziah
And over the doers of the work of the field for the service of the ground was Ezri the son of Kelub
And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite And over what was in the vineyards for the treasuries of wine was Zabdi the Shiphmite
And over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the Shephelah was Baal Hanan the Gederite And over the treasuries of oil was Joash
And over the herd pasturing in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite And over the herd in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai
And over the camels was Obil the Ishmaelite And over the female donkeys was Jehdeiah the Meronothite
And over the flock was Jaziz the Hagrite All of these were officials of the property that was to King David
And Jonathan the uncle of David was an advisor He was a man of understanding and a scribe And Jehiel the son of Hakmoni was with the sons of the king
And Ahithophel was an advisor to the king and Hushai the Archite was a friend of the king
And after Ahithophel were Jehoiada the son of Benaiah and Abiathar And the commander of the army of the king was Joab

28.t: And David assembled all of the leaders of Israel the leaders of the tribes and the commanders of the divisions serving the king and the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds and the officers of all of the property and possessions of the king and of his sons with the officials and the warriors and all of the warriors of valor to Jerusalem

And David the king rose to his feet and he said Hear me my brothers and my people As for me it was with my heart to build a house of rest for the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh and as a footstool of the feet of our God And I prepared to build
But God said to me You shall not build a house for my name for you have been a man of battles and you have shed blood

Yet Yahweh the God of Israel chose me from all of the house of my father to be king over Israel forever for he chose Judah for a leader and in the house of Judah the house of my father and among the sons of my father he delighted in me to make me reign over all of Israel
And from all of my sons for Yahweh has given many sons to me he then chose Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of Yahweh over Israel
And he said to me Solomon your son he he will build my house and my courts for I have chosen him for myself as a son and I I will be a father to him
And I will establish his kingdom to forever if he is strong to do my commands and my judgments as this day

And now in the eyes of all of Israel the assembly of Yahweh and in the ears of our God keep and seek all of the commandments of Yahweh your God that you may possess the good land and that you may cause your sons after you to inherit it to forever

And you Solomon my son know the God of your father and serve him with a whole heart and with a willing soul for Yahweh is seeking all hearts and he is understanding every intention of thoughts If you seek him he will be found by you but if you abandon him he will reject you forever
Now see for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house as a sanctuary Be strong and act
And David gave to Solomon his son the plan of the porch and its houses and its treasuries and its upper rooms and its inner rooms and the house of the covering

and the plan of all that was with him by the Spirit for the courts of the house of Yahweh and for all of the chambers around for the treasuries of the house of God and for the treasuries of the holy things
and for the divisions of the priests and the Levites and for all of the work of the service of the house of Yahweh and for all of the vessels of the service of the house of Yahweh
for gold by weight for gold for all of the vessels of service and service for all of the vessels of silver by weight for all of the vessels of service and service

and the weight for the gold lampstands and their gold lamps by weight lampstand and lampstand and its lamps and for the silver lampstands by weight for a lampstand and its lamps according to the service of lampstand and lampstand
and gold by weight for the tables of the arrangement for table and table and silver for the tables of silver
and the forks and the basins and the pitchers of pure gold and for the gold bowls by weight for bowl and bowl and for the bowls of silver by weight for bowl and bowl
and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight and for the plan of the chariot of the gold cherubs for spreading out and covering over the Box of the Covenant of Yahweh
Everything is in writing from the hand of Yahweh upon me He made me understand all of the works of the plan

And David said to Solomon his son Be strong and be courageous and act May you not fear and may you not be dismayed for Yahweh God my God is with you He will not leave you and he will not abandon you until all of the work of the service of the house of Yahweh finishes

And behold the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all of the service of the house of God and with you in all of the work will be every willing one with wisdom for all of the service and the leaders and all of the people for all of your ways

29.t: And King David said to all of the assembly Solomon my son God has chosen him alone is young and tender and the work is great for the temple is not for man but for Yahweh God

And according to all of my power I have prepared for the house of my God gold for the gold and silver for the silver and bronze for the bronze iron for the iron and wood for the wood stones of onyx and settings stones of antimony and variegation and every precious stone and stones of marble to abundance
And again in my delighting in the house of my God I have given to the house of my God a treasure being to me gold and silver to above from everything I have prepared for the house of the sanctuary
3 000 kikkars of gold from the gold of Ophir and 7 000 kikkars of refined silver to overlay the walls of the houses
gold for the gold and silver for the silver and for all of the work by the hand of the craftsmen And who is willing to fill his hand today to Yahweh
Then the leaders of the fathers offered freely and the leaders of the tribes of Israel and the commanders of thousands and hundreds and the commanders of the work of the king
And they gave gold for the service of the house of God 5 000 kikkars and one myriad darics and silver 10 000 kikkars and bronze 18 000 kikkars and iron 100 000 kikkars
And the one being found with it they gave stones to the treasury of the house of Yahweh under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite
And the people rejoiced because they had offered freely for with a whole heart they had offered freely to Yahweh And King David also rejoiced a great rejoicing
And David blessed Yahweh to the eyes of all of the assembly And David said Blessed are you Yahweh God of Israel our father from forever and to forever

To you Yahweh are the greatness and the might and the glory and the splendor and the majesty for everything in the heavens and on the earth is to you Yahweh the kingdom and lifting yourself above all as head
And wealth and glory are from to your face and you are ruling over all and in your hand are power and might and in your hand is to exalt and to strengthen all
And now our God we are giving thanks to you and praising the name of your glory
And for who am I and who are my people that we should have the power to offer freely like this For everything is from you and from your hand we have given to you
For we are foreigners to your face and settlers like all of our fathers Our days upon the earth are like a shadow and without hope
Yahweh our God all of this abundance that we have prepared to build a house for you for the name of your holiness it is from your hand and all is for you

And I know my God that you are examining the heart and are pleased with uprightnesses In the uprightness of my heart I I have offered freely all of these And now your people have been found here I see with rejoicing to offer freely to you
Yahweh the God of Abraham Isaac and Israel our fathers keep this forever concerning the intention of the thoughts of the heart of your people and establish their heart toward you
And give to Solomon my son a whole heart to keep your commandments your testimonies and your statutes and to do everything and to build the temple that I have prepared
And David said to all of the assembly Now bless Yahweh your God And all of the assembly blessed Yahweh the God of their fathers And they bowed down and prostrated themselves to Yahweh and to the king

And they sacrificed sacrifices to Yahweh and they offered burnt offerings to Yahweh on the morrow of that day 1 000 bulls 1 000 rams 1 000 lambs and their drink offerings and sacrifices to abundance for all of Israel
And they ate and drank to the face of Yahweh on that day with great rejoicing And they made Solomon the son of David king a second time and they anointed a leader for Yahweh and Zadok as priest
And Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king in place of David his father And he succeeded and all of Israel listened to him
And all of the leaders and the warriors and also all of the sons of King David gave a hand under King Solomon
And Yahweh made Solomon great to above in the eyes of all of Israel And he put on him the majesty of a kingdom over Israel that had not been on any king to his face
Now David the son of Jesse had reigned over all of Israel
And the days that he reigned over Israel were 40 years He reigned in Hebron 7 years and he reigned in Jerusalem 33
And he died in good old age full of days wealth and glory And Solomon his son reigned in his place
Now the matters of King David the first and the last behold they are written in the words of Samuel the seer and in the words of Nathan the prophet and in the words of Gad the visionary
with all of his reign and his might and the times that passed over him and over Israel and over all of the kingdoms of the lands

1.t: And Solomon the son of David strengthened himself over his kingdom and Yahweh his God was with him and made him exceedingly great
And Solomon said to all Israel to the chiefs of thousands and of hundreds and to the judges and to every prince of all Israel the heads of the fathers
And Solomon went and all the assembly with him to the high place that was at Gibeon for there was the tent of meeting of God which Moses the servant of Yahweh had made in the wilderness
However the Box of God David had brought up from Kiriath Jearim to where David prepared for it for he pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem
And the bronze altar which Bezalel the son of Uri the son of Hur made was there before the tabernacle of Yahweh and Solomon and the assembly sought him
And Solomon went up there to the bronze altar before Yahweh which was at the tent of meeting and he brought up on it 1 000 burnt offerings
In that night God appeared to Solomon and he said to him Ask what I should give to you
And Solomon said to God You yourself did with David my father great covenant faithfulness and have made me king in his place
Now Yahweh God may your word with David my father be confirmed for you yourself have made me king over a people numerous as the dust of the earth
Now wisdom and knowledge give to me and I will go out before this people and I will come in for who can judge this great people of yours

And God said to Solomon Because this was in your heart and you have not asked for wealth riches or glory or the life of those who hate you and also many days you did not ask but you have asked for yourself wisdom and knowledge with which you will judge my people which I made you king over them
wisdom and knowledge are given to you and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you which were not thus to the kings who were before you and after you will not be thus
And Solomon came from the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem from before the tent of meeting and he was king over Israel
And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen and there was to him 1 400 chariots and 12 000 horsemen and he placed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem
And the king made silver and gold in Jerusalem as the stones and cedars he made as the sycamore trees that were in the lowlands in abundance
And the source of the horses which were to Solomon was from Egypt and from Kue the traders of the king they would take at a price from Kue
And they brought up and brought out from Egypt a chariot for 600 silver and a horse for 150 And thus according to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram by their hands they brought out

2.t: And Solomon said to build a house for the name of Yahweh and a house for his kingdom
And Solomon counted 70 000 men as burden bearers and 80 000 men as stonemasons in the hills and directors over them 3 600
And Solomon sent to Hiram the king of Tyre saying Just as you did with David my father and sent to him cedars to build for himself a house to dwell in it

Behold I am building a house for the name of Yahweh my God to consecrate to him to sacrifice before him spiced incense and the regular display and burnt offerings in the morning and in the evening on the Sabbaths and on the new moons and the appointed times of Yahweh our God Forever this is over Israel
And the house that I am building will be great for great is our God more than all gods
But who can keep strength to build for him a house since the heavens and the heavens of the heavens do not contain him And who am I that I would build for him a house except to sacrifice before him

And now send to me a wise man to work in gold and in silver and in bronze and in iron and in purple and crimson and violet and one who knows how to engrave engravings with the wise who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem whom David my father prepared
And send to me trees of cedar cypress and algum from Lebanon for I myself know that your servants know how to cut trees of Lebanon And behold my servants will be with your servants
in order to prepare for me trees in abundance for the house which I am building will be great and marvelous
And behold to the wood cutters to the ones who cut the trees I will give crushed wheat to your servants 20 000 cors and barley 20 000 cors and wine 20 000 baths and oil 20 000 baths
And Hiram the king of Tyre said in a writing and sent to Solomon Because Yahweh loves his people he has placed you over them as king

And Hiram said Blessed be Yahweh the God of Israel who made the heavens and the earth who has given to David the king a son of wisdom knowing insight and understanding who will build a house for Yahweh and a house for his kingdom
And now I have sent a wise man knowing understanding Huram Abi

a son of a woman from the daughters of Dan and his father a man of Tyre knowing to work in gold and in silver in bronze in iron in stones and in trees in purple in violet and in fine linen and in crimson and to engrave any engraving and to devise any device which is given to him with your wise ones and the wise ones of my lord David your father
And now the wheat and the barley the oil and the wine which my lord has said let him send to his servants
And we ourselves will cut trees from Lebanon according to all your need and we will bring them to you by rafts by sea to Joppa and you yourself will bring them up to Jerusalem
And Solomon counted all the men the foreigners who were in the land of Israel after the census that David his father had counted them And there were found 153 600
And he made from them 70 000 burden bearers 80 000 stonemasons in the hills and 3 600 directors to cause the people to work

3.t: And Solomon began to build the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah where he had appeared to David his father where David prepared in the place at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite
And he began to build in the second month on the second in the fourth year of his reign
And these were the founding of Solomon to build the house of God the length in cubits by the former measure 60 cubits and the width 20 cubits
And the porch which is at the front the length on the front of the width of the house 20 cubits and the height 120 And he overlaid it from within with pure gold
And the great house he overlaid with cypress wood and he overlaid it with pure gold and he brought up on it palm trees and chains
And he overlaid the house with precious stones for beauty and the gold was gold of Parvaim
And he overlaid the house the beams the thresholds and its walls and its doors with gold and he engraved cherubim on the walls
And he made the house of the holy of holies its length at the front of the width of the house 20 cubits and its width 20 cubits And he overlaid it with pure gold to 600 talents
And the weight of the nails was 50 shekels of gold and the upper rooms he overlaid with gold
And he made in the house of the holy of holies two cherubim a work of casting and he overlaid them with gold
And the wings of the cherubim their length was 20 cubits one wing was five cubits reaching to the wall of the house and another wing five cubits reaching to a wing of the other cherub
And the wing of the other cherub five cubits reaching to the wall of the house and the other wing five cubits clinging to the wing of the other cherub
The wings of these cherubim spread out 20 cubits And they were standing on their feet and their faces toward the house
And he made the curtain of violet and purple and crimson and fine linen and he brought up on it cherubim
And he made before the house two pillars 35 cubits in length and the capital which was on its head five cubits
And he made chains in the inner sanctuary and he placed on the head of the pillars and he made 100 pomegranates and he placed on the chains
And he set up the pillars on the face of the temple one on the right hand and one on the left And he called the name of the right Jakin and the name of the left Boaz

4.t: And he made an altar of bronze 20 cubits its length and 20 cubits its width and 10 cubits its height
And he made the Sea of cast metal 10 by the cubit from its edge to its edge round all around and 5 by the cubit its height and a measuring string 30 by the cubit surrounding it all around
And a likeness of oxen was under it all around all around surrounding it 10 cubits encircling the Sea all around two rows of the oxen cast in its cast metal
Standing on 12 oxen three turned to the north and 3 turned to the west and 3 turned to the south and three turned to the east And the Sea was on them above and all their hindquarters to the house
And its thickness was a span and its edge like a work of an edge of a cup a bud of a lily taking hold 3 000 baths it could contain
And he made 10 pots and he placed five on the right and five on the left to wash in them the work of the burnt offering they will rinse in them And the Sea for bathing for the priests in it
And he made the 10 lampstands of gold according to their judgment and he placed in the temple five on the right and five on the left
And he made 10 tables and he gave rest in the temple five on the right and five on the left And he made 100 basins of gold
And he made the courtyard of the priests and the great court and the doors for the court and their doors he overlaid with bronze
And the Sea he placed on the right side to the east facing toward the south
And Huram made the tubs and the shovels and the basins And Huram finished making the work that he made for King Solomon in the house of God
the two pillars and the bowls and the capitals on the head of the two pillars and the two trellises to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the head of the pillars
and the 400 pomegranates for the two trellises two rows of pomegranates for each trellis to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the face of the pillars
And the stands he made and the pots he made on the stands
the one Sea and the 12 oxen under it
And the tubs and the shovels and the forks and all items Huram Abi made for King Solomon for the house of Yahweh of polished bronze
In the vicinity of the Jordan the king cast them in the thick ground between Succoth and between Zeredathah
And Solomon made all these items in great abundance indeed the weight of the bronze was not sought out
And Solomon made all the items that were in the house of God and the altar of gold and the tables and on them the bread of the presence
and the lampstands and their lamps for their burning according to the judgment before the inner sanctuary fine gold
and the buds and the lamps and the tongs of gold it was perfection of gold
And the lamp trimmers and the basins and the spoons and the censers of fine gold And the entrance of the house its inner doors into the Holy of Holies and the doors of the house for the temple gold

5.t: And all the work which Solomon did for the house of Yahweh was completed and Solomon brought in the sacred things of David his father and the silver and the gold and all the items he placed in the treasuries of the house of God

Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes the leaders of the fathers of the sons of Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the Box of the covenant of Yahweh from the city of David that is Zion
And all the men of Israel assembled to the king at the feast it was the seventh month
And all the elders of Israel came and the Levites carried the Box
And they brought up the Box and the tent of meeting and all the sacred items that were in the tent the priests the Levites brought them up
And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel were gathering to him before the Box sacrificing sheep and oxen which was not counted and it was not numbered because of the abundance
And the priests brought in the Box of the covenant of Yahweh to its place to the inner sanctuary of the house to the holy of holies to under the wings of the cherubim
And the cherubim were spreading out wings over the place of the Box And the cherubim covered over the Box and over its poles from above
And the poles lengthened and the heads of the poles from the Box were seen at the front of the inner sanctuary but they were not seen outside And they are there until this day
There was nothing in the Box except the two tablets that Moses had placed at Horeb which Yahweh cut with the sons of Israel in their going out from Egypt
And it happened in the going out of the priests from the holy place that all the priests who were found consecrated themselves there was no keeping to the divisions

And the Levites the singers all of them Asaph Heman Jeduthun and their sons and their brothers clothed in fine linen with cymbals and with harps and lyres were standing to the east of the altar And with them 120 priests sounding with trumpets

And it happened like one were the trumpeters and singers to cause to hear one voice to praise and to give thanks to Yahweh And when raising a voice with trumpets and with cymbals and with the items of the song and when praising Yahweh For good for forever is his covenant faithfulness And the house filled with a cloud the house of Yahweh
And the priests were not able to stand to minister because of the cloud for the glory of Yahweh filled the house of God

6.t: Then Solomon said Yahweh has said he would dwell in thick darkness
but I have built a lofty house for you and a place for you to dwell forever
And the king turned his face and he blessed all the assembly of Israel and all the assembly of Israel was standing
And he said Blessed be Yahweh the God of Israel who spoke with his mouth to David my father and with his hands he fulfilled saying

From the day that I brought out my people from the land of Egypt I did not choose a city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for my name to be there And I did not choose a man to be leader over my people Israel
But I have chosen Jerusalem for my name to be there and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel
And it was with the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh the God of Israel
And Yahweh said to David my father On account of what is with your heart to build a house for my name you did well that it was with your heart
Only you yourself must not build the house instead your son who comes from your loins he himself will build the house for my name

And Yahweh has established his word that he spoke and I have risen instead of David my father and I sit on the throne of Israel just as Yahweh spoke And I have built the house for the name of Yahweh the God of Israel
And I set there the Box in which there is the covenant of Yahweh which he cut with the sons of Israel
And he stood before the altar of Yahweh in front of all the assembly of Israel And he spread out his hands

for Solomon made a platform of bronze and he placed it in the midst of the court five cubits its length and five cubits its width and three cubits its height And he stood on it and he knelt down on his knees in front of all the assembly of Israel and he spread out his hands to the heavens

And he said Yahweh God of Israel there is not like you a god in the heavens or on the earth one who keeps the covenant and covenant faithfulness to your servants walking before you with all their heart
who kept for your servant David my father that which he spoke to him And you spoke with your mouth and by your hand you have fulfilled like this day

And now Yahweh God of Israel keep for your servant David my father that which you spoke to him saying There will not be cut off for you a man from before me sitting on the throne of Israel only if your sons keep their ways to walk in my law just as you walked before me
And now Yahweh God of Israel let your word be confirmed which you spoke to your servant to David
But will God indeed dwell with mankind on the earth Behold the heavens and the heavens of the heavens do not contain you how much less this house that I have built
Yet turn to the prayer of your servant and to his supplication Yahweh my God to listen to the cry and to the prayer that your servant is praying before you
your eyes to be open to this house days and night to the place where you said to put your name there to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place
And listen to the supplications of your servant and your people Israel when they pray toward this place and you yourself hear from the place of your dwelling from the heavens and hear and forgive
If a man sins against his neighbor and is made by him to swear an oath and brings an oath before your altar in this house

then you yourself hear from the heavens and act and judge your servants to bring back the wicked to put his way on his head and to make righteous the righteous to give to him according to his righteousness
And if your people Israel are struck down before an enemy because they have sinned against you and they return and they confess your name and they pray and they seek favor before you in this house
then you yourself hear from the heavens and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the ground that you gave to them and to their fathers
When the heavens are restrained and there is no rain because they have sinned against you and they pray toward this place and they confess your name from their sin they turn for you afflict them

then you yourself hear in the heavens and forgive the sin of your servants and your people Israel for you teach them the good way in which they should walk in it And give rain on your land which you gave to your people for a possession

Famine if there is in the land pestilence if there is blight or mildew locust or grasshopper if there is indeed they suffer distress from their enemies in the land at the gates any plague or any sickness
any prayer any supplication which is by any person or by all your people Israel which they know each his own plague and his own sorrow and he spreads out his hands toward this house

then you yourself hear from the heavens your dwelling place and forgive and give to each according to all his ways because you know his heart for you yourself only you know the heart of the sons of mankind
in order that they may fear you by walking in your ways all the days that they live on the face of the ground that you gave to our fathers

And also to the foreigner who is not from your people Israel and he comes from a distant land because of your great name and your strong hand and your outstretched arm and they come and pray toward this house

and you yourself hear from the heavens from your dwelling place and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you like your people Israel and to know that your name is called toward this house that I have built

When your people go out to battle against their enemies in the way which you send them and they pray to you toward the way of this city that you have chosen it and the house that I have built for your name
then hear from the heavens their prayer and their supplication and do their judgment
When they sin against you for there is no person who does not sin and you are angry with them and give them before an enemy and their captors take them captive to a land distant or near

and they turn back their heart in the land where they are captive there and they turn and they seek favor from you in the land of their captivity saying We have sinned we have committed iniquity and we have done evil

and they turn to you with all their heart and with all their being in the land of their captivity where they took them captive and they pray toward the way of their land which you gave to their fathers and the city that you chose and toward the house that I have built for your name
then hear from the heavens from your dwelling place their prayer and their supplication and do their judgment and forgive your people who sinned against you
Now my God please let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayer of this place
And now arise Yahweh God to your resting place you and the Box of your strength Your priests Yahweh God may they be clothed in salvation and your faithful ones rejoice in goodness
Yahweh God do not turn away the face of your anointed ones Remember the covenant faithfulnesses of David your servant

7.t: And when Solomon finished praying then the fire came down from the heavens and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices and the glory of Yahweh filled the house
And the priests were not able to go into the house of Yahweh because the glory of Yahweh filled the house of Yahweh

And all the sons of Israel were seeing the fire come down and the glory of Yahweh on the house and they bowed down their faces to the ground on the stone pavement and they worshiped and gave thanks to Yahweh Truly he is good truly his covenant faithfulness is forever
And the king and all the people were offering sacrifice before Yahweh
And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of 22 000 oxen and 120 000 sheep And the king and all the people dedicated the house of God

And the priests at their posts were standing and the Levites with instruments of song of Yahweh which David the king had made to give thanks to Yahweh For his covenant faithfulness is forever when David praised by the hand of them And the priests were trumpeting in front of them and all Israel was standing

And Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard which is before the house of Yahweh For he did there the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings because the bronze altar which Solomon made was not able to contain the burnt offerings and the grain offering and the fats
And Solomon did the feast at that time seven days and all Israel with him a very great assembly from Lebo Hamath to the brook of Egypt
And they did on the eighth day an assembly for the dedication of the altar they did seven days and the feast seven days

And on the 23 rd day of the seventh month he sent away the people to their tents joyful and good of heart on account of the goodness which Yahweh did for David and for Solomon and for Israel his people
And Solomon finished the house of Yahweh and the house of the king And all that came into the heart of Solomon to do in the house of Yahweh and in his house he succeeded
And Yahweh appeared to Solomon in the night and he said to him I have heard your prayer and I have chosen this place for myself for a house of sacrifice
If I restrain the heavens and there is no rain or if I command the locust to devour the land or if I send pestilence among my people

and my people whom my name is called over them humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn back from their evil ways then I myself will hear from the heavens and I will forgive their sin and I will heal their land
Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place
And now I have chosen and I have consecrated this house for my name to be there until forever And my eyes and my heart will be there all the days
And you if you walk before me just as David your father walked and do according to all that I have commanded you and my statutes and my judgments you keep
then I will establish the throne of your kingdom just as I cut with David your father saying There will not be cut off from you a man ruling in Israel
But if you all turn yourselves and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I placed before you all and walk and serve other gods and worship them

then I will remove them from upon my ground which I gave to them And this house which I consecrated for my name I will cast out from before my face and I will make it a proverb and a taunt among all the peoples
And this house which was exalted to all who pass by it will be devastated and they will say Why did Yahweh do thus to this land and to this house

And they will say On account of which they forsook Yahweh the God of their fathers who brought them out from the land of Egypt and they laid hold of other gods and worshipped them and served them On account of thus he brought on them all this misery

8.t: And it happened at the end of 20 years in which Solomon built the house of Yahweh and his house
and the cities which Huram gave to Solomon Solomon built them And he caused to dwell there the sons of Israel
And Solomon went to Hamathzobah and he prevailed over it
And he built Tadmor in the wilderness and all the cities of stores which he built in Hamath
And he built Beth Horon the Upper and Beth Horon the Lower fortified cities with walls doors and a bar

and Baalath and all the cities of stores which were to Solomon and all the cities of the chariots and the cities of the horsemen and all the desire of Solomon which he desired to build in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land of his kingdom
All the people who were left from the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites who were not from Israel
from their sons who were left after them in the land whom the sons of Israel had not brought to an end and Solomon brought them up for forced laborers until this day
But from the sons of Israel which Solomon did not make to be laborers for his work rather they were men of battle and chiefs of his officers and chiefs of his chariots and his horsemen
And these the chiefs of supervisors who were to King Solomon 250 ruling over the people

And the daughter of Pharaoh Solomon brought up from the city of David to the house that he built for her for he said My wife must not dwell in the house of David the king of Israel because sacred are the places where the Box of Yahweh has come into them
Then Solomon brought up burnt offerings to Yahweh on the altar of Yahweh that he had built before the porch

And by the matter day by day to bring up according to the commandment of Moses for the Sabbaths and for the new moons and for the appointed times three times in the year at the Feast of Unleavened Bread and at the Feast of Weeks and at the Feast of Booths

And he appointed according to the judgment of David his father the divisions of the priests over their service and the Levites over their charge to praise and to minister in front of the priests for the matter of the day in its day and the gatekeepers in their divisions for gate and gate for thus was the commandment of David the man of God
And they did not turn from the commandment of the king regarding the priests and the Levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasuries
And all the work of Solomon was completed from the day of the foundation of the house of Yahweh and until its completion Complete was the house of Yahweh
Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and to Eloth on the edge of the sea in the land of Edom

And Huram sent to him by the hand of his servants ships and servants who knew the sea And they came with the servants of Solomon to Ophir And they took from there 450 talents of gold and they brought to King Solomon

9.t: And the queen of Sheba heard the report of Solomon and she came to test Solomon with difficult questions in Jerusalem with very great wealth and camels carrying spices and gold in abundance and precious stone And she came to Solomon and spoke with him about all that was in her heart
And Solomon declared to her all her matters and a matter was not concealed from Solomon which he did not declare to her
And the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon and the house that he built

and the food of his table and the seating of his servants and the standing of his ministers and their attire and his cupbearers and their attire and his burnt offering that he brought up to the house of Yahweh and there was not still breath in her
And she said to the king True was the word that I heard in my land concerning your words and concerning your wisdom
But I did not believe their words until when I came and my eyes saw And behold it was not told to me half of the greatness of your wisdom you have added on to the report that I heard
How blessed are your men And how blessed are these servants of yours who are standing before you continually and are hearing your wisdom

Let Yahweh your God be blessed who delighted in you to place you on his throne to be king for Yahweh your God because your God loved Israel to establish them forever And he has placed you over them to be king to do justice and righteousness
And she gave to the king 120 talents of gold and spices in great abundance and precious stone And there was not like that spice which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon
And also the servants of Hiram and the servants of Solomon who brought gold from Ophir brought algum wood and precious stone
And the king made the algum wood into staircases for the house of Yahweh and for the house of the king and lyres and harps for the singers And there was not seen like them before in the land of Judah
And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire which she asked besides that which she brought to the king And she turned and went to her land she and her servants
And the weight of the gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold
besides from the traveling men and the traders who brought in and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land were bringing gold and silver to Solomon
And King Solomon made 200 large shields of beaten gold 600 of beaten gold he brought up for one large shield
And 300 shields of beaten gold 300 gold he brought up for one shield And the king placed them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon
And the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold
And six steps to the throne and a footstool with gold to the throne was fastened And hands from this and from this on the place of the seat and two lions standing beside the hands
And 12 lions were standing there on six steps from this and from this it had not been done thus for any kingdom

And all the vessels of drink of King Solomon were gold and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were refined gold Nothing of silver it was not thought in the days of Solomon for anything
For the ships belonging to the king went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram Once every three years the ships of Tarshish would come carrying gold and silver ivories and apes and baboons
And King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom
And all the kings of the earth were seeking the face of Solomon to hear his wisdom which God placed in his heart
And they were bringing each his gift items of silver and items of gold and garments armor and spices and horses and mules a matter of year by year
And there were to Solomon 4 000 stalls for horses and chariots and 12 000 horsemen and he placed them in chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem
And it happened he was ruling over all the kings from the River and until the land of the Philistines and until the border of Egypt
And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones and the cedars he made as sycamore trees that were in the lowlands in abundance
And they were bringing out horses from Egypt to Solomon and from all the lands

And the remainder of the matters of Solomon the first things and the last things are they not written in the words of Nathan the Prophet and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat
And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel 40 years
And Solomon lied down with his fathers and they buried him in the city of David his father And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place

10.t: And Rehoboam went to Shechem for to Shechem all Israel had come to make him king
And it happened when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard for he was in Egypt where he had fled from the face of King Solomon And Jeroboam returned from Egypt
And they sent and they called to him and Jeroboam and all Israel came And they spoke to Rehoboam saying
Your father hardened our yoke But now lighten the hard service of your father and his heavy yoke which he gave to us and we will serve you
And he said to them Yet three days and return to me And the people went
And King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had been standing before Solomon his father when he was alive saying How do you all advise to bring back an answer to this people
And they spoke to him saying If you are good to this people and are favorable to them and speak to them good words then they will be for you servants all the days
But he abandoned the advice of the elders who had advised him and he consulted the young men who had grown with him standing before him
And he said to them What do you all advise that we may bring back an answer to this people who spoke to me saying Lighten from the yoke that your father gave us

And the young men who had grown with him spoke saying Thus you shall say to the people who spoke to you saying Your father made our yoke heavy but you yourself lighten from on us Thus you shall say to them My little finger is thicker than the loins of my father
So now my father loaded on you all a heavy yoke but I myself will add to your yoke My father rebuked you all with whips but I with scorpions
And Jeroboam came and all the people to Rehoboam on the third day just as the king spoke saying Return to me on the third day
And the king answered them harshly And King Rehoboam abandoned the advice of the elders
And he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men saying I will make heavy your yoke and I myself will add to it My father rebuked you all with whips but I with scorpions

And the king did not listen to the people because it was a turn of affairs from God in order that Yahweh would establish his word that he spoke by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat

And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them and the people answered the king saying What for us is a portion with David And no inheritance with the son of Jesse Each to your tents Israel Now see your house David And all Israel went to his tents
But the sons of Israel dwelling in the cities of Judah and Rehoboam reigned over them

And King Rehoboam sent Hadoram who was over the forced labor but the sons of Israel stoned him with stones and he died And King Rehoboam strengthened himself to go up in the chariot to flee to Jerusalem
And Israel has rebelled against the house of David until this day

11.t: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem and he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin 180 000 chosen who do battle to fight against Israel to bring back the kingdom to Rehoboam
But the word of Yahweh was to Shemaiah the man of God saying
Say to Rehoboam the son of Solomon king of Judah and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin saying

Thus says Yahweh Do not go up and do not fight with your brothers Return each to his house for from with me this thing is And they listened to the words of Yahweh and returned from going against Jeroboam
And Rehoboam dwelled in Jerusalem and he built cities for fortification in Judah
And he built Bethlehem and Etam and Tekoa
and Beth Zur and Soko and Adullam
and Gath and Mareshah and Ziph
and Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah
and Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron which were in Judah and in Benjamin fortified cities
And he strengthened the fortifications And he placed in them leaders and storehouses of food and oil and wine
and in each city by city large shields and spears and he very much strengthened them greatly And to him were Judah and Benjamin
And the priests and the Levites who were in all Israel presented themselves to him from all their territories
For the Levites left their open lands and their property And they went to Judah and to Jerusalem for Jeroboam and his sons rejected them from serving as priests to Yahweh
And he established for himself priests for the high places and for the goats and for the calves which he had made
And after them from all the tribes of Israel the ones giving their heart to seek Yahweh the God of Israel came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh the God of their fathers
