And this will be better to Yahweh than an ox a bull having horns and having hooves
The poor will see they will rejoice seekers of God let your heart live
For Yahweh is hearing the needy and he does not despise his prisoners
Let the heavens and the earth praise him the seas and everything moving in them
For God will save Zion and he will build the cities of Judah that they may dwell there and possess it
And the seed of his servants will inherit it and the ones loving his name will dwell in it

70.t: Hurry God to deliver me Yahweh to my help
Let the ones seeking my life have shame and have confusion let the ones delighting in my harm be turned back and disgraced
Let them turn back on account of their shame the ones saying Aha Aha
Let all of the seekers of you rejoice and be glad in you and let the lovers of your salvation say continually God is great
But I am poor and needy God hurry to me You are my help and my deliverer Yahweh do not delay

71.t: In you Yahweh I take refuge let me not ever have shame
In your righteousness deliver me and rescue me incline your ear to me and save me
Be to me a rock of abode for coming continually you command to save me for you are my rock and my stronghold
My God rescue me from the hand of the wicked from the palm of the one doing wrong and the one being cruel
for you are my hope Lord Yahweh my confidence from my youth
I have supported myself on you from the womb you were taking me from the belly of my mother My praise is about you continually
I have become like a wonder to many but you are my refuge of strength
Let my mouth be filled with your praise all of the day with your splendor
May you not cast me away in the time of old age may you not forsake me when my strength fails
For my enemies have spoken against me and the ones watching my life have consulted together
saying God has forsaken him pursue and seize him for there is none delivering
God may you not be far from me my God hasten to my help
Let them shame and finish the adversaries of my life let them cover with reproach and disgrace the ones seeking my harm
But I I will hope continually and I will add to all of your praise
My mouth will recount your righteousness all of the day your salvation for I do not know the numbers
I will come in the forces of Lord Yahweh I will remember your righteousness yours alone
God you have taught me from my youth and to this I declare your wonderful doings
And also until old age and gray hair God do not forsake me until I declare your arm to a generation your might to everyone who will come
For your righteousness God is to height you who do great things God who is like you
You who have made me see many and evil troubles may you return may you revive me and may you return may you bring me up from the depths of the earth
May you increase my greatness and may you turn around may you comfort me
Also I I will praise you with the instrument of the lute for your faithfulness my God Let me make music to you with the harp Holy One of Israel
My lips will shout joyfully when I make music to you and my soul which you have redeemed
Also my tongue will meditate on your righteousness all of the day for they will shame for they will confound the ones seeking my harm

72.t: Of Solomon God give your judgments to the king and your righteousness to the son of the king
May he judge your people with righteousness and your poor with justice
May the mountains bring peace to the people and the hills in righteousness
May he judge the poor of the people may he save the sons of the needy and may he crush the oppressor
May they fear you with the sun and to the face of the moon generation of generations
May he come down like rain on mown grass like showers a drenching of the earth
May the righteous flourish in his days and abundance of peace until the moon is not
May he rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth
May desert dwellers kneel to his face and may his enemies lick the dust
May the kings of Tarshish and the coastlands return tribute may the kings of Sheba and Seba bring near a gift
And may all kings bow down to him may all nations serve him
For may he deliver the needy crying out and the poor when no helper is to him
May he have pity on the weak and the needy and may he save the lives of the needy
May he redeem their life from oppression and from violence and may their blood be precious in his eyes
May he live And may one give to him from the gold of Sheba and may one pray for him continually may they bless him all of the day
May there be an abundance of grain in the land on the head of the mountains may its fruit sway like Lebanon and may they flourish from the city like the grass of the earth
May his name be forever may his name continue to the face of the sun And may they be blessed by him may all of the nations acclaim him
Blessed be Yahweh God the God of Israel the one doing wonders he alone
And blessed be the name of his glory forever and let all of the earth be filled with his glory Amen and amen
The prayers of David son of Jesse are finished

73.t: A psalm of Asaph Surely God is good to Israel to those with a pure heart
But as for me my feet almost slipped my steps almost were caused to slide out from under me
because I was envious of the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked
For they have no ropes until their death and their belly is fat
They are free from the trouble of man and with the rest of man they are not afflicted
Therefore pride is a necklace for them a garment of violence covers them
Their eyes bulge out from fatness the imaginations of their heart overflow
They mock and speak with evil of oppression they speak from an elevated place
They set their mouth in the heavens and their tongue goes through the earth
Therefore his people turn here and waters of a full cup are drained by them
And they say How does God know And is there knowledge in the Most High
Behold these wicked they are always at ease they increase in wealth
Surely in vain I have kept my heart clean and washed my hands in innocence
For I have been stricken all of the day and punished every morning
If I had said I will recount such things behold I would have betrayed the generation of your children
And when I thought how to understand this it was troublesome in my eyes
until I went into the sanctuaries of God then I discerned their end
Surely you set them in slippery places you make them fall to destruction
How they are brought to desolation as in a moment They come to an end they perish by terrors
Like a dream after one awakes Lord when you rouse yourself you will despise their image
When my heart was embittered and I was pierced in my kidneys
I was stupid and I was not knowing I was an animal with you
Yet I am continuously with you you hold me by my right hand
You guide me with your counsel and afterward you will take me to glory
Whom have I in heaven but you And besides you there is nothing on the earth I desire
My flesh and my heart fail but God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever
For behold those who are far from you will perish you destroy every one being unfaithful to you
But for me the closeness of God for me is good I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge in order to recount all your works

74.t: A maskil Of Asaph Why God have you rejected us forever Why does your nose smoke against the flock of your pasture
Remember your congregation that you acquired in antiquity which you redeemed the tribe of your inheritance this Mount Zion on which you have dwelt
Lift up your feet to the destructions of perpetuity to all the enemy has damaged in the holy place
Your adversaries roared in the midst of your meeting place they set up their signs as signs
It was known like one bringing upward axes in a thicket of trees
And now with hatchet and hammers they have broken down its carvings altogether
They sent your holy place into fire they profaned the dwelling of your name to the ground
They said in their heart Let us oppress them altogether They burned all of the meeting places of God in the land
We do not see our signs there is no longer a prophet and not one with us knowing until when
Until when God will the adversary reproach Will the enemy despise your name forever
Why do you hold back your hand even your right hand From the midst of your bosom finish them
But God is my king from antiquity working salvations in the midst of the earth
You you divided the sea by your strength you broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters
You you crushed the heads of Leviathan you gave him as food to a people to the desert dwellers
You you split open spring and wadi you you dry up perpetual rivers
The day is to you the night is also to you You you established the light and the sun
You you set all of the boundaries of the earth summer and winter you you formed them
Remember this the enemy has reproached Yahweh and a foolish people has despised your name
May you not give the life of your dove to a beast may you not forget the life of your poor forever
Regard the covenant for pastures of violence fill the dark places of the land
May the weak not return ashamed may the poor and the needy praise your name
Arise God Plead your case Remember your reproach from the fool all of the day
Do not forget the voice of your adversaries the uproar of the ones rising against you going up continually

75.t: We give thanks to you God we give thanks and your name is near they recount your wonders
When I take the appointed time I I will judge with equity
The earth and all its inhabitants are melting I I established its pillars Selah
I said to the boasters Do not boast and to the wicked Do not lift up a horn
Do not lift up your horn to the height or speak with an arrogant neck
For not from the east or from the west and not from the wilderness comes lifting up
For God is the judge this one he brings low and this one he lifts up
For a cup is in the hand of Yahweh and the wine foams a full mixture and he pours out from this surely its dregs they will drain all the wicked of the earth will drink
But I I will declare to eternity I will sing praise to the God of Jacob
And all the horns of the wicked I will cut off the horns of the righteous will be lifted up

76.t: In Judah God is known in Israel his name is great
And his abode is in Salem and his dwelling place is in Zion
There he broke the flames of the bow the shield and the sword and the battle Selah
You are shining majestic from the mountains of prey
The stout of heart were plundered they slept their sleep and all of the men of strength found not their hands
At your rebuke O God of Jacob both rider and horse fell deeply asleep
You you are to be feared and who can stand before your face from the time of your nose
From heaven you caused judgment to be heard the earth feared and was quiet
when God arose to judgment to save all the humble of the earth Selah
For the wrath of man will thank you the remainder of wrath you will gird on
Vow and pay to Yahweh your God let all who are around him bring a gift to the Fear
He cuts off the spirit of princes he is to be feared by the kings of the earth

77.t: My voice is to God and I cry out my voice is to God and he listens to me
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord my hand was stretched out at night and it did not slacken My soul refused to be comforted
I remembered God and I groaned I meditated and my spirit grew faint Selah
You held the lids of my eyes I was troubled and I did not speak
I thought about days from antiquity years of long ago
I will remember my song in the night with my heart I will meditate and my spirit searches
Will the Lord reject me forever And will he not again add to show favor
Has his covenant faithfulness ceased forever Has a promise ended for generation and generation
Has God forgotten to be gracious Or has he shut up his compassions in his nose Selah
And I said This is my wounding the changing of the right hand of the Most High
I will remember the deeds of Yah for I will remember your wonder from antiquity
And I will ponder on all your deeds and on your works I will meditate
Your way God is in holiness what god is great like God
You are the God who does wonders you have revealed your strength among the peoples
You have redeemed your people with your arm the sons of Jacob and Joseph Selah
The waters saw you God the waters saw you and they trembled indeed the depths shook
The clouds poured down water the skies gave a sound your arrows also flew about
The sound of your thunder was in the whirlwind the lightning lit up the world the earth trembled and shook
Your way went through the sea and your path through many waters but your footprints were not discerned
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron

78.t: A maskil of Asaph Hear my teaching my people incline your ears to the words of my mouth
I will open my mouth in a parable I will pour out riddles from antiquity
These are things that we have heard and learned things that our fathers have told us
We will not keep them from their descendants We will tell the next generation about the praises of Yahweh his strength and his wonders that he has done
And he established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel which he commanded our fathers to teach them to their children
So that the later generation might know the children yet to be born and they will rise up and tell to their children
And they would place their confidence in God and not forget the deeds of God but keep his commandments
And they would not be like their fathers a stubborn generation and a rebellious generation which did not cause its heart to be steadfast and its spirit was not faithful with God
The sons of Ephraim being armed with shooters of bows they turned back on the day of battle
They did not keep the covenant of God and they refused to walk in his law
And they forgot his deeds and his wonders that he had shown them
He did wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt in the territory of Zoan
He divided the sea and led them across it and he made the waters to stand like a heap
And by day he led them with the cloud and all the night with the light of fire
He split open the rocks in the wilderness and he gave drink abundantly as the deep
He made streams flow out of the rock and made the water flow like rivers
And they added still to sin against him to rebel against the Most High in the dry land
And they tested God in their hearts by asking for food for their appetite
And they spoke against God They said Can God arrange a table in the wilderness
Behold he struck the rock and waters gushed out and streams overflowed Is he able to give bread also Or can he provide meat for his people
Therefore Yahweh heard and was furious and a fire was kindled against Jacob and also his nose went up against Israel
because they did not believe in God and did not trust in his salvation
Yet he commanded the clouds from above and opened the doors of the sky
And he rained down manna to eat on them and gave to them the grain of heaven
Man ate the bread of the mighty He sent to them provision to their satisfaction
He caused the east wind to blow in the sky and by his power he guided the south wind
And he rained down meat on them like dust and birds of wing as the sands of the sea
And he caused them to fall in the middle of his camp around his dwellings
And they ate and were very satisfied And he brought their craving to them
They were not separated from their craving their food was still in their mouth
and the nose of God went up in them and he killed some of their stoutest people and he caused the young men of Israel to bow down
In all this they sinned again and did not believe in his wonders
So he consumed their days in a vapor and their years in terror
When he killed them then they would seek him and they would return and look earnestly for God
And they would remember that God was their rock and that God Most High was their redeemer
And they would deceive him with their mouth and lie to him with their tongues
And their hearts were not steadfast with him and they were not faithful in his covenant
Yet he being merciful atoned for their iniquity and did not destroy them And many times he held back his nose and did not stir up all his wrath
And he remembered that they were flesh a wind going and it does not return
How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness They grieved him in the desert
And they returned and they tested God and grieved the Holy One of Israel
They did not remember his hand the day when he redeemed them from the adversary
when he set his signs in Egypt and his wonders in the field of Zoan
And he turned their rivers to blood and their streams they could not drink
He sent a swarm among them and it devoured them and the frog and it destroyed them
And he gave their produce to the locust and their labor to the swarming locust
He slew their vines with hail and their sycamore trees with frost
And he gave over their cattle to the hail and their livestock to the bolts of lightning
He sent among them the burning of his nose fury and indignation and distress a group of messengers of calamity
He made level a path for his anger he did not spare their soul from death and their life he gave over to the plague
And he struck every firstborn in Egypt the beginning of strength in the tents of Ham
And he made his people journey like sheep and he led them like a flock in the wilderness
And he guided them in security and they did not fear and the sea covered their enemies
And he brought them to the border of his holiness this mountain that his right hand acquired
And he drove out nations from before them and caused them to fall in a portion of inheritance and he caused the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents
But they tested and rebelled against God Most High and they did not keep his testimonies
And they turned back and acted treacherously like their fathers they turned themselves like a bow of deceit
And they provoked him to anger with their high places and with their carved images they moved him to jealousy
God heard and was furious and he rejected Israel greatly
And he abandoned the dwelling of Shiloh the tent in which he had dwelt among mankind
And he gave his strength to captivity and his splendor into the hand of the enemy
And he delivered his people over to the sword and he was furious with his inheritance
Fire consumed his young men and his virgins were not praised in wedding songs
His priests fell by the sword and his widows did not weep
Then the Lord awoke as one sleeping as a mighty man shouting from wine
And he struck his adversaries backward he gave to them a reproach of perpetuity
And he rejected the tent of Joseph and he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim
But he chose the tribe of Judah Mount Zion which he loved
And he built his sanctuary like the heights like the earth he founded it forever
And he chose David his servant and took him from the folds of the flock
From behind the nursing ewes he brought him to shepherd Jacob his people and Israel his inheritance
And he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart and with the skillfulness of his hands he guided them

79.t: A psalm Of Asaph God nations have come into your inheritance they have defiled the temple of your holiness they have made Jerusalem into heaps
They have given the corpse of your servants as food to the bird of the heavens the flesh of your faithful to the beast of the earth
They have poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem and there is no burying
We have become a reproach to our neighbors scorn and derision to the ones around us
Until when Yahweh Will you be angry forever Will your jealousy burn like fire
Pour out your wrath on the nations that have not known you and on the kingdoms that have not called on your name
For one has devoured Jacob and they have desolated his habitation
Do not remember former iniquities against us hasten let your compassions meet us for we have become very weak
Help us God of our salvation on account of the glory of your name and deliver us and cover over our sins for the sake of your name
Why should the nations say Where is their God Let the vengeance of the poured out blood of your servants be known among the nations to our eyes
Let the groaning of the prisoner come to your face according to the greatness of your arm preserve the sons of death
And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you Lord
And we your people and the flock of your pasture will give thanks to you forever to generation and generation we will recount your praise

80.t: Shepherd of Israel give ear the one leading Joseph like a flock Sitter on the cherubim shine forth
To the face of Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh awaken your might and come to us for salvation
God restore us and make your face shine and let us be saved
Yahweh God of armies until when will you smolder against the prayer of your people
You have made them eat bread of tears and you have made them drink tears in triple measure
You have made us strife to our neighbors and our enemies mock among themselves
God of armies restore us and make your face shine and let us be saved
You pulled up a vine from Egypt you drove out nations and planted it
You cleared to the face of it and it rooted its roots and filled the land
The mountains were covered with its shadow and its branches were cedars of God
It sent out its branches to the sea and its shoots to the River
Why have you broken down its walls so that all the ones passing on the way pluck it
The boar from the forest ravages it and the creature of the field grazes on it
God of armies return please Look down from heaven and see and visit this vine
even the stock that your right hand planted and on the son you strengthened for yourself
It is burned with fire it is cut down from the rebuke of your face they perish
Let your hand be on the man of your right hand on the son of man you strengthened for yourself
And we will not turn back from you revive us and we will call on your name
Yahweh God of armies restore us Make your face shine and let us be saved

81.t: Shout joyfully to God our strength shout out to the God of Jacob
Raise a song and put forth the tambourine the pleasant harp with the lyre
Blow a shofar at the new moon at the full moon for the day of our festival
For it is a statute for Israel a judgment of the God of Jacob
He set it as a testimony in Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt where I heard a lip I did not know
I removed his shoulder from the burden his palms passed from the basket
In distress you called and I delivered you I answered you from the secret place of thunder I tested you at the waters of Meribah Selah
Hear my people and let me testify against you Israel if you would listen to me
There shall not be a strange god among you and you shall not bow down to a god of foreignness
I am Yahweh your God the one having brought you up from the land of Egypt Open wide your mouth and I will fill it
But my people did not listen to my voice and Israel did not submit to me
So I sent them away in the stubbornness of their heart they walked in their counsels
If only my people were listening to me if Israel would walk in my ways
As a little thing I would subdue their enemies and I would turn my hand against their adversaries
The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him and their time would be forever
And he would feed him with the fat of the wheat and I would satisfy you with honey from the rock

82.t: A psalm Of Asaph God is standing in the congregation of God in the midst of gods he judges
Until when will you judge with injustice and lift up the faces of the wicked Selah
Judge the poor and the orphan vindicate the poor and the destitute
Rescue the poor and the needy deliver them from the hand of the wicked
They do not know and they do not understand they walk about in darkness All of the foundations of the earth are shaken
I I said You are gods and sons of the Most High all of you
But you will die like man and like one of the princes you will fall
Arise God judge the earth for you you will inherit among all of the nations

83.t: God may silence not be to you do not be still and do not be quiet God
For behold your enemies roar and the ones hating you lift up the head
They are cunning with counsel against your people and they conspire against your treasured ones
They have said Come and let us destroy them from being a nation that the name of Israel may not be remembered anymore
For they have conspired against you heart together they have cut a covenant
the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites Moab and the Hagrites
Gebal and Ammon and Amalek Philistia with the dwellers of Tyre
Also Assyria has joined with them they are an arm to the sons of Lot Selah
Do to them as to Midian as to Sisera as to Jabin at the river of Kishon
They were destroyed at En Dor they became dung for the ground
Make them their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb and like Zebah and like Zalmunna all of their princes
who said Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God
My God make them like tumbleweed like chaff to the face of the wind
As fire burns a forest and as flame kindles mountains
thus pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your whirlwind
Fill their faces with shame that they may seek your name Yahweh
May they have shame and be terrified eternities of eternity and may they have disgrace and may they perish
And may they know that you your name is Yahweh you alone are the Most High over all of the earth

84.t: How amiable are your dwellings Yahweh of Armies
My soul longs and even faints for the courts of Yahweh my heart and my flesh cry out to the living God
Even the sparrow has found a house and the swallow a nest for herself where she may lay her young your altars Yahweh of Armies my king and my God
The happinesses of the dwellers of your house They praise you continually Selah
The happinesses of the man strength to him is in you Highways are in their heart
Passing through in the Valley of Baca they make it a spring the early rain also covers it with blessings
They go from strength to strength each one appears before God in Zion
Yahweh God of armies hear my prayer listen God of Jacob Selah
See our shield God and regard the face of your anointed
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand I choose to stand at the threshold in the house of my God rather than dwell in the tents of wickedness
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield Yahweh gives favor and glory He does not withhold good from the ones walking in blamelessness
Yahweh of Armies the happinesses of the man trusting in you

85.t: You favored your land Yahweh you restored the captivity of Jacob
You bore the iniquity of your people you covered all of their sin Selah
You gathered up all of your wrath you turned back from the burning of your nose
Restore us God of our salvation and break up your vexation with us
Will you be angry with us forever Will you prolong your nose to generation and generation
You will you not return May you revive us that your people may rejoice in you
Make us see your covenant faithfulness Yahweh and give your salvation to us
Let me hear what God Yahweh will speak for he will speak peace to his people and to his faithful ones but let them not return to folly
Surely his salvation is near to his reverent ones for glory to dwell in our land
Covenant faithfulness and truth will meet together righteousness and peace will kiss
Truth will sprout from the earth and righteousness will look down from the heavens
Also Yahweh will give the good and our land will give its produce
Righteousness walks before him and it puts his steps in the way

86.t: A prayer Of David Incline your ear Yahweh answer me for I am poor and needy
Guard my soul for I am faithful You my God save your servant the one trusting in you
Favor me Lord for to you I call all of the day
Gladden the soul of your servant for to you Lord I lift up my soul
For you Lord are good and forgiving and plentiful of covenant faithfulness to all of the ones calling on you
Listen to my prayer Yahweh and attend to the voice of my pleas
In the day of my trouble I call on you for you will answer me
There is none like you among the gods Lord and there is nothing like your works
All of the nations that you have made will come and bow down to your face Lord and they will glorify your name
For you are great and are doing wonderful things you are God you alone
Teach me your way Yahweh that I may walk in your truth Unite my heart to fear your name
I will thank you Lord my God with all of my heart and I will glorify your name forever
For your covenant faithfulness is great toward me and you have delivered my soul from lowest Sheol
God the arrogant arise against me and the congregation of the violent seek my life and they do not set you before them
But you Lord are a merciful and gracious God long of nostrils and plentiful of covenant faithfulness and truth
Turn to me and favor me give your strength to your servant and save the son of your female servant
Work for me a sign for good that the ones hating me may see and have shame for you Yahweh you help me and comfort me

87.t: Of the sons of Korah A psalm A song His foundation is on the mountains of holiness
Yahweh is loving the gates of Zion more than all of the dwellings of Jacob
Glorious things are spoken of you city of God Selah
I will mention Rahab and Babylon to the ones knowing me behold Philistia and Tyre with Cush This one was born there
And of Zion it will be said Man and man was born in her and he he will establish her the Most High
Yahweh will recount in the writing of the peoples This one was born there Selah
And the singers like the pipers All of my springs are in you

88.t: Yahweh God of my salvation by day in the night I cry out before you
Let my prayer come to your face incline your ear to my cry
For my soul is full of troubles and my life has come near to Sheol
I am reckoned with the ones going down into the pit I have become like a man without strength
free among the ones having died like the slain lying in the grave whom you do not remember them anymore and they they are cut off from your hand
You have set me in the pit of the depths in dark places in deep places
Your wrath rests heavily on me and you overwhelm me with all of your waves Selah
You have distanced my acquaintances from me you have made me abominations to them I am shut in and I do not go out
My eye mourns from affliction I call out to you Yahweh in all of the day I spread out my palms to you
Will you do a wonder for the ones having died Or will the Raphaites arise Will they thank you Selah
Will your covenant faithfulness be recounted in the grave your faithfulness in Abaddon
Will your wonder be known in the darkness or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness
But I I cry out to you Yahweh and in the morning my prayer precedes you
Why Yahweh do you reject my soul Why do you hide your face from me
I have been weak and expiring since youth I have borne your terrors I must despair
Your indignations pass over me your terrors destroy me
They surround me like water all of the day they close in upon me together
You have distanced friend and acquaintance from me the ones known to me are darkness

89.t: I will sing the covenant faithfulness of Yahweh forever to generation and generation I will make known your faithfulness with my mouth
For I said Covenant faithfulness will be built up forever the heavens you establish your faithfulness in them
I have cut a covenant with my chosen I have sworn to David my servant
Until forever I will establish your seed and I will build up your throne to generation and generation Selah
And the heavens praise your wonder Yahweh your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones
For who in the sky arrays with Yahweh compares to Yahweh among the sons of God
God is greatly dreaded in the council of the holy ones and feared above all of the ones around him
Yahweh God of Armies who is like you mighty Yah And your faithfulness is your surroundings
You are ruling over the surging of the sea when its waves rise you you still them
You you shattered Rahab like a slain one with the arm of your strength you scattered your enemies
To you are the heavens also to you the earth the world and its fullness you you founded them
The north and the south you you created them Tabor and Hermon shout joyfully in your name
To you is an arm with might your hand is strong your right hand is high
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne covenant faithfulness and truth precede your face
The happinesses of the people knowing the joyful shout Yahweh they walk in the light of your face
In your name they rejoice all of the day and in your righteousness they rise high
for you are the splendor of their strength and by your favor you raise up our horn
For our shield is to Yahweh and our king to the Holy One of Israel
Then you spoke in a vision to your faithful ones and said I have placed help on a warrior I have raised up a chosen one from the people
I have found David my servant I have anointed him with the oil of my holiness
with whom my hand will be established my arm will also strengthen him
The enemy will not exact from him and a son of wickedness will not oppress him
And I will crush his adversaries from his face and I will strike down the ones hating him
And my faithfulness and my covenant faithfulness will be with him and in my name his horn will be high
And I will set his hand on the sea and his right hand on the rivers
He he will call to me You are my Father my God and the rock of my salvation
And I I will make him the firstborn the highest of the kings of the earth
I will keep my covenant faithfulness for him forever and my covenant will be confirmed to him
And I will set up his seed forever and his throne like the days of the heavens
If his sons forsake my law and they do not walk in my judgments
if they profane my statutes and they do not keep my commandments
then I will punish their transgression with a rod and their iniquity with blows
But my covenant faithfulness I will not break off from him and I will not deal falsely in my faithfulness
I will not profane my covenant and I will not change the utterance of my lips
Once I have sworn by my holiness If I should lie to David
His seed will be forever and his throne like the sun before me
It will be established forever like the moon yes the attested witness in the sky Selah
But you you have rejected and spurned you have passed yourself over from your anointed one
You have voided the covenant of your servant you have profaned his crown to the ground
You have broken down all of his walls you have made his fortifications a ruin
All of the passers of the way plunder him he has become a reproach to his neighbors
You have raised up the right hand of his adversaries you have made all of his enemies rejoice
You have also turned back the edge of his sword and you have not made him stand in battle
You have made his splendor cease and you have cast his throne to the ground
You have shortened the days of his youth you have covered him over with shame Selah
Until when Yahweh Will you hide yourself forever Will your wrath burn like fire
Remember me what life is for what emptiness you created all of the sons of man
What man will live and not see death will deliver his soul from the hand of Sheol Selah
Where are your former covenant faithfulnesses Lord which you swore to David in your faithfulness
Remember Lord the reproach of your servants my carrying in my bosom all of many peoples
with which your enemies have taunted Yahweh with which they have taunted the footsteps of your anointed
Blessed be Yahweh forever Amen and amen

90.t: Lord you have been a habitation to us in generation and generation
Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the earth and the world even from forever to forever you are God
You cause man to return to dust and you say Return sons of man
For a thousand years in your eyes are like the day before when it has passed and a watch in the night
You flood them away they are sleep in the morning like grass it passes along
In the morning it sprouts and passes along in the evening it withers and dries up
For by your nose we perish and by your wrath we are terrified
You have set our iniquities before you our hidden sin in the light of your face
For all of our days turn in your wrath we end our years like a sigh
The days of our years in them are 70 years or if by strength 80 years but their expanse is trouble and sorrow for it passes quickly and we fly away
Who knows the power of your nose or your wrath according to your fear
So teach us to number our days that we might bring in a heart of wisdom
Return Yahweh Until when Have compassion on your servants
Satisfy us in the morning with your covenant faithfulness and we will rejoice and be glad in all of our days
Make us glad according to the days you afflicted us the years we have seen trouble
May your work be seen by your servants and your majesty by their sons
May the favor of the Lord our God be upon us And the work of our hands establish for us indeed the work of our hands establish it

91.t: The one dwelling in the shelter of the Most High will remain in the shadow of Shaddai
I will say to Yahweh My refuge and my fortress my God I trust in him
For he will rescue you from the snare of the trapper from the plague of calamities
He will cover you with his feathers and under his wings you will shelter His faithfulness is a shield and rampart
You will not be afraid of the terror of the night of the arrow that flies by day
of the plague that walks in darkness of the destruction that wastes at midday
A thousand may fall at your side and a myriad at your right hand it will not approach toward you
You will only observe with your eyes and see the recompense of the wicked
Because you have made Yahweh my refuge the Most High your dwelling
evil will not happen to you and a plague will not approach your tent
For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all of your ways
They will lift you up in their hands lest you hit your foot against a stone
You will tread on the lion and the adder you will trample the young lion and the serpent
Because he clings to me indeed I will deliver him I will protect him because he knows my name
He will call me and I will answer him I will be with him in trouble I will rescue him and I will honor him
I will satisfy him with length of days and I will show him my salvation

92.t: It is good to give thanks to Yahweh and to sing praises to your name Most High
to proclaim your covenant faithfulness in the morning and your truthfulness in the nights
with a ten string and with a lyre with a melody on a harp
For you Yahweh have made me glad through your deeds I will sing for joy because of the deeds of your hands
How great are your deeds Yahweh Your thoughts are very deep
A brutish person does not know nor does a stupid one understand this
When the wicked sprout like grass and all evildoers thrive they will be destroyed for eternity
But you Yahweh are exalted forever
For behold your enemies Yahweh For behold your enemies they will perish All those who do evil will be scattered
But you have lifted up my horn like a wild ox I am saturated with fresh oil
My eye has looked on my foes those rising up against me those doing evil my ears have heard
The righteous one will flourish like the palm tree he will grow like a cedar in Lebanon
They are planted in the house of Yahweh they flourish in the courts of our God
They bear fruit even when they are old they are juicy and green
to proclaim that Yahweh is just my rock and there is no unrighteousness in him

93.t: Yahweh reigns he wears majesty Yahweh wears he girds himself with strength Indeed the world is firmly established it cannot be moved
Your throne is established from before you are from everlasting
The seas rise Yahweh the seas have lifted up their voice the seas lift up their pounding waves
More than the sounds of many waters than the mighty breakers of the sea Yahweh on high is mighty
Your decrees are very trustworthy holiness adorns your house Yahweh for length of days

94.t: God of vengeance Yahweh God of vengeance shine forth
Rise up judge of the earth return recompense upon the proud
Until when will the wicked Yahweh until when will the wicked rejoice
They pour out they speak arrogance all doers of evil praise themselves
They crush your people Yahweh they afflict your inheritance
They kill the widow and the sojourner and they murder the fatherless
They say Yah does not see the God of Jacob does not perceive
Understand stupid ones among the people O fools when will you have insight
The one planting the ear does he not hear Or the one forming the eye does he not observe
The one instructing nations does he not rebuke Does the one teaching mankind lack knowledge
Yahweh knows the thoughts of mankind that they are vapor
The joys of the man whom you instruct Yah and from your law you teach him
to give rest to him from days of evil until a pit is dug for the wicked
For Yahweh will not forsake his people and he will not abandon his inheritance
For judgment will return to the right and all the upright in heart are after it
Who will rise up for me against the evildoers Who will stand up for me against the workers of wickedness
Unless Yahweh had been a help to me shortly my soul would have dwelt in silence
When I said My foot is slipping Your covenant faithfulness Yahweh supported me
When my cares within me are many your consolations gladden my soul
Can a throne of destruction be your ally one creating injustice by statute
They conspire together against the life of the righteous and they condemn innocent blood
But Yahweh has been to me a high tower and my God the rock of my refuge
He will return on them their iniquity and he will destroy them in their wickedness Yahweh our God will destroy them

95.t: Come let us sing to Yahweh let us shout to the rock of our salvation
Let us meet his face with thanksgiving with psalms let us sing joyfully to him
For Yahweh is a great God and a great king above all gods
who in his hand has the depths of the earth and the heights of the mountains are to him
who to him is the sea and he he made it and his hands formed the dry land
Come let us worship and bow down let us kneel to the face of Yahweh our maker
For he is our God and we are the people of his pasture and the flock of his hand Today if only you would listen to his voice
Do not harden your heart as at Meribah as on the day of Massah in the wilderness
where your fathers tested me tried me though they had seen my deeds
For 40 years I was angry with the generation and said They are a people wandering of heart and they they have not known my ways
Therefore I vowed in my nose if they enter into my rest

96.t: Sing to Yahweh a new song sing to Yahweh all the earth
Sing to Yahweh bless his name announce his salvation from day to day
Recount his glory among the nations his marvelous deeds among all the peoples
For Yahweh is great and is to be praised greatly He is to be feared above all gods
For all the gods of the peoples are idols but Yahweh made the heavens
Splendor and majesty are to his face Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary
Ascribe to Yahweh clans of peoples ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength
Give to Yahweh the glory of his name Bring an offering and come into his courts
Bow down to Yahweh in the splendor of holiness tremble from his face all the earth
Say among the nations Yahweh reigns Indeed the world is established it cannot be shaken He judges the peoples with evenness
Let the heavens be glad and let the earth rejoice let the sea roar and its fullness
Let the fields rejoice and all that is in them Then let all the trees in the forest shout for joy
to the face of Yahweh for he is coming for he is coming to judge the earth He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his faithfulness

97.t: Yahweh reigns let the earth rejoice let the many coastlands be glad
Clouds and darkness surround him Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne
Fire goes to his face and burns his adversaries all around
His lightning lights up the world the earth sees and trembles
The mountains melt like wax from to the face of Yahweh from to the face of the Lord of all the earth
The heavens declare his righteousness and all the peoples see his glory
Let all those serving a carved image have shame those boasting in worthless idols bow down to him all you gods
Zion heard and was glad and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments Yahweh
For you Yahweh are most high above all the earth You are exalted far above all gods
Lovers of Yahweh hate evil The protector of the lives of his faithful from the hand of the wicked he snatches them
Light is sown for the righteous and for the upright of heart gladness
Be glad in Yahweh you righteous and give thanks to the remembrance of his holiness

98.t: A psalm Sing to Yahweh a new song for he has done marvelous things his right hand and the arm of his holiness have brought him salvation
Yahweh has made known his salvation to the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness
He remembers his covenant loyalty and his faithfulness to the house of Israel all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God
Shout to Yahweh all the earth burst into song sing for joy and make music
Make music to Yahweh with the harp with the harp and the voice of a song
With trumpets and the sound of the shofar shout to the face of the King Yahweh
Let the sea roar and its fulness the world and the dwellers in it
Let the rivers clap palm let the mountains rejoice together
to the face of Yahweh who is coming to judge the earth he will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with fairness

99.t: Yahweh reigns let the peoples tremble sitting above the cherubim let the earth quake
Yahweh in Zion is great and he is high above all the peoples
Let them praise your great and fearsome name holy is he
And the strength of the king he loves justice You you have established fairness you you have done justice and righteousness in Jacob
Exalt Yahweh our God and worship at the stool for his feet Holy is he
Moses and Aaron were among his priests and Samuel was among those calling his name They called to Yahweh and he he answered them
In the pillar of cloud he spoke to them They kept his testimonies and the statutes he gave to them
Yahweh our God you you answered them A forgiving God you were to them but avenging concerning their deeds
Exalt Yahweh our God and worship at the hill of his holiness for Yahweh our God is holy

100.t: A psalm of thanksgiving Shout to Yahweh all the earth
Serve Yahweh with gladness come to his face with rejoicing
Know that Yahweh he is God he he made us and not we his people and the sheep of his pasture
Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise Give thanks to him bless his name
For Yahweh is good his covenant faithfulness is to eternity and his truthfulness until generation and generation

101.t: A psalm of David I shall sing of covenant faithfulness and justice to you Yahweh I shall sing praises
I shall study the blameless way When will you come to me I will walk in the integrity of my heart within my house
I will not put a worthless thing before my eyes I hate to do transgressions it will not cling to me
A perverse heart will turn away from me I will not know evil
The one slandering his neighbor in secret him I will destroy The one lofty of eyes and the one wide of heart him I cannot
My eyes are on the faithful ones of the land to sit with me The one walking in the way of integrity he may serve me
A doer of deceit will not remain within my house a speaker of lies will not be established before my eyes
In the mornings I will destroy all the wicked of the land to cut off all workers of evil from the city of Yahweh

102.t: Hear my prayer Yahweh let my cry come unto you
Do not hide your face from me on the day it distresses me Incline your ear to me On the day I call out hurry answer me
For my days expire like smoke and my bones are charred like a fireplace
My heart is struck like grass and withered for I have forgotten to eat my bread
From the voice of my groaning my bone clings to my flesh
I am like an owl of the wilderness I have become like a screech owl in the ruins
I am alert and I have become like a bird alone on a roof
My enemies taunt me all the day those mocking me swear by me
As ashes as bread I eat and I mix my drink with weeping
from the face of your fury and rage for you have lifted me up and thrown me
My days are like a lengthening shadow and I like grass have withered
But you Yahweh sit forever and your remembrance is to generation and generation
You you will arise you will have mercy on Zion for it is the time to favor her for the appointed time has come
For your servants cherish her stones and favor her dust
The nations will fear the name of Yahweh and all the kings of the earth your glory
For Yahweh builds Zion he appears in his glory
He turns to the prayer of the destitute and he does not despise their prayer
This will be written for a future generation and a people being created will praise Yah
that he looked down from the height of his holiness Yahweh from heaven regarded the earth
to hear the groaning of the prisoner to release the sons of execution
To recount the name of Yahweh in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem
when peoples and kingdoms gather together to serve Yahweh
He has broken my strength on the road He has shortened my days
I said My God do not take me away in the middle of my days your years are a generation of generations
Formerly you set the earth and the heavens are the work of your hands
They they will perish but you you will stand and all of them will wear out like a garment like clothing you will pass them off and they will pass away
But you are he and your years will not end
The sons of your servants will abide and their seed will be established to your face

103.t: Of David Bless Yahweh my soul And all of my inward parts the name of his holiness
Bless Yahweh my soul And do not forget all of his benefits
The one pardoning all your sins the one healing all your diseases
The one redeeming your life from the pit the one crowning you with covenant faithfulness and mercy
The one satisfying your ornaments with good your youth renews itself like the eagle
Yahweh doing righteousness and justice for all those being oppressed
He made known his ways to Moses his deeds to the children of Israel
Yahweh is merciful and gracious long of nostrils and abundant in covenant faithfulness
He will not contend to the end and he will not maintain forever
He does not deal with us according to our sins and he does not treat us according to our iniquities
For as the heavens are high above the earth his covenant faithfulness is strong toward those fearing him
As far as the sunrise is from the sunset he has removed our transgressions from us
As a father has compassion on his children Yahweh has compassion on those fearing him
For he he knows our form remembering that we are dust
A man his days are like grass like a flower of the field thus he flourishes
For the wind passes over it and it is no more and its place does not acknowledge it again
But the covenant faithfulness of Yahweh is from everlasting to everlasting on those fearing him and his righteousness is to the children of children
to the ones keeping his covenant and to the ones remembering his precepts to do them
Yahweh has established his throne in the heavens and his kingdom rules over all
Bless Yahweh his angels warriors of strength doers of his word listening to the voice of his word
Bless Yahweh all his hosts ministering to him doing his pleasure
Bless Yahweh all his works in all the places of his reign Bless Yahweh my soul

104.t: Bless Yahweh my soul Yahweh my God you are very great you are clothed with splendor and majesty
wrapping light as the garment spreading out the heavens as the tent curtain
the one setting his upper chambers on the waters the one appointing the clouds his chariot the one walking on the wings of the wind
making the winds his messengers flaming fire his servants
He set the earth upon its foundations it will not be moved forever and ever
You covered it with the deep like a garment the waters stood above the mountains
From your rebuke they fled from your voice of thunder they hurried away
They ascended the mountains they descended the valleys to the place that you had appointed for them
You set a boundary they cannot pass they will not return to cover the earth
The one sending springs into the wadis between the mountains they flow
They give drink to all his animals of the field the wild donkeys break their thirst
Alongside them the birds of the heavens dwell from between the branches they give voice
The one watering the mountains from his upper chambers from the fruit of your works the earth is satisfied
The one making grass grow for the cattle and plants for the work of man to bring forth bread from the earth
And wine he gladdens the heart of man to make the face shine from oil and bread he sustains the heart of man
The trees of Yahweh are satisfied the cedars of Lebanon which he planted
where birds make their nests there the stork the cypress tree her home
the high mountains for the wild goats the cliffs a refuge for the hyraxes
He made the moon for appointed times the sun knows its setting
You set darkness and it is night in it all of his creatures of the forest crawl
the young lions roaring for prey and seeking their food from God
The sun rises they retreat and lie down in their dens
Man goes out to his work and to his labor until evening
How many are your works Yahweh You made all of them with wisdom the earth is full of your creation
There is the sea great and broad of hands creeping things are there and there is no number living things small with great
Ships travel there Leviathan which you formed to play in it
All of them look to you to give their food at its time
You give to them they gather it you open your hand they are satisfied with good
You hide your face they are terrified you take away their breath they expire and return to their dust
You send out your breath they are created and you renew the face of the land
May the glory of Yahweh be forever may Yahweh rejoice in his creation
The one looking at the earth and it shakes he touches the mountains and they smoke
I shall sing to Yahweh in my life I shall sing praise to my God during my existence
May my meditation be sweet to him I I will rejoice in Yahweh
May sinners cease from the earth and the wicked be no more Bless Yahweh my soul Hallelu Yah

105.t: Give thanks to Yahweh call on his name make known his deeds among the peoples
Sing to him make music to him exclaim about all of his marvelous deeds
Boast in the name of his holiness let the heart of the seekers of Yahweh rejoice
Seek Yahweh and his strength search for his face continually
Recall the marvelous things that he has done his miracles and the decrees from his mouth
seed of Abraham his servant sons of Jacob his chosen ones
He is Yahweh our God His decrees are in all the earth
He remembers his covenant forever the word he commanded for a thousand generations
that he cut with Abraham and his oath to Isaac
He confirmed it to Jacob as a statute to Israel an everlasting covenant
saying I will give to you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance
when they were few in number very few and strangers in it
They wandered from nation to nation from a kingdom to other people
He did not allow anyone to oppress them he rebuked kings because of them
Do not touch my anointed ones and do not harm my prophets
He called for a famine on the land he broke all of the staff of bread
He sent a man ahead of them Joseph was sold as a servant
They oppressed his feet in a shackle his neck went into the iron
until the time of his word coming to pass The speaking of Yahweh refined him
The king sent and released him the one ruling the people and liberated him
He appointed him lord of his house and ruler over all of his possessions
to bind his princes according to his soul and he taught his elders wisdom
Then Israel came into Egypt and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham
He made his people very fruitful and he made him stronger than his enemies
He turned their hearts to hate his people to plot against his servants
He sent Moses his servant Aaron whom he had chosen him
They performed among them the matters of his signs and his wonders in the land of Ham
He sent darkness and made it dark and they did not rebel against his words
He turned their water into blood and killed their fish
Their land swarmed with frogs in the rooms of their kings
He spoke and flies came gnats in all their territory
He made their rain hail fire of flames on their land
He struck their vines and their figs he shattered the trees of their territory
He spoke and the locust came and the young locust and there was no number
And they ate all of the vegetation in their land and they ate the fruit of their ground
Then he struck every firstborn in their land the first of all their strength
He brought them out with silver and gold and there was no stumbling among his tribes
Egypt was glad when they departed for the dread of them had fallen upon them
He spread a cloud for a covering and fire to light up the night
He asked and he brought quail and satisfied them with bread from heaven
He split the rock and waters gushed out they went forth in the desert a river
For he remembered the word of his holiness with Abraham his servant
He led his people out with joy his chosen with shouts of triumph
Then he gave to them the lands of the nations and they took possession of the toil of the peoples
so that they might keep his statutes and comply with his laws Hallelu Yah

106.t: Hallelu Yah Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh proclaim all of his praise
The happinesses of the guardians of justice the doers of righteousness at all times
Remember me Yahweh in the favor of your people visit me in your salvation
to look on the good of your chosen to rejoice in the gladness of your nation to boast with your inheritance
We have sinned like our fathers we have done wrong we have done evil
Our fathers did not consider your marvelous deeds in Egypt they did not remember the abundance of your covenant faithfulness and they rebelled at the sea the Sea of Reeds
But he saved them on account of his name to make known his power
He rebuked the Sea of Reeds and it dried up Then he led them through the depths as through a desert
So he saved them from the hand of the hater and he rescued them from the hand of the enemy
Then the waters covered their adversaries one of them was not left
Then they believed his words they sang his praise
But they hurried they forgot his deeds they did not wait for his instructions
And they craved a craving in the wilderness and they tested God in the wasteland
So he gave to them their request but he sent a wasting disease upon their lives
And they became envious of Moses in the camp of Aaron the holy one of Yahweh
The earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered over the congregation of Abiram
Fire blazed up in their congregation a flame burned up the wicked
They made a calf at Horeb and worshiped a cast image
Thus they traded their Glory for the likeness of a bull eating grass
They forgot God their Savior the doer of great deeds in Egypt
wonders in the land of Ham awesome acts at the Sea of Reeds
So he said to annihilate them had not Moses his chosen one stood in the breach to his face to turn away his heat from destroying
Then they despised the delightful land they did not believe his word
but grumbled in their tents they did not listen to the voice of Yahweh
Then he raised his hand to them to make them fall in the desert
and to make their seed fall among the nations and to scatter them among the lands
They joined themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate the sacrifices of the dead
And they angered with their actions and a plague broke out among them
Then Phinehas stood and intervened and the plague was restrained
It was counted to him as righteousness to generation and generation until forever
And they angered at the waters of Meribah and it was bad for Moses on account of them
For they rebelled against his spirit and he spoke rashly with his lips
They did not destroy the peoples which Yahweh had said to them
but they mingled with the nations and learned their ways
and served their idols and they became a snare to them
And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
And they shed innocent blood the blood of their sons and their daughters whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan and the land was desecrated by bloodshed
And they became unclean by their deeds and they prostituted themselves by their actions
So Yahweh s nose burned with his people and he despised his inheritance
And he gave them into the hand of the nations and the haters of them ruled over them
And their enemies oppressed them and they were humbled under their hand
Many times he rescued them but they they were rebellious in their counsel and sank in their sin
Yet he saw in the narrow to them when he was hearing their cry
And he remembered his covenant with them and relented because of the abundance of his covenant faithfulness
He gave them for compassion to the face of all of their captors
Save us Yahweh our God Gather us from the nations to give thanks to the name of your holiness to glory in your praises
May Yahweh the God of Israel be blessed from everlasting and to everlasting and all the people say Amen Hallelu Yah

107.t: Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Let the redeemed of Yahweh say it who he rescued them from the hand of the opponent
And he has gathered them from lands from the sunrise and from the evening from the north and from the sea
They wandered in the desert with wilderness for a road a city for a home they did not find
Hungry and thirsty their soul fainted within them
Then they called out to Yahweh in the distressing to them he rescued them from their distresses
He led them by a direct path to go to a city of dwelling
May they thank Yahweh for his covenant faithfulness and his amazing deeds for the sons of man
For he satisfies the thirsty soul and the hungry soul he fills with good
Sitting in darkness and gloom prisoners of affliction and iron
because they had rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High
he humbled their hearts through hardship they stumbled and there was no helper
Then they cried out to Yahweh in the distressing to them he saved them from their distresses
He brought them out of darkness and gloom and broke apart their bonds
May they thank Yahweh for his covenant faithfulness and his amazing deeds for the sons of man
For he has broken the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron
Foolish from their rebellious way and afflicted from their sins
their soul detested all food and they touched the gates of death
Then they cried out to Yahweh in the distressing to them he saved them from their distresses
He sent his word and healed them and he delivered them from their destruction
May they thank Yahweh for his covenant faithfulness and his amazing deeds for the sons of man
May they sacrifice sacrifices of thanksgiving and recount his deeds with a shout
Going down to the sea in ships doing business on abundant waters
they they saw the deeds of Yahweh and his wonders in the deep
Then he spoke and aroused the wind of a hurricane and raised up his waves
They went up to the sky they went down to the depths Their souls melted in the disaster
They swayed and staggered as intoxicated and all their wisdom became confounded
Then they cried out to Yahweh in the distressing to them and he rescued them from their distresses
He raised the storm to calmness and he quieted the waves
Then they rejoiced because they subsided and he guided them to the harbor of their desire
May they thank Yahweh for his covenant faithfulness and his amazing deeds for the sons of man
May they exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him at the seat of the elders
He turns rivers into a desert and springs of water into thirsty land
fruitful ground into salt land from the wickedness of the dwellers in it
He turns the wilderness into a pool of water and dry land into springs of water
He settles the hungry there and they build a city of dwelling
Then they sow fields and plant vineyards and they produce the fruit of the harvest
He blesses them and they become very many and their cattle do not become few
Then they become few and become low from distress of evil and sorrow
He pours contempt on the leaders and causes them to wander in an empty place of no road
But he raises up the needy from affliction and establishes families like a flock
The upright see and rejoice and all wickedness shuts its mouth
Who is wise Then may he keep these things and may they ponder the covenant faithfulness of Yahweh

108.t: My heart is made steadfast God I will sing and I will make music indeed with my glory
Awaken lyre and harp I will awaken the dawn
I will thank you Yahweh among the peoples I will make music to you among the nations
For your covenant faithfulness is great from above the heavens and your trustworthiness above the clouds
Be exalted God above the heavens and your glory over all the earth
So that your beloved ones may be rescued save with your right hand and answer me
God has spoken in his holiness I shall rejoice I shall divide Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth
To me is Gilead to me is Manasseh and Ephraim is the protection of my head Judah my scepter
Moab is a tub for my washing over Edom I throw my sandal over Philistia I shout triumphantly
Who will bring me into the strong city Who will lead me to Edom
God have you not rejected us And you do not go out with our army God
Give to us help against the enemy and futility is the deliverance of man
With God we will accomplish valor and he he will trample our adversaries

109.t: To the chief musician a psalm of David God of my praise do not be silent
For a wicked mouth and a mouth of deceit open against me they speak a tongue of untruth with me
and words of hatred surround me and they attack me without cause
In return for my love they accuse me but I prayer
They put upon me evil in return for good and hatred in return for my love
Appoint a wicked one over him and may an accuser stand at his right hand
When he is judged may he come out guilty and may his prayer be as sin
May his days be few may another take his position
May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow
And wandering may his children wander and beg and seek from their desolations
May a creditor snare all that is to him may strangers plunder his work
May there not be to him one extending covenant faithfulness and may there not be one pitying his orphans
May his posterity be to cut off may their name be blotted out in the next generation
May the sin of his fathers be remembered to Yahweh and the offense of his mother not be blotted out
May they be before Yahweh continually and may he cut off their remembrance from the earth
because he never remembered to do covenant faithfulness but pursued the humble man and the needy and the dejected in heart to death
And he loved cursing and it came to him and he did not delight in blessing and it was far from him
And he put on cursing as his garment and it entered into his inner being like water and like oil into his bones
May it be to him like the clothing he wears and for the belt he always girds himself with it
This the payment of my accusers from Yahweh and those speaking evil against my soul
But you Yahweh my Lord do with me on account of your name Because your covenant faithfulness is good rescue me
For I am poor and needy and my heart breaks within me
Like a shadow when it lengthens I am made to go I am shaken off like a locust
My knees are weak from fasting and my flesh is gaunt from fatness
And I I am a disgrace to them they see me they shake their head
Help me Yahweh my God save me according to your covenant faithfulness
so that they know that this is your hand you Yahweh you have done it
They they will curse but you you will bless they arise but then become ashamed and your servant will rejoice
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace may they wear their shame like a robe
With my mouth I greatly thank Yahweh and in the midst of many I will praise him
For he stands at the right hand of the needy to save him from the judges of his soul

110.t: Of David a psalm The declaration of Yahweh to my lord the king Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet
Yahweh will stretch out the scepter of your strength from Zion rule in the midst of your enemies
Your people freewill offerings on the day of your strength in the beauty of holiness from the womb of the dawn the dew of your youth is to you
Yahweh has sworn and will not revoke it You are a priest forever after the manner of Melchizedek
The Lord is at your right hand He crushes kings on the day of his nose
He will judge the nations he fills with bodies he crushes the head upon abundant land
He will drink from the stream along the path Therefore he will lift up the head

111.t: Hallelu Yah I will thank Yahweh with the whole heart in the assembly of the upright and congregation
The works of Yahweh are great searched by everyone desirous of them
His work is splendor and majesty and his righteousness stands forever
He makes a remembrance for his wonders Yahweh is gracious and merciful
He gives food to those fearing him He remembers his covenant forever
He showed the power of his works to his people to give to them the inheritance of the nations
The works of his hands are truth and justice all of his precepts are reliable
They are established forever for eternity done in faithfulness and upright
He has sent redemption to his people he ordained his covenant forever holy and awesome is his name
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom good understanding to all those doing them His praise stands forever

112.t: Hallelu Yah The happinesses of the man fearing Yahweh greatly delighting in his commandments
His seed will be powerful on the earth a generation of upright ones will be blessed
Wealth and riches are in his house and his righteousness stands forever
Light shines in the darkness for the upright ones gracious and compassionate and just
a gracious and lending man is good he conducts his affairs with justice
For he will not be moved for forever the righteous will be for an eternal remembrance
He does not fear bad news his heart is sure trusting in Yahweh
His heart is upheld he does not fear until he looks over his adversaries
He scatters he gives to the poor his righteousness stands forever his horn is high with honor
The wicked will see and be angry he will grind his teeth and he will melt away the desire of the wicked will perish

113.t: Hallelu Yah Praise him servants of Yahweh praise the name of Yahweh
Blessed be the name of Yahweh from now and to forever
From the rising of the sun to its setting may the name of Yahweh be praised
Yahweh is high above all nations his glory above the skies
Who is like Yahweh our God the one making high to sit
the one making low to look on the sky and on the earth
raising up the poor from the dust he lifts the needy from the garbage
to seat him with princes with the princes of his people
He causes the barren woman of the house to dwell the joyful mother of children Hallelu Yah

114.t: When Israel went out from Egypt the house of Jacob from a people speaking a foreign language
Judah became his sanctuary Israel his realm
The sea looked and fled the Jordan turned backward
The mountains skipped like rams the hills like sons of the flock
What is to you sea that you flee Jordan you turn backwards
Mountains you skip like rams hills like sons of the flock
Tremble earth from to the face of the Lord from to the face of the God of Jacob
the one turning the rock into a pool of water flint into a spring of water

115.t: Not to us Yahweh not to us but to your name give honor upon your covenant faithfulness upon your trustworthiness
Why should the nations say Where then is their God
And our God is in heaven everything that he desires he does
Their idols are silver and gold the work of the hands of man
A mouth is to them but they do not speak eyes are to them but they do not see
ears are to them but they do not hear a nose is to them but they do not smell
Their hands but they do not feel their feet but they cannot walk they do not murmur in their throats
Their makers are like them everyone who is trusting in them
Israel trust in Yahweh he is their help and their shield
House of Aaron trust in Yahweh he is their help and their shield
Fearers of Yahweh trust in Yahweh he is their help and their shield
Yahweh remembers us he will bless he will bless the house of Israel he will bless the house of Aaron
He will bless those fearing Yahweh the small with the great
May Yahweh add to you to you and to your sons
May you be blessed by Yahweh the maker of heaven and earth
The heavens of heavens are to Yahweh but the earth he has given to the sons of man
The dead do not praise Yah and not any descending to silence
But we we will bless Yah from now and to forever Hallelu Yah

116.t: I love him because Yahweh hears my voice my pleas
because he extends his ear to me and throughout my days I will call out
The cords of death surrounded me and the constrictions of Sheol found me I found anguish and sorrow
Then I called on the name of Yahweh Please Yahweh rescue my life
Yahweh is merciful and righteous and our God is compassionate
Yahweh guards the naive I was low and he saved me
Return to your rest my soul for Yahweh has repaid you
For you rescued my soul from death my eye from weeping my foot from stumbling
I will walk to the face of Yahweh in the lands of the living
I trusted though I spoke I I am very wretched
I I said in my panic All mankind lies
How can I return to Yahweh all of his bestowments to me
I will raise the cup of salvation and call on the name of Yahweh
I will fulfill my vows to Yahweh right in front of all of his people
Precious in the eyes of Yahweh is the death of his faithful
Indeed Yahweh for I am your servant I am your servant the son of your servant woman you have undone my bonds
I will sacrifice to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving and I will call on the name of Yahweh
I will fulfill my vows to Yahweh right in front of all of his people
in the courts of the house of Yahweh in your midst Jerusalem Hallelu Yah

117.t: Praise Yahweh all nations extol him all peoples
For his covenant faithfulness is strong toward us and the trustworthiness of Yahweh is to forever Hallelu Yah

118.t: Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Let Israel indeed say For his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Let the house of Aaron indeed say For his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Let the fearers of Yahweh indeed say For his covenant faithfulness is to forever
From the constriction I called out to Yah Yah answered me with wideness
Yahweh is for me I will not be afraid what can man do to me
Yahweh is for me as my helper and I I will gaze on the haters of me
Better to take shelter in Yahweh than to trust in man
Better to take shelter in Yahweh than to trust in princes
All the nations surrounded me in the name of Yahweh indeed I fended them off
They surrounded me yes they surrounded me in the name of Yahweh indeed I fended them off
They surrounded me like bees they were extinguished like a fire of thorns in the name of Yahweh indeed I fended them off
To push down you pushed me down to fall but Yahweh helped me
Yah is my strength and song and he is to me for salvation
The voice of a shout and salvation is in the tents of the righteous the right hand of Yahweh does valor
The right hand of Yahweh is high the right hand of Yahweh does valor
I will not die but live and I will declare the deeds of Yah
To chastise Yah has chastised me but to death he has not given me
Open to me the gates of righteousness I will enter them I will thank Yah
This is the gate of Yahweh the righteous may enter through it
I will thank you for you answered me and you have become salvation for me
The stone that the builders rejected has become the head of the corner
This is from Yahweh it is marvelous in our eyes
This is the day Yahweh made Let us rejoice and be glad in it
Please Yahweh save please Please Yahweh give success please
Blessed is the one coming in the name of Yahweh we bless you from the house of Yahweh
Yahweh is God and he has given light to us bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar
You are my God and I will thank you my God I will exalt you
Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever

119.t: The happinesses of the blameless of way the ones walking in the teaching of Yahweh
The happinesses of the keepers of his testimonies They seek him with a whole heart
Surely they do not practice injustice they walk in his ways
You you have commanded your precepts to keep diligently
Oh that my paths would be established to keep your statutes
Then I would not have shame when I look to all of your commandments
I will thank you with uprightness of heart when I learn the judgments of your righteousness
I will keep your statutes do not utterly leave me BETH
How can a young man keep his path pure By keeping according to your word
With all of my heart I seek you Do not let me stray from your commandments
I have hidden your word in my heart so that I might not sin against you
Blessed are you Yahweh teach me your statutes
With my lips I have recounted all of the judgments of your mouth
I rejoice in the way of your testimonies as upon all riches
I will meditate on your precepts and I will study your paths
I delight in your statutes I will not forget your word GIMEL
Deal kindly with your servant so that I may live and keep your word
Uncover my eyes so that I may gaze on the marvelous things from your teaching
I am a sojourner in the land do not hide your commandments from me
My soul languishes with longing for your judgments at all times
You rebuke the proud the cursed those wandering from your commandments
Roll from upon me disgrace and humiliation for I have guarded your testimonies
Though rulers sit and discuss against me your servant meditates on your statutes
Indeed your testimonies are my pleasure my men of counsel DALETH
My soul clings to the dust Revive me according to your word
I recounted my ways and you answered me Teach me your statutes
Make me understand the way of your precepts so that I can meditate on your wonders
My soul melts from grief Lift me up by your word
Turn from me the path of deceit and favor me with your teaching
I have chosen the way of faithfulness I agree with your judgments
I cling to your testimonies Yahweh do not let me be shamed
I run in the way of your commandments for you enlarge my heart HE
Teach me Yahweh the way of your statutes and I will keep it to the end
Give me understanding and I will guard your teaching and I will keep it with a whole heart
Guide me in the path of your commandments for I delight in it
Incline my heart toward your testimonies and not toward unrighteous gain
Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things in your ways revive me
Fulfill for your servant your word which is for the fear of you
Turn away my reproach which I dread for your judgments are good
