Behold I long for your precepts In your righteousness revive me WAW
And let your covenant faithfulness come to me Yahweh your salvation according to your word
then I will answer the one reproaching me with a word for I trust in your word
So do not utterly snatch the word of truth from my mouth for I wait for your judgments
Then I will observe your teaching continually forever and ever
And I will walk about in the broad for I seek your precepts
And I will speak of your testimonies before kings and I will not have shame
And I delight in your commandments which I love
And I will lift up my palms to your commandments which I love and I will meditate on your statutes ZAYIN
Remember the word to your servant by which you have given me hope
This is my comfort in my affliction because your promise revives me
The proud utterly scoff at me from your teaching I do not turn aside
I remember your judgments from ancient times Yahweh and I comfort myself
Rage has seized me from the wicked rejecting your teaching
Your statutes are music to me in the house of my sojourning
I remember your name during the night Yahweh and I shall observe your teaching
This is for me that I keep your precepts HETH
Yahweh is my portion I promise to observe your words
I entreat your face with a whole heart be merciful to me according to your word
I examine my ways and turn my feet to your testimonies
I hurry and do not delay to observe your commandments
The cords of the wicked ensnare me I do not forget your teaching
In the middle of the night I rise to praise you because of the judgments of your righteousness
I am a companion to all who fear you and to observers of your precepts
Your covenant faithfulness fills the earth Yahweh teach me your statutes TETH
You do good to your servant Yahweh according to your word
Teach me good discernment and understanding for I trust in your commandments
Before I was afflicted I was going astray but now I observe your word
You are good and you do good Teach me your statutes
The arrogant smear lies on me I with a whole heart I keep your precepts
Their hearts are unfeeling like fat I in your teaching I delight
It is good for me that I have suffered so that I would learn your statutes
The teaching of your mouth is good for me more than thousands of gold and silver YODH
Your hands have made me and established me give me understanding so that I may learn your commandments
May the fearful of you see me and rejoice because I hope in your word
Yahweh I know that your judgments are just and in faithfulness you humble me
Please may your covenant faithfulness be to comfort me according to your word to your servant
May your compassion come to me so that I may live for your teaching is my delight
Let the proud have shame for they have slandered me with a lie I I will meditate on your precepts
May the fearful of you turn to me so that they may know your testimonies
May my heart be blameless in your statutes so that I may not have shame KAPH
My soul faints for your salvation I wait for your word
My eyes faint for your promise saying When will you comfort me
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke I do not forget your statutes
How many are the days of your servant When will you act in pursuing justice for me
The proud have dug pits for me which is not according to your teaching
All of your commandments are truth They pursue me in deceit help me
As a little they have made an end of me in the land but I I have not rejected your precepts
According to your covenant faithfulness keep me alive so that I may observe the testimony of your mouth LAMEDH
Forever Yahweh your word is established in the heavens
Your faithfulness is to generation and generation you have established the earth and it stands
By your judgments they stand today for all things are your servants
If your teaching had not been my delight then I would have perished in my affliction
I will not forget your precepts forever for through them you have preserved me alive
I am yours save me for I seek your precepts
The wicked wait for me to destroy me I pay attention to your testimonies
I have seen an end for all perfection your commandment is very broad MEM
How I love your teaching It is my meditation all the day
Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies for it is with me forever
I have more insight than all my teachers for your testimonies are a meditation to me
I understand more than the elders for I have kept your precepts
I have restrained my feet from every evil path so that I might keep your word
I have not turned aside from your judgments for you you have taught me
How your word is sweet to my palate more than honey to my mouth
From your precepts I gain understanding therefore I hate every path of falsehood NUN
Your word is a lamp to my foot and a light to my path
I have sworn and I will confirm it to keep the judgments of your righteousness
I have been afflicted exceedingly Yahweh revive me according to your word
Please accept the freewill offerings of my mouth Yahweh and teach me your judgments
My soul is in my palm continually but I do not forget your teaching
The wicked have set a snare for me but I have not wandered from your precepts
I have inherited your testimonies forever for they are the joy of my heart
I have inclined my heart to do your statutes to forever the end SAMEKH
The double minded I have hated but your teaching I have loved
My hiding place and my shield are you for your word I wait
Turn aside from me doers of evil and let me keep the commandments of my God
Sustain me according to your word so that I may live and do not make me ashamed of my hope
Support me so that I will be saved and so I may gaze on your statutes continually
You reject all those straying from your statutes for their deceit is falsehood
You cause to cease as dross all the wicked of the earth therefore I love your testimonies
My flesh shudders from dread of you and I fear your judgments AYIN
I have done justice and righteousness do not leave me to those oppressing me
Be surety for your servant for good do not let the arrogant oppress me
My eyes have failed for your salvation and for the word of your righteousness
Deal with your servant according to your covenant faithfulness and teach me your statutes
I am your servant give me understanding so that I can know your testimonies
It is time for Yahweh to act they have broken your law
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold and more than fine gold
Therefore all the precepts of everything I carefully observe every path of falsehood I hate PE
Your testimonies are wonderful therefore my soul has kept them
The doorway of your words gives light giving understanding to the simple
I open wide my mouth and I pant for I long for your commandments
Turn to me and be gracious to me according to the judgment for the ones loving your name
Establish my steps in your word and do not let any iniquity rule over me
Redeem me from the oppression of man that I may keep your precepts
Make your face shine on your servant and teach me your statutes
Streams of water go down from my eyes because they do not keep your law TSADE
Righteous are you Yahweh and upright are your judgments
You have commanded your testimonies in righteousness and faithfulness exceedingly
My zeal consumes me for my adversaries have forgotten your words
Your word is refined exceedingly and your servant loves it
Small am I and despised your precepts I have not forgotten
Your righteousness is righteousness forever and your law is truth
Narrow and distress have found me your commandments are my delight
The righteousness of your testimonies is forever give me understanding so that I may live QOPH
I call out with a whole heart answer me Yahweh I shall keep your statutes
I call out to you save me so that I may keep your testimonies
I preempt the dawn and cry for help for your words I wait
My eyes preempt the night watches to meditate on your word
Hear my voice according to your covenant faithfulness Yahweh according to your judgment revive me
The pursuers of evil purpose have drawn near from your law they are far away
Near are you Yahweh and all your commandments are truth
Long ago I knew from your testimonies that you have founded them forever RESH
See my affliction and rescue me for I have not forgotten your law
Plead my plea and redeem me for your word revive me
Salvation is far from the wicked for they have not sought your statutes
Your compassions are many Yahweh according to your judgments revive me
Many are my pursuers and my adversaries from your testimonies I do not turn aside
I have seen the treacherous and I was disgusted because they have not kept your word
See that I have loved your precepts Yahweh according to your covenant faithfulness revive me
The head of your word is truth and every judgment of your righteousness is forever SHIN
Princes pursue me without cause and my heart trembles from your words
I am rejoicing over your word like one finding great plunder
Falsehood I hate and I abhor your law I love
Seven times in the day I praise you because of the judgments of your righteousness
Great peace is to the ones loving your law and there is no stumbling block for them
I hope for your salvation Yahweh and I do your commandments
My soul keeps your testimonies and I love them exceedingly
I keep your precepts and your testimonies for all my ways are before you TAV
May my cry come near to your face Yahweh according to your word give me understanding
May my plea come to your face according to your word deliver me
May my lips gush out praise for you teach me your statutes
May my tongue sing of your word for all your commandments are righteousness
May your hand be to help me for I have chosen your precepts
I long for your salvation Yahweh and your law is my delight
May my soul live and may it praise you and may your judgments help me
I have strayed like a perishing sheep seek your servant for I have not forgotten your commandments

120.t: A song of ascents To Yahweh in the distress to me I called and he answered me
Yahweh deliver my soul from a lip of falsehood from a tongue of deceit
What will he give to you and what will he add to you O tongue of deceit
Arrows of a warrior sharpened with coals of broom trees
Woe to me for I am sojourning in Meshech I am dwelling with the tents of Kedar
My soul has dwelt much to itself with a hater of peace
I am peace but when I speak they are for war

121.t: A song of ascents I lift up my eyes to the mountains From where does my help come
My help is from with Yahweh maker of heaven and earth
May he not give your foot to the slipping may your keeper not slumber
Behold he will not slumber and he will not sleep the keeper of Israel
Yahweh is your keeper Yahweh is your shade upon your right hand
By day the sun will not strike you and the moon by night
Yahweh will keep you from all evil he will keep your soul
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in from now and to forever

122.t: A song of ascents of David I rejoiced in the ones saying to me Let us go to the house of Yahweh
Our feet are standing in your gates Jerusalem
Jerusalem the one built like a city that is joined to itself together
Where the tribes go up the tribes of Yah a testimony to Israel to give thanks to the name of Yahweh
For there sit thrones for judgment thrones for the house of David
Ask for the peace of Jerusalem may the ones loving you prosper
Let there be peace within your rampart prosperity in your citadels
For the sake of my brothers and my companions let me speak please peace in you
For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God let me seek good for you

123.t: A song of ascents To you I lift up my eyes the one dwelling in the heavens
Behold as the eyes of servants are to the hand of their masters as the eyes of a maidservant are to the hand of her mistress thus our eyes are to Yahweh our God until he is gracious to us
Be gracious to us Yahweh be gracious to us for we are greatly satiated with contempt
Greatly our soul is satiated with it the scorn of the arrogant the contempt of the proud

124.t: A song of ascents of David If not Yahweh who was for us let Israel indeed say
if not Yahweh who was for us when man rose up against us
then they would have swallowed us alive when their nose burned against us
Then the waters would have overflowed us the torrent would have passed over our soul
Then the raging waters would have passed over our soul
Blessed be Yahweh who did not make us prey for their teeth
Our soul is like a bird that escaped from the snare of the trappers the snare was broken and we we escaped
Our help is in the name of Yahweh the maker of heaven and earth

125.t: A song of ascents Those trusting in Yahweh are like Mount Zion it will not be shaken forever it abides
Jerusalem mountains are around her and Yahweh is around his people from now and to forever
For the rod of wickedness will not rest on the lot of the righteous so that the righteous will not stretch out their hands in unrighteousness
Do good Yahweh to the good and to the upright in their hearts
And those twisting their crooked ways Yahweh will make them go with the workers of iniquity Peace be upon Israel

126.t: A song of ascents When Yahweh returned the captivity of Zion we were like ones dreaming
Then our mouth was filled with laughter and our tongue with a shout of joy Then they said among the nations Yahweh has made great to do with these
Yahweh has made great to do with us we are joyful
Return Yahweh our captivity like the streams in the Negev
The ones sowing in tears will reap in a shout of joy
Going he may go and weeping carrying the bag of seed Coming he will come in a shout of joy carrying his sheaves

127.t: A song of ascents of Solomon If Yahweh does not build a house in vain its builders have labored on it If Yahweh does not watch a city in vain the watchman has stayed awake
It is vain for you the ones rising early to get up the ones being late to sit down the ones eating the bread of toils certainly he gives to his beloved one sleep
Behold the inheritance of Yahweh is sons a reward is the fruit of the womb
Like arrows in the hand of a warrior thus are the sons of the youth
The happinesses of the man who has filled his quiver of them They will not have shame when they speak with adversaries in the gate

128.t: A song of ascents The happinesses of everyone fearing Yahweh the one walking in his ways
The labor of your palms when you eat it is your happiness and good for you
Your wife is like a fruitful vine in the recesses of your house Your sons are like shoots of olive trees all around your table
Behold for thus the man fearing Yahweh will be blessed
May Yahweh bless you from Zion that you may look on the good of Jerusalem all of the days of your life
and that you may see sons to your sons Peace be upon Israel

129.t: A song of ascents Abundantly they have afflicted me from my youth Let Israel indeed say
Abundantly they have afflicted me from my youth however they did not prevail against me
Upon my back the plowers plowed they made long their furrows
Yahweh is righteous he has cut the cords of the wicked
Let them have shame and withdraw backward all the haters of Zion
Let them be like grass of the rooftops that before one pulls it out it dries up
that the reaper does not fill his palm with and the one binding sheaves does not fill his bosom
and those passing by do not say The blessing of Yahweh be upon you we bless you in the name of Yahweh

130.t: A song of ascents Out of the depths I cry to you Yahweh
Lord hear my voice let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications
If you Yah would mark sins Lord who could stand
However there is forgiveness with you so that you may be feared
I wait for Yahweh my soul waits and in his word I hope
my soul for the Lord more than watchmen for the morning watchmen for the morning
Israel hope in Yahweh for with Yahweh is covenant faithfulness and with him is abundant redemption
And he he will redeem Israel from all his sins

131.t: A song of ascents of David Yahweh my heart is not high and my eyes are not raised up and I do not walk in great and marvelous things beyond me
Rather I have stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child upon his mother like a weaned child upon me is my soul
Israel hope in Yahweh from now and until forever

132.t: A song of ascents Remember Yahweh for David all of his afflictions
who swore to Yahweh vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob
If I go into the tent of my house if I go up on the bed of my couch
if I give sleep to my eyes slumber to my eyelids
until I find a place for Yahweh dwellings for the Mighty One of Jacob
Behold we heard of it in Ephrathah we found it in the fields of Jaar
Let us go to his dwellings let us bow down at the footstool of his feet
Arise Yahweh to your resting place you and the box of your strength
Let your priests wear righteousness and let your faithful shout for joy
For the sake of David your servant do not turn back the face of your anointed
Yahweh swore to David in truth he will not turn back from it From the fruit of your body I will set one on the throne for you
If your sons keep my covenant and my testimonies that I will teach them then also their sons unto perpetuity will sit on the throne for you
For Yahweh has chosen Zion he desired it for a dwelling for himself
This is my resting place unto perpetuity here I will dwell for I have desired it
Blessing I will bless her provisions her needy I will satisfy with bread
And her priests I will clothe with salvation and her faithful shouting they will shout for joy
There I will make a horn sprout for David I have arranged a lamp for my anointed one
His enemies I will clothe with shame but upon him his crown will flourish

133.t: A song of ascents of David Behold how good and how pleasant is the dwelling of brothers yes together
Like the good oil on the head coming down on the beard the beard of Aaron that is coming down on the mouth of his garments
like the dew of Hermon that is coming down on the mountains of Zion for there Yahweh commanded the blessing life to forever

134.t: A song of the ascents Behold bless Yahweh all servants of Yahweh the ones standing in the house of Yahweh in the nights
Lift up your hands to the holiness and bless Yahweh
May Yahweh bless you from Zion the maker of heaven and earth

135.t: Hallelu Yah Praise the name of Yahweh praise him servants of Yahweh
who are standing in the house of Yahweh in the courts of the house of our God
Hallelu Yah for Yahweh is good make music to his name for it is pleasant
For Yah chose Jacob for himself Israel for his special possession
For I I know that Yahweh is great and our Lord than all gods
Everything that Yahweh desires he does in the heavens and on the earth in the seas and all deeps
bringing up clouds from the end of the earth he makes lightning bolts for the rain bringing out wind from his storehouses
who struck the firstborn of Egypt from man to beast
He sent signs and wonders into your midst Egypt against Pharaoh and against all of his servants
who struck many nations and slew mighty kings
Sihon king of the Amorite and Og king of the Bashan and all the kingdoms of Canaan
And he gave their land as an inheritance an inheritance for Israel his people
Yahweh your name is to forever Yahweh your remembrance is to generation and generation
For Yahweh vindicates his people and he has compassion on his servants
The idols of the nations are silver and gold the work of the hands of man
A mouth is to them but they do not speak eyes are to them but they do not see
Ears are to them but they do not listen indeed there is no breath in their mouths
Their makers are like them everyone who is trusting in them
House of Israel bless Yahweh house of Aaron bless Yahweh
House of the Levite bless Yahweh fearers of Yahweh bless Yahweh
Blessed be Yahweh from Zion the one dwelling in Jerusalem Hallelu Yah

136.t: Give thanks to Yahweh for he is good for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Give thanks to the God of the gods for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Give thanks to the Lord of the lords for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the doer of great wonders him alone for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the maker of the heavens by understanding for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the one spreading out the earth over the waters for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the maker of great lights for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
the sun for dominion in the day for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
the moon and stars for dominion in the night for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the striker of Egypt in their firstborn for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he brought out Israel from their midst for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
By a strong hand and by an outstretched arm for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the parter of the Sea of Reeds into parts for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he made Israel pass through the midst of it for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he tossed Pharaoh and his army into the Sea of Reeds for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the one leading his people in the wilderness for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
To the one striking great kings for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he killed mighty kings for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Sihon king of the Amorite for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
and Og king of the Bashan for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he gave their land as an inheritance for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
an inheritance to Israel his servant for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
who in our humiliation remembered us for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
And he tore us away from our adversaries for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
giving bread to all of flesh for his covenant faithfulness is to forever
Give thanks to the God of the heavens for his covenant faithfulness is to forever

137.t: By the rivers of Babylon there we sat down also we wept when we remembered Zion
On the willows in her midst we hung our harps
For there our captors requested of us words of a song and our tormentors joy Sing for us from a song of Zion
How shall we sing the song of Yahweh on the land of foreignness
If I forget you Jerusalem let my right hand forget
Let my tongue cling to my palate if I do not remember you if I do not cause Jerusalem to go up above the head of my joy
Remember Yahweh for the sons of Edom the day of Jerusalem the ones saying Lay bare lay bare to the foundation in her
Daughter Babylon the devastated one the happinesses of the one who makes complete to you your repayment that you paid to us
The happinesses of the one who seizes and dashes your infants against the rock

138.t: Of David I will thank you with my whole heart before the gods I will make music to you
I will bow down toward the temple of your holiness and I will praise your name for your covenant faithfulness and for your trustworthiness for you have exalted above all of your name your word
On the day that I called and you answered me you emboldened my soul with power
May all the kings of the earth thank you Yahweh because they heard the words from your mouth
May they sing of the ways of Yahweh for great is the glory of Yahweh
Though Yahweh is high yet he sees the lowly and the proud he knows from far off
Though I walk in the middle of trouble you will keep me alive you will stretch out your hand against the nose of my enemies and your right hand will save me
Yahweh will accomplish for my benefit your covenant faithfulness Yahweh is forever Do not forsake the works of your hands

139.t: For the chief musician of David a psalm Yahweh you have searched me and you know me
You you know my sitting down and my rising up you understand my thought from far away
My path and my lying down you have winnowed and you are familiar with all of my ways
For there is not a word on my tongue behold Yahweh you know all of it
Behind and before you have enclosed me and you have set your palm upon me
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me it is high I am not capable of it
Where shall I go from your spirit And where shall I flee from your face
If I ascend to the heavens you are there and I spread out in Sheol behold you
If I lift up the wings of the dawn dwell in the farthest part of the sea
even there your hand will lead me and your right hand will hold me
And I said Surely darkness will crush me and night the light around me
Even darkness does not make it dark to you and the night shines like the day like darkness like light
For you you created my kidneys you knit me together in the womb of my mother
I will thank you because fearsomely I am wonderfully made Wonderful are your works and my soul knows it very well
My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place when I was woven in the depths of the earth
your eyes saw my unformed substance And in your book all of them were written the days were formed and yet not one of them was
And to me how precious are your thoughts God How numerous are their heads
If I should count them they are more than the sand I awake and I am still with you
If only you would kill the wicked God And men of bloodshed depart from me
who speak of you for an evil purpose they lift up your name to emptiness your enemies
Do I not hate the ones hating you Yahweh And do I not loathe the ones rising up against you
With a completeness of hatred I hate them they have become enemies to me
Search me God and know my heart examine me and know my cares
And see if a way of hurtfulness is in me and lead me in the way of eternity

140.t: Rescue me Yahweh from an evil man from a man of violence preserve me
who plot evil things in the heart all the day they travel around to battles
They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent venom of a viper is under their lips Selah
Guard me Yahweh from the hands of the wicked from the man of violence preserve me who have planned to push down my steps
The proud have hidden a snare for me and cords they have spread out a net to the hand of the path traps they have set for me Selah
I have said to Yahweh You are my God Give ear Yahweh to the voice of my supplications
Yahweh Lord the strength of my salvation you have covered my head in the day of weaponry
Do not grant Yahweh the desires of the wicked do not bring forth his plot lest they rise up Selah
The head of the ones surrounding me let the mischief of their lips cover them
Let burning coals fall on them let him cast them into the fire into pits let them not rise up
Let not a man of tongue be established in the land a man of violence let evil hunt him with blows
I know that Yahweh will do the cause of the poor the justice of the needy
Surely the righteous will praise your name the upright will dwell before your face

141.t: A psalm of David Yahweh I cry out to you Hurry to me Give ear to my voice when I cry out to you
May my prayer be established like incense to your face a raising of my palms like the evening sacrifice
Yahweh place a guard over my mouth guard the door of my lips
Do not turn my heart toward an evil thing to wantonly act in activities in wickedness with men doers of evil And may I not dine on their delicacies
Let the righteous hit me covenant faithfulness and he is correcting me Oil for the head may my head not refuse For my prayer is continually against their wickedness
Their judges are thrown down beside a cliff and they hear my words that they are pleasant
Just as splitting and breaking up in the ground our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol
Yet my eyes are on you Yahweh Lord in you I take refuge do not uncover my soul
Keep me from the hands of the snare they have laid for me and the traps of the workers of evil
Let the wicked fall into his nets together I while I cross over

142.t: My voice to Yahweh I cry out my voice to Yahweh I plead for favor
I pour out my lament to his face my distress to his face I declare
When my spirit faints within me then you you know my path Along this path I walk they have hidden a trap for me
Look right and see and there is no one who recognizes me A refuge has become lost from me there is no one caring for my soul
I cried out to you Yahweh I said You are my shelter my portion in the land of the living
Listen to my cry for I am very low rescue me from my pursuers for they are stronger than I
Bring out my soul from prison to praise your name The righteous will gather around me because you will fulfill for me

143.t: A psalm of David Hear my prayer Yahweh listen to my pleas On account of your faithfulness answer me in your righteousness
And do not enter into judgment with your servant for everyone living is not righteous to your face
For the enemy has pursued my soul he has crushed my life to the ground he has made me to live in dark places like the dead of ages
So my spirit faints within me my heart despairs inside me
I remember days from before I meditate on all your works I reflect on the works of your hands
I spread out my hands to you my soul as a thirsty land to you Selah
Hurry Answer me Yahweh my spirit is expiring Do not hide your face from me or I will become equal with those going down to the pit
Let me hear your covenant faithfulness in the morning for I trust in you Make known to me this way I should walk for I lift up my soul to you
Rescue me from my enemies Yahweh I hide in you
Teach me to do your will for you are my God May your good Spirit lead me in a level land
Yahweh for the sake of your name may you preserve my life in your righteousness may you bring my soul out of distress
And in your covenant faithfulness may you destroy my enemies and exterminate all the adversaries of my soul for I am your servant

144.t: Of David Blessed be Yahweh my rock the one teaching my hands for war my fingers for battle
my covenant faithfulness and my fortress my stronghold and the one rescuing me my shield and in whom I take refuge the one subduing my people under me
Yahweh what is man that you know him the son of man that you consider him
Man compares to vapor his days are like a passing shadow
Yahweh bow your heavens and come down touch the mountains that they may smoke
Light lightning and scatter them send your arrows and rout them
Send your hands from above break me free and deliver me from many waters from the hand of sons of a foreigner
who their mouth speaks worthlessness and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood
God I will sing a new song to you with a lyre of ten strings I will make music to you
the one giving salvation to kings the one breaking free David his servant from the evil sword
Break me free and deliver me from the hand of the sons of a foreigner who their mouth speaks worthlessness and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood
that our sons may be like plants having been enlarged in their youth our daughters like corner pillars carved in the pattern of a palace
May our granaries be full furnishing from kind to kind may our flocks be thousanding may they be myriading in our fields
May our oxen be burdened no breach and no going out and no cry in our squares
The happinesses of the people for whom it is thus to it The happinesses of the people for whom Yahweh is its God

145.t: A psalm of David I will exalt you my God the King and I will bless your name forever and ever
I will bless you every day and I will praise your name forever and ever
Yahweh is great and being much praised and there is no searching of his greatness
Generation to generation will proclaim your works and they will declare your mighty acts
On the splendor of the glory of your majesty and on the deeds of your making wonderful let me meditate
And they will tell the strength of your making fearful and let me recount it your greatness
They will pour forth the remembrance of the abundance of your goodness and they will sing joyfully about your righteousness
Yahweh is gracious and compassionate long of nostrils and great of covenant faithfulness
Yahweh is good to all and his compassions are over all of his works
All your works will thank you Yahweh and your faithful will bless you
They will tell the glory of your kingdom and they will speak of your power
to make known to the sons of man his mighty acts and the glory of the splendor of his kingdom
Your kingdom is a kingdom of all of eternities and your dominion is in every generation and generation
Yahweh is supporting all of the ones falling and raising up all of the ones being bowed down
The eyes of all wait for you and you you are giving their food to them in its time
opening your hand and satisfying every living thing with respect to desire
Yahweh is righteous in all of his ways and faithful in all of his works
Yahweh is near to all of the ones calling on him to all who call on him in truth
He does the desire of the ones fearing him and he hears their cry and he saves them
Yahweh is keeping all of the ones loving him but he destroys all of the wicked
My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh and all flesh will bless the name of his holiness forever and ever

146.t: Hallelu Yah Praise Yahweh my soul
Let me praise Yahweh in my life let me make music to my God while I yet am
Do not trust in nobles in the son of man in whom there is no salvation
His breath goes out he returns to his ground on that day his thoughts perish
The happinesses of the one who has the God of Jacob for his help his hope is in Yahweh his God
the one having made the heavens and the earth the sea and all that is in them the one keeping faithfulness forever
doing justice for the oppressed giving bread to the hungry Yahweh is releasing the bound ones
Yahweh is opening the blind Yahweh is raising up the one bowed down Yahweh is loving the righteous
Yahweh is guarding the sojourners he upholds the orphan and the widow but the way of the wicked he overturns
Yahweh reigns forever your God Zion to generation and generation Hallelu Yah

147.t: Hallelu Yah For it is good to make music to our God for praise is pleasant and suitable
Yahweh builds up Jerusalem he gathers the scattered of Israel
healing the broken of heart and binding up their wounds
counting the number of the stars he calls names to all of them
Great is our Lord and abundant of power his understanding is without number
Yahweh is lifting up the poor bringing down the wicked to the ground
Sing to Yahweh with thanksgiving make music to our God with the harp
the one covering the heavens with clouds the one preparing rain for the earth the one making the mountains sprout with grass
He gives its food to the beast to the sons of the raven when they call
He does not delight in the strength of a horse he does not take pleasure in the legs of a man
Yahweh takes pleasure in the ones fearing him the ones hoping for his covenant faithfulness
Extol Yahweh Jerusalem praise your God Zion
For he strengthens the bars of your gates he blesses your sons in your midst
The one putting peace at your borders he satisfies you with the fat of wheat
The one sending his command to the earth his word runs to swiftness
The one making snow like wool he scatters frost like ashes
The one sending his hail like crumbs who can stand to the face of his cold
He sends his word and he makes them melt he makes his wind blow and the waters flow
He declared his word to Jacob his statutes and his judgments to Israel
He has not done this for any other nation and his judgments they do not know them Hallelu Yah

148.t: Hallelu Yah Praise Yahweh from the heavens praise him in the heights
Praise him all of his angels praise him all of his armies
Praise him sun and moon praise him all of the stars of light
Praise him heavens of the heavens and the waters that are above the heavens
Let them praise the name of Yahweh for he he commanded and they were created
And he established them forever and ever he gave a decree and it will not pass away
Praise Yahweh from the earth sea creatures and all depths
fire and hail snow and vapor wind of tempest doing his word
mountains and all hills tree of fruit and all cedars
the living creature and every beast the creeper and the bird of wing
kings of the earth and all peoples princes and all judges of the earth
young men and also young women old men with youths
Let them praise the name of Yahweh for his name alone is exalted his splendor is over the earth and the heavens
And he has raised up a horn for his people praise for all of his faithful for the sons of Israel a people near to him Hallelu Yah

149.t: Hallelu Yah Sing to Yahweh a new song his praise in the assembly of the faithful
Let Israel rejoice in his Maker let the sons of Zion be glad in their king
Let them praise his name in the dance let them make music to him with the tambourine and the harp
For Yahweh is taking pleasure in his people he beautifies the humble with salvation
Let the faithful exult in glory let them sing joyfully on their beds
Let the exaltations of God be in their throat and a sword of mouths in their hand
to execute vengeance on the nations punishments on the peoples
to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron
to execute on them the judgment written It is honor to all of his faithful Hallelu Yah

150.t: Hallelu Yah Praise God in his sanctuary praise him in the expanse of his strength
Praise him for his mighty deeds praise him according to the abundance of his greatness
Praise him with the blast of a shofar praise him with the lyre and the harp
Praise him with the tambourine and the dance praise him with stringed instruments and the flute
Praise him with cymbals of hearing praise him with cymbals of a shout
Let all of the breath praise Yah Hallelu Yah

1.t: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David the king of Israel
To know wisdom and instruction to understand sayings of understanding
to receive instruction of insight righteousness and justice and integrity
to give to naive ones prudence to a young man knowledge and discretion
may a wise one hear and increase learning and an understanding one acquire guidance
to understand a proverb and a parable the words of the wise ones and their riddles
The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge fools despise wisdom and instruction
Hear my son the instruction of your father and do not forsake the law of your mother
for they are a garland of grace for your head and pendants for your neck
My son if sinners entice you do not consent
If they say Come with us Let us lie in wait for blood Let us hide to ambush the innocent one without cause
Let us swallow them the living ones like Sheol and the whole ones like those going down to a pit
We will find all precious wealth We will fill our houses with spoil
You must cause your lot to fall in our midst one purse will be for all of us
My son do not walk on the road with them restrain your foot from their path
for their feet run to evil and they hurry to pour out blood
Surely in vain is the net spread out in the eyes of any owner of wing
but they lie in wait for their blood they hide in ambush for their lives
So are the paths of all who unjustly gain unjust gain it takes the life of its owner
Wisdom calls out outside she gives her voice in the open areas
At the head of the tumultuous places she calls out at the opening of the gates in the city she says her sayings
Until when will naive ones love naiveté and mockers delight in mockery for themselves and stupid ones hate knowledge
Turn to my rebuke Behold I shall allow my spirit to gush forth to you I shall cause you to know my words
Because I have called and you have refused I have stretched out my hand and there was no one listening attentively
and you have ignored all my counsel and my rebuke you did not accept
I too shall laugh at your calamity I shall mock when your dread comes
when your dread comes like a storm and your calamity happens like a whirlwind when distress and anguish come upon you
Then they will call out to me but I will not answer They will diligently seek me but they will not find me
for the reason that they hate knowledge and the fear of Yahweh they did not choose
they did not want my counsel and they despised my every rebuke
And they will eat from the fruit of their way and from their plans they will be satisfied
For the turning away of the naive ones will slay them and false security will lead stupid ones to ruin
But the one who listens to me will dwell securely and will be at ease from the dread of evil

2.t: My son if you receive my sayings and my commandments you store up with you
to cause your ear to be attentive to wisdom you incline your heart to understanding
indeed if for insight you call out for understanding you lift up your voice
if you seek it as silver and as hidden treasures you search for it
then you will understand the fear of Yahweh and the knowledge of God you will find
For Yahweh gives wisdom from his mouth are knowledge and understanding
And he stores up for the upright ones sound wisdom a shield for those walking with integrity
to guard the paths of justice and the way of his faithful ones he will preserve
Then you will understand righteousness and justice and integrity every good track
for wisdom will enter into your heart and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul
Discretion will watch over you understanding will guard you
to rescue you from the way of evil from a man speaking perversions
the ones who forsake the paths of straightness to walk in the ways of darkness
the ones who are glad to do evil they rejoice in perverse things of evil
whose paths are crooked and going astray in their tracks
to rescue you from a strange woman from a foreign woman who makes her sayings smooth
the one who forsakes the companion of her youth and the covenant of her God she has forgotten
For her house sinks down to death and her tracks to the spirits of dead ones
All those who enter her will not return and they will not reach the paths of life
So you shall walk in the way of the good ones and the paths of the righteous ones you shall keep
For the upright will dwell in the land and the blameless will remain in it
but wicked ones will be cut off from the land and treacherous ones will be torn away from it

3.t: My son do not forget my law and my commandments let your heart guard
For length of days and years of life and peace they will add to you
Do not let covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness leave you tie them on your neck write them on the tablet of your heart
and find favor and good insight in the eyes of God and man
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart and on your understanding do not lean
In all your ways acknowledge him and he himself will straighten your paths
Do not be wise in your eyes fear Yahweh and turn away from evil
It will be healing for your navel and refreshment for your bones
Honor Yahweh from your wealth and from the first of all your produce
and your storehouses will be filled with abundance and with new wine your wine vats will burst open
The correction of Yahweh my son do not reject and do not abhor his rebuke
For whom Yahweh loves he disciplines and like a father a son in whom he delights
Happy is a man who finds wisdom and a man who obtains understanding
For better is its profit than the profit of silver and than gold its produce
She is more precious than coral pearls and all your desired things do not compare with her
Length of days is in her right hand in her left hand are riches and honor
Her ways are ways of pleasantness and all her paths are peace
She is a tree of life to the ones who take hold of her and those who grasp her are happy
Yahweh by wisdom founded the earth he established the heavens by understanding
By his knowledge the depths broke open and the clouds dripped dew
My son do not let them depart from your eyes guard prudence and discretion
and they will be life for your soul and grace for your neck
Then you will walk your way to security and your foot will not stumble
If you lie down you will not be in dread You will lie down and your sleep will be pleasant
Do not be afraid of sudden dread and of the devastation of the wicked when it comes
For Yahweh will be your confidence and he will keep your foot from capture
Do not withhold good from its owners when it is in the power of your hand to act
Do not say to your neighbor Go and return and tomorrow I will give it and it is with you
Do not plot evil against your neighbor and he is dwelling securely with you
Do not contend with a man without cause if he has not done you evil
Do not be envious of a man of violence and do not choose any of his ways
For an abomination to Yahweh is he who goes astray but with the upright ones is his secret counsel
The curse of Yahweh is on the house of a wicked one but he blesses the abode of the righteous
Though to the mockers he himself mocks yet to the humble ones he gives favor
Wise ones will inherit honor but stupid ones lift up dishonor

4.t: Hear sons the instruction of a father and listen attentively in order to know understanding
For I give good teaching to you do not forsake my law
When I was a son of my father the tender and only one to the face of my mother
then he taught me and said to me Let your heart grasp my words keep my commandments and live
Acquire wisdom acquire understanding do not forget and do not veer from the sayings of my mouth
Do not forsake her and she will preserve you love her and she will guard you
Wisdom is first Acquire wisdom And with all your acquisition acquire understanding
Cherish her and she will raise you up she will honor you when you embrace her
She will give for your head a garland of grace with a crown of splendor she will cover you
Hear my son and receive my sayings and they will multiply for you the years of life
In the way of wisdom I taught you I caused you to tread in the tracks of uprightness
In your walking your step will not be restricted and if you run you will not stumble
Grasp on to instruction do not let go guard it for it is your life
On the path of wicked ones do not go and do not advance on the way of evil ones
Avoid it do not pass through it veer from it and pass on
For they do not sleep if they do not do evil and their sleep is robbed if they do not cause stumbling
For they eat the bread of wickedness and the wine of violent acts they drink
But the path of the righteous ones is like the light of brightness going and shining until the day is established
The way of the wicked is like the darkness they do not know on what they stumble
My son listen attentively to my words incline your ear to my sayings
Do not let them depart from your eyes keep them in the midst of your heart
For they are life to those who find them and healing to all of his flesh
Guard your heart more than all that is protected for from it are the sources of life
Remove from you perversity of mouth and the deviousness of lips put far away from you
Cause your eyes to gaze to the front and cause your eyelids to be straight in front of you
Make level the track of your foot and all your ways will be firm
Do not veer right or left cause your foot to turn away from evil

5.t: My son listen attentively to my wisdom incline your ear to my understanding
in order to keep discretion and your lips may guard knowledge
For the lips of a strange woman drip fresh honey and smoother than oil is her palate
but her aftermath is bitter as wormwood sharp as a sword of mouths
Her feet are going down to death her steps take hold of Sheol
lest she observe the path of life she does not know her tracks are unstable
And now sons listen to me and do not turn away from the sayings of my mouth
Keep your way far from her and do not come near to the opening of her house
lest you give to others your splendor and your years to a cruel one
lest strangers be satisfied with your strength and your toils in the house of a foreigner
and you groan at your end when your flesh and your body are finished
And you will say How I hated correction and my heart despised rebuke
And I did not listen to the voice of my teachers and to my instructors I did not incline my ear
I am as a little in all evil in the midst of the assembly and the congregation
Drink water from your cistern and flowing waters from the midst of your well
Should your springs overflow outside channels of water in the open areas
Let them be for you for you alone and not for strangers with you
May your fountain be blessed and be glad because of the wife of your youth
A doe of loves and a mountain goat of grace may her breasts drench you on every occasion may you continually stagger in her love
And why would you stagger my son with a strange woman or embrace the bosom of a foreign woman
For in front of the eyes of Yahweh are the ways of a man and all of his paths he observes
His iniquities capture him the wicked one and by the cords of his sin he is grasped
He will die because there is no correction and in the abundance of his folly he staggers

6.t: My son if you pledge for your neighbor you clasp your palms for a stranger
you are ensnared by the sayings of your mouth you are caught by the sayings of your mouth
then do this my son and rescue yourself Since you have come into the palm of your neighbor go humble yourself and press your neighbor
Do not give sleep to your eyes and slumber to your eyelids
Rescue yourself like a gazelle from a hand and like a bird from the hand of the trapper
Go to the ant lazy one See its ways and be wise
which without a commander officer or ruler for it
prepares its bread in the summer it gathers its food in the harvest
Until when lazy one will you lie down When will you rise from your sleep
A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to lie down
and your poverty will come like one who walks and your need like a man of shield
A man of worthlessness a man of iniquity is one who walks with perversity of mouth
one who winks with his eye one who rubs with his foot one who points with his fingers
Perverse things are in his heart plotting evil on every occasion he sends forth quarrels
Therefore his calamity will come instantly suddenly he will be broken and without healing
Six are they that Yahweh hates and seven are abominations to his self
uplifted eyes a tongue of falsehood and hands pouring out innocent blood
a heart devising plans of iniquity feet hurrying to run to evil
a witness of falsehood breathing out lies and sending forth quarrels between brothers
Guard my son the commandment of your father and do not forsake the law of your mother
Bind them on your heart continually tie them around your neck
When you walk about it will guide you when you lie down it will preserve you then you will wake up it itself will converse with you
For commandment is a lamp and law is a light and the rebukes of instruction are the way of life
to keep you from a woman of evil from the smoothness of the tongue of a foreign woman
Do not desire her beauty in your heart and do not let her take you with her eyelashes
For the price of a prostitute woman is as a loaf of bread but the wife of a man hunts a precious life
Could a man carry a fire on his chest and his clothes not be burned
If a man walks on coals then will his feet not be scorched
So is the one going to the wife of his neighbor Every one who touches her will not remain blameless
They do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his appetite when he is hungry
but if he is found he must repay sevenfold all the wealth of his house he must give
One who commits adultery with a woman is lacking of heart destroying his life he does it
He will find a wound and disgrace and his shame will not be wiped out
For jealousy is the heat of a man and he will not spare in the day of vengeance
He will not lift up the face of any ransom and he will not be willing if you increase the bribe

7.t: My son keep my sayings and store up my commandments with you
Keep my commandments and live and my law as the pupil of your eyes
Tie them on your fingers write them on the tablet of your heart
Say to Wisdom You are my sister and call to Understanding Kinsman
in order to keep you from the strange woman from the foreign woman who makes her sayings smooth
For at the window of my house through the window lattice I looked down
And I saw among the naive ones I discerned among the sons a young man lacking of heart
passing through the lane beside her corner and he steps in the way of her house
in the twilight breeze in the evening of day in the pupil of the night and darkness
And behold there is a woman to meet him with the garment of a prostitute and guarded of heart
She is a loud and rebellious one her feet do not stay in her house
At one time in the street at another time in the open areas and beside every corner she lies in wait
And she grabs him and kisses him she strengthens her face and says to him
The sacrifices of peace offerings are with me today I paid my vows
Therefore I came out to meet you to diligently seek your face and I found you
I have spread my couch with coverings colored linen of Egypt
I have sprinkled my bed with myrrh aloes and cinnamon
Come let us drink fully of lovemaking until the morning let us delight ourselves with loves
For the man is not in his house he went on a road far away
He took the bag of silver in his hand on the day of the full moon he will enter his house
She leads him astray with the abundance of her instruction with the smoothness of her lips she compels him
Following after her suddenly like an ox to slaughter he goes and like an ankle chain to the correction of a fool
until an arrow splits his liver like a bird rushing into a trap and he did not know that it was for his life
And now sons listen to me and be attentive to the sayings of my mouth
Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways do not wander into her tracks
For she has caused many pierced ones to fall and numerous are all her slain ones
Her house is the ways of Sheol descending to the rooms of death

8.t: Does not Wisdom call out and Understanding give her voice
At the head of the heights beside the road the house of the paths she stations herself
At the hand of the gates at the mouth of the city the entrance of the openings she cries out
To you men I call and my voice is to the sons of man
Understand prudence naive ones and stupid ones understand heart
Listen for noble things I will speak and the opening of my lips will be upright things
For my palate will utter truth and wickedness is an abomination to my lips
All the words of my mouth are in righteousness there is nothing twisted or crooked in them
All of them are straightforward things for the understanding one and upright things for finders of knowledge
Take my instruction and not silver and knowledge rather than choice gold
For wisdom is better than coral pearls and all desired things do not compare with her
I Wisdom I dwell with Prudence and knowledge of discretion I find
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil Pride and arrogance and the evil way and the mouth of perverse things I hate
Counsel and sound wisdom are mine I am understanding strength is mine
By me kings reign and dignitaries decree righteousness
By me princes rule and nobles all judges of righteousness
I myself love those who love me and those who diligently seek me will find me
Riches and honor are with me lasting wealth and righteousness
My fruit is better than gold and than refined gold and my produce than choice silver
I walk in the path of righteousness in the midst of the pathways of justice
to cause those who love me to inherit substance and their treasuries I will fill
Yahweh possessed me at the beginning of his way before his works from then
From eternity I was poured out from the head from the ancient times of the earth
When there were no watery depths I was brought forth when there were no springs heavy with water
Before the mountains were sunk to the face of the hills I was brought forth
before he made the earth or the outside places or the head of the loose soil of the world
When he established the heavens I was there when he inscribed a circle over the face of the watery deep
when he made firm the clouds above when the springs of the watery deep became strong
when he set up for the sea its statute so waters do not cross over his mouth when he inscribed the foundations of the earth
Then I was beside him as a skilled worker and I was a delight day by day frolicking before his face at every time
Frolicking in the world of his earth and my delights were with the sons of man
And now sons listen to me and happy are they who keep my ways
Hear instruction and be wise and do not neglect it
Happy is the man listening to me keeping vigil over my doors day by day keeping watch over the doorposts of my entrances
For a finder of me is a finder of life and he obtains favor from Yahweh
But a misser of me does violence to his life all haters of me love death

9.t: Wisdom has built her house she has hewn out her seven pillars
She has slaughtered her slaughter she has mixed her wine also she has arranged her table
She has sent out her young women she calls out on the tops of the heights of the city
Whoever is naive let him turn aside here she says to him lacking of heart
Come eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed
Forsake naive things and live and stride on the way of understanding
The instructor of a mocker receives disgrace for himself and the rebuker of a wicked one his injury
Do not rebuke a mocker lest he hate you rebuke a wise one and he will love you
Give to a wise one and he will become more wise inform a righteous one and he will increase learning
The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Yahweh and knowledge of holy things is understanding
Indeed by me your days will increase and years of life will be added to you
If you are wise you are wise for yourself and if you mock you alone will bear it
The woman of stupidity is loud naive and she does not know anything
And she sits at the opening of her house on a seat by the heights of the city
to call to those who pass over the way the ones going straight on their paths
Whoever is naive let him turn aside here And she says to him the lacking of heart
Stolen waters are sweet and bread of secrecies is pleasant
But he does not know that the spirits of the dead are there in the depths of Sheol are her called ones

10.t: The proverbs of Solomon A wise son gladdens a father but a stupid son is the grief of his mother
Treasures of wickedness do not profit but righteousness delivers from death
Yahweh does not let the life of the righteous starve but the desire of the wicked he thrusts away
A palm of idleness makes poverty but the hand of the diligent ones makes rich
One who gathers in the summer is a son who has insight but one who sleeps in the harvest is a son who acts shamefully
Blessings are for the head of the righteous but the mouth of the wicked covers violence
The memory of the righteous one is for a blessing but the name of the wicked ones will rot
The one wise of heart receives commands but the one stupid of lips will be thrown down
One who walks with integrity will walk securely but one who causes his ways to be crooked will be known
One who winks an eye gives pain and the one foolish of lips will be thrown down
A fountain of life is the mouth of the righteous one but the mouth of the wicked ones covers violence
Hatred stirs up quarrels but love covers over all transgressions
On the lips of the discerning one wisdom is found but a rod is for the back of the one lacking of heart
Wise ones store up knowledge but the mouth of a fool is near ruin
The wealth of the rich one is the city of his strength the ruin of lowly ones is their poverty
The wage of a righteous one is to life the income of a wicked one is to sin
On a path to life is one who keeps instruction but one who forsakes rebuke goes astray
One who covers hate has lips of falsehood and one who causes an evil report to go forth he is a stupid one
With a multitude of words transgression does not cease but one who restrains his lips is insightful
Choice silver is the tongue of the righteous one the heart of the wicked ones is like little
The lips of the righteous one shepherd many but fools die by lack of heart
The blessing of Yahweh it causes riches and striving does not add more with it
Like laughter for a stupid one is doing a wicked plan but wisdom for a man of understanding
The terror of the wicked one it will come to him but the desire of the righteous ones will be given
When a whirlwind passes over then there is no more wicked but a righteous one is a foundation of eternity
Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes so is the lazy one to one who sends him
The fear of Yahweh will add days but the years of the wicked ones will be short
The hope of the righteous ones is joy but the expectation of the wicked ones will perish
A stronghold for the one with integrity is the way of Yahweh but ruin for doers of iniquity
A righteous one will not falter to eternity but wicked ones will not dwell in the land
The mouth of the righteous one bears the fruit of wisdom but the tongue of the perverse ones will be cut off
The lips of the righteous one know favor but the mouth of the wicked ones perverse things

11.t: Scales of deceit are an abomination to Yahweh but a whole stone is his delight
When presumptuousness comes then disgrace comes but with modest ones is wisdom
The integrity of the upright ones will guide them but the crookedness of the treacherous ones will destroy them
Wealth will not profit in the day of rage but righteousness will deliver from death
The righteousness of a blameless one will make his way straight but by his wickedness a wicked one will fall
The righteousness of the upright will deliver them but by the desire of treacherous ones they will be captured
At the death of a wicked man expectation will perish and the hope of strength perishes
A righteous one is drawn away from distress and a wicked one enters instead of him
With a mouth a godless one destroys his neighbor but with knowledge the righteous will be delivered
In the good of the righteous a city exults and when the wicked perish a shout of joy
With the blessing of the upright a city is raised up but with the mouth of the wicked it is torn down
One despising his neighbor is lacking of heart but a man of understandings will keep quiet
One going about with gossip uncovers a secret but one faithful of spirit covers a matter
When there are no directions a people falls but salvation is in an abundance of counsel
One will be harmed with harm if he pledges for a stranger but one hating hand clasps is secure
A woman of grace will grasp honor but the ruthless will grasp riches
A man of covenant faithfulness repays his soul but a cruel one troubles his flesh
A wicked one makes a wage of falsehood but one sowing righteousness a wage of truth
True righteousness is to life but one who pursues evil is to his death
An abomination to Yahweh is the crooked of heart but his delight is the blameless of way
Hand to hand a wicked one will not remain blameless but the seed of the righteous will safely escape
A ring of gold in the nose of a pig is a beautiful woman turning away from discretion
The desire of the righteous is only good the expectation of the wicked is rage
There is a scatterer yet being added to more and one withholding more than what is right yet to poverty
A life of blessing will be fattened and the one who drenches he also will be drenched
One withholding grain people will curse him but a blessing is for the head of the seller
One diligently seeking good seeks favor but one searching for evil it will come to him
One trusting in his riches he himself will fall but like a leaf the righteous will sprout
One troubling his house will inherit wind and a fool will be a slave to the wise of heart
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life and one taking souls is wise
Behold a righteous one in the land will be repaid how much more a wicked one and a sinner

12.t: The lover of correction loves knowledge but the hater of rebuke is stupid
A good one obtains favor from Yahweh but a man of schemes he will condemn
A man will not be established by wickedness but the root of the righteous will not be shaken
A wife of worth is the crown of her husband but she who causes shame is like rottenness in his bones
The plans of the righteous are justice the directions of the wicked are deceit
The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood but the mouth of the upright will deliver them
The wicked are overthrown and they are naught but the house of the righteous will stand
For the mouth of his insight a man will be praised but one twisted of heart will be for contempt
Better is being disregarded and having a servant than honoring oneself and lacking bread
A righteous one knows the life of his animal but the compassion of the wicked is cruel
Bread will satisfy one who works his ground but one who pursues empty things is lacking of heart
A wicked one desires the snare of the evil but the root of the righteous will give
In the transgression of lips is the snare of an evil one but a righteous one will go out from distress
From the fruit of the mouth of a man will he be satisfied with good and the accomplishment of the hands of a man will return to him
The way of a fool is right in his eyes but a wise one listens to counsel
A fool his anger is known on the day but a prudent one covers dishonor
He who breathes out faithfulness tells righteousness but a witness of falsehoods deceit
There is one speaking thoughtlessly like the thrusts of a sword but the tongue of the wise ones healing
A lip of truth will be established to perpetuity but a tongue of falsehood as long as I would blink
Deceit is in the heart of devisers of evil but joy is for advisers of peace
Any iniquity will not be allowed to happen to the righteous but the wicked are full of evil
An abomination to Yahweh are lips of falsehood but doers of faithfulness are his delight
A prudent man covers knowledge but the heart of the stupid calls out folly
The hand of the diligent will rule but an idle one will become a forced laborer
Concern in the heart of a man weighs it down but a good word gladdens it
A righteous one searches out from his neighbor but the way of the wicked leads them astray
A negligent one will not roast his game but the wealth of a man is precious for a diligent one
In the path of righteousness is life and the way of the beaten path is no death

13.t: A wise son the instruction of a father but a mocking one does not listen to rebuke
From the fruit of the mouth of a man he eats good but the appetite of the treacherous ones violence
One guarding his mouth keeps his life one opening his lips ruin for him
A lazy one his appetite is craving and there is nothing but the appetite of the diligent will be fattened
A righteous one hates a word of falsehood but a wicked one causes a stink and causes embarrassment
Righteousness guards the blameless of way but wickedness leads a sinful one astray
There is one pretending to be rich but there is nothing at all one pretending to be poor but much wealth
The ransom of the life of a man is his riches but a poor one does not hear a rebuke
The light of the righteous will be glad but the lamp of the wicked goes out
With presumptuousness comes only contention but with those who are counseled wisdom
Wealth from emptiness will dwindle but one gathering by hand will increase
Hope deferred makes a heart sick but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life
One despising a word it will go badly for him but one fearing a command that one will be rewarded
The law of the wise is a fountain of life to turn away from the snares of death
Good insight gives favor but the way of treacherous ones is permanent
Every prudent one acts with knowledge but a stupid person displays folly
A wicked messenger falls into evil but an envoy of faithfulness causes healing
Poverty and shame are for one avoiding correction but one keeping a rebuke will be honored
A desire that occurs will be pleasing to the self but the abomination of the stupid is turning away from evil
One walking with wise ones will become wise but one associating with stupid ones will be harmed
Evil will pursue the sinful but goodness will reward the righteous
The good will cause sons of sons to inherit but the wealth of a sinner is stored up for the righteous
Much food is in the unplowed field of poor ones but there is food being swept away by no justice
One who withholds his rod hates his son but one who loves him diligently seeks him with discipline
A righteous one eating to the satisfaction of his appetite but the stomach of the wicked will lack

14.t: The wisest of women builds her house but a foolish woman tears it down with her hands
The one walking in his uprightness fears Yahweh but the one crooked in his ways despises him
In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride but the lips of the wise ones will preserve them
Where there are no cattle is a trough of cleanness but an abundance of produce is by the strength of an ox
A witness of faithfulness will not lie but a witness of falsehood breathes out lies
A mocker seeks wisdom and there is none but knowledge is easy for the understanding one
Go before a man of stupidity and you will not know lips of knowledge
The wisdom of a prudent one is to understand his way but the folly of the stupid is deceit
The foolish mock the guilt offering but among the upright is favor
A heart knows the bitterness of itself and in its joy a stranger will not share
The house of the wicked will be destroyed but the tent of the upright will flourish
There is a straight road to the face of a man but its end is the ways of death
Even in laughter a heart may ache and the end of joy may be grief
A backsliding heart will be filled from his ways but a good man from his deeds
A naive one believes every word but a prudent one considers his step
A wise one fears and turns away from trouble but a stupid one interferes and is confident
One short of nostrils does folly and a man of schemes is hated
Simpletons inherit folly but the prudent will wear a crown of knowledge
The evil will bow down to the face of the good and the wicked at the gates of the righteous one
One who is poor is hated even by his neighbor but those who love the rich are many
The one despising his neighbor sins but the one who shows favor to the lowly happy is he
Do not devisers of evil go astray But covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness are devisers of good
With all toil is profit but the word of lips is only for lack
The crown of the wise ones is their riches the folly of stupid ones is folly
A witness of truth rescues lives but a fraud breathes out lies
In the fear of Yahweh is strong confidence and for his sons he will be a refuge
The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life to turn away from the snares of death
With the abundance of people is the majesty of a king but with the end of the population comes the ruin of the ruler
One long of nostrils is abundant in understanding but one short of spirit lifts up folly
A heart of healing is life to bodies but envy is the decay of bones
An oppressor of a lowly one taunts his maker but one showing favor to a needy one honors him
By his evil the wicked one is thrust down but the righteous one finds refuge in his death
In the heart of the understanding one rests wisdom and in the midst of the stupid she will be known
Righteousness raises a nation but sin is shame for peoples
The delight of a king is for the servant who has insight but his rage is for one who acts shamefully

15.t: A gentle answer turns back heat but a word of pain lifts up a nose
The tongue of the wise makes knowledge good but the mouth of the stupid gushes forth folly
The eyes of Yahweh are in every place watching the evil and the good
A healing tongue is a tree of life but crookedness in it is a breaking in the spirit
A fool despises the correction of his father but one who keeps rebuke is prudent
The house of the righteous has much treasure but in the harvest of the wicked is being troubled
The lips of the wise scatter knowledge but the heart of the stupid is not so
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh but the prayer of the upright is his delight
An abomination to Yahweh is the way of the wicked but a pursuer of righteousness he loves
Severe discipline is for one who forsakes the path one who hates rebuke will die
Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh how much more the hearts of the sons of man
A mocker does not love one who rebukes him to the wise he will not go
A joyful heart makes a face glad but by pain of heart a spirit is stricken
The heart of the understanding one seeks knowledge but the mouth of the stupid feeds on folly
All the days of the afflicted are evil but the good of heart has a feast continually
Better is a little with the fear of Yahweh than much treasure and anxiety with it
Better is a portion of vegetables and love there than a fattened ox and hatred with it
A man of heat stirs up a quarrel but one long of nostrils will quiet a dispute
The way of the lazy is like a hedge of briar but the path of the upright is a built up highway
A wise son gladdens a father but a stupid man despises his mother
Folly is a joy to the lacking of heart but the man of understanding makes to go straight
Plans are broken with no counsel but with a multitude of advisers it will stand
Joy is for the man in the answer of his mouth and how good is a word in its time
The path of life is upward for the insightful one in order to turn away from Sheol below
Yahweh will tear down the house of the proud but he will set up the boundary of the widow
Evil thoughts are an abomination to Yahweh but words of pleasantness are pure ones
One who unjustly gains unjust gain troubles his house but one who hates bribes will live
The heart of the righteous considers how to answer but the mouth of the wicked gushes forth evils
Yahweh is far from the wicked but the prayer of the righteous he hears
The luminary of the eyes gladdens the heart good news fattens the bone
An ear hearing the rebuke of life will lodge in the midst of the wise ones
One who avoids correction rejects his life but one who hears rebuke acquires heart
The fear of Yahweh is instruction of wisdom and to the face of honor is humility

16.t: The arrangements of the heart are a man s but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh
All the ways of a man are pure in his eyes but Yahweh examines spirits
Roll to Yahweh your works and your plans will be established
Yahweh has made all for its purpose and even a wicked one for the day of evil
An abomination to Yahweh is each one high of heart hand to hand he will not remain blameless
By covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness iniquity is atoned for and by the fear of Yahweh one turns away from evil
When Yahweh is pleased with the ways of a man he causes even his enemies to be at peace with him
Better is a little with righteousness than an abundance of produce with no justice
The heart of a man plans his way but Yahweh establishes his step
Divination is on the lips of a king in judgment his mouth must not act unfaithfully
A scale with the two balances of justice belong to Yahweh all the stones of the bag are his work
An abomination of kings is doing wickedness for by righteousness is a throne established
The delight of kings is lips of righteousness and he loves one who speaks upright things
The heat of a king is messengers of death but a wise man will atone for it
In the light of the face of the king is life and his favor is like a cloud of spring rain
How much better it is to acquire wisdom than gold and to acquire understanding is to be chosen more than silver
The highway of the upright ones turns away from evil one who protects his life guards his way
To the face of a breaking is pride and to the face of a stumbling is a height of spirit
Better to be lowly of spirit with afflicted ones than to share a portion of spoil with proud ones
One who comprehends concerning a matter will find good and one who trusts in Yahweh he is happy
The wise of heart will be called an understanding one and the sweetness of lips increases learning
A fountain of life is the insight of its owner but the instruction of fools is folly
The heart of the wise makes his mouth insightful and on his lips it increases learning
Words of pleasantness are a honeycomb of honey sweet to the soul and healing to the bone
There is a straight road to the face of a man but its end is the ways of death
The appetite of the laborer labors for him for his mouth presses on him
A man of worthlessness digs up evil and on his lips it is like a scorching fire
A man of perverse things lets loose strife and a murmurer separates the friendly
A man of violence entices his neighbor and he leads him on a road that is not good
One who shuts his eyes plans perverse things one who compresses his lips brings evil to completion
Gray hair is a crown of splendor on the road of righteousness it is found
Better is one long of nostrils than a mighty one and one ruling his spirit than one capturing a city
Into the lap a lot is cast but its every judgment is from Yahweh

17.t: Better is a dry morsel and ease with it than a house full of sacrifices of quarreling
An insightful servant will rule over a shameful son and in the midst of brothers he will share an inheritance
The smelting pot is for the silver and the furnace is for the gold and Yahweh tests hearts
The evildoer listens attentively to the lips of iniquity a liar gives ear to a tongue of destruction
A mocker of one who is poor taunts his maker one glad at calamity will not remain blameless
The crown of the old is sons of sons and the splendor of sons is their fathers
A lip of excess is not suitable for a worthless one how much less a lip of falsehood for a noble
A stone of favor is a bribe in the eyes of its owner he succeeds to all that he turns
One who covers a transgression seeks love but one who repeats a matter separates a close friend
A rebuke goes down into an understanding one more than striking a stupid one a hundred times
An evil one seeks only rebellion and a cruel messenger will be sent against him
Let a female bear robbed of offspring meet a man and not a stupid one in his folly
One who returns evil for good evil will not depart from his house
The beginning of a quarrel is the releasing of water so leave the dispute before it breaks out
One who declares a wicked one righteous and one who declares a righteous one wicked even the two of them are an abomination to Yahweh
Why is this A payment is in the hand of a stupid one to acquire wisdom but there is no heart
At every time the friend loves and a brother is born for distress
A man lacking of heart is one who clasps a palm pledging a pledge to the face of his neighbor
One who loves transgression loves contention one who makes his opening high seeks a breaking
One crooked of heart will not find goodness and one who is turned away in his tongue will fall into evil
One who begets a stupid one it is for grief for him and the father of a worthless one will not rejoice
A joyful heart makes healing good but a broken spirit dries up bone
A wicked one takes a bribe from the bosom to bend the paths of justice
Wisdom is with the face of an understanding one but the eyes of a stupid one are at the end of the earth
A stupid son is a grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him
Actually to fine the righteous is not good to strike nobles is against uprightness
One restraining his words is one knowing knowledge and the cool of spirit is a man of understanding
Even a fool keeping silent will be considered wise one shutting his lips understanding

18.t: One who separates himself seeks for desire against all sound wisdom he breaks out
A stupid one does not delight in understanding but rather in his heart revealing itself
