When a wicked one comes contempt also comes and with shame reproach
The words of the mouth of a man are deep waters a fountain of wisdom is a gushing stream
It is not good to lift the face of the wicked to turn aside the righteous in the judgment
The lips of a stupid one enter into a dispute and his mouth calls for blows
The mouth of a stupid one is ruin for him and his lips are a snare of his life
The words of a murmurer are like things swallowed greedily and they themselves go down into the rooms of the belly
Also one who slacks in his work he is a brother to an owner of destruction
The name of Yahweh is a tower of strength the righteous one runs into it and is set on high
The wealth of the rich one is the city of his strength and like a wall set on high in his imagination
To the face of breaking the heart of a man is exalted but to the face of honor humility
One who returns a word before he listens it is folly to him and shame
The spirit of a man will endure his illness but a crushed spirit who can lift it
The heart of an understanding one acquires knowledge and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge
The gift of a man will make room for him and before the face of great ones it will guide him
The first one with his case is right then his neighbor comes and examines him
The lot causes quarrels to cease and between mighty ones it makes a separation
A brother offended is more than a city of strength and quarrels are like the gate bar of a fortress
From the fruit of the mouth of a man his belly is satisfied with the produce of his lips he is satisfied
Death and life are in the hand of the tongue and those who love it will eat its fruit
He who finds a wife finds good and he obtains favor from Yahweh
One who is poor speaks pleas but a rich one answers harshly
A man of companions is to be broken but there is one who loves clinging more than a brother

19.t: Better is one who is poor who walks in his integrity than one who is crooked in his lips and he is a stupid one
Also zeal with no knowledge is not good and one who hurries with feet misses the way
The folly of a man will lead astray his way and his heart will rage against Yahweh
Wealth adds many companions but a lowly one is separated from his companions
A witness of falsehoods will not be blameless and he who breathes out lies will not escape
Many will entreat the face of a noble and everyone is the friend of a man of gift
All the brothers of one who is poor hate him how much more do his friends go far away from him He pursues with words they are not
The one acquiring heart is loving his life the one keeping understanding is to find good fortune
A witness of falsehoods will not be blameless and one who breathes out lies will perish
Luxury is not suitable for a stupid one how much less for a slave to rule over princes
The insight of a man makes his nose long and his splendor is to pass over a transgression
The rage of a king is a growling like the young lion but his favor is like dew on vegetation
A stupid son is destruction to his father and a continual dripping the quarrels of a wife
A house and wealth are the inheritance of fathers but from Yahweh is a wife who has insight
Laziness causes deep sleep to fall and a life of idleness is hungry
One who keeps a commandment keeps his life one who despises his ways will die
One who is gracious to a lowly one lends to Yahweh and his dealing he will repay to him
Discipline your son when there is hope and do not lift up your soul to put him to death
One great of heat lifts up a fine for if you rescue then you will continue to do so again
Listen to counsel and accept instruction so that you will become wise in your afterwards
Many are the plans in the heart of a man but the counsel of Yahweh it will stand
The desire of a man is his covenant faithfulness and better is one who is poor than a man of lying
The fear of Yahweh is to life and the satisfied one will stay overnight he will not be visited by evil
A lazy one hides his hand in the dish he will not even return it to his mouth
You strike a mocker and a naive one will become prudent and rebuke an understanding one he will understand knowledge
One who does violence to a father who causes a mother to flee is a son who causes shame and causes embarrassment
My son cease to hear instruction to stray from the words of knowledge
A witness of worthlessness mocks justice and the mouth of the wicked ones swallows iniquity
Judgments are prepared for the mockers and blows for the back of stupid ones

20.t: The wine is a mocker beer is a brawler and everyone who staggers by it is not wise
The terror of a king is a growling like the young lion one who infuriates him is one who wrongs his life
Honor for a man is cessation from strife but every fool breaks out
A lazy one will not plow from winter and he begs in the harvest but there is nothing
Counsel in the heart of a man is deep waters but a man of understanding will draw it out
Many a man proclaims each man his covenant faithfulness but a man of faithful acts who can find
A righteous one walks about in his integrity happy are his sons after him
A king who sits on the throne of judgment is one who winnows all evil with his eyes
Who can say I have made my heart pure I am clean from my sin
Stone and stone ephah and ephah are an abomination to Yahweh both the two of them
Even a young man will make himself known by his deeds if pure and if upright is his behavior
A hearing ear and a seeing eye Yahweh made both the two of them
Do not love sleep lest you become impoverished Open your eyes be satisfied with bread
Bad Bad says the buyer but when he departs on his way then he praises himself
There is gold and an abundance of corals but lips of knowledge are a vessel of preciousness
Take his garment when he has pledged for a stranger and on behalf of a foreign woman hold it in pledge
Sweet to a man is bread of falsehood but afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel
Plans by counsel are established and by guidance make war
One who goes about as a gossip reveals a secret and with one who opens his lips do not associate yourself
One who curses his father and his mother his lamp will be extinguished in the pupil of darkness
An inheritance gained quickly in the beginning its end will not be blessed
Do not say I will repay evil Wait for Yahweh and he will save you
Stone and stone are an abomination to Yahweh and scales of deceit are not good
From Yahweh are the steps of a strong man so how can a man understand his way
A snare of a man He says rashly It is holy and after vows considers
A wise king is one who winnows the wicked and he brings back a wheel over them
The breath of a man is the lamp of Yahweh searching all the rooms of the belly
Covenant faithfulness and trustworthiness guard a king and his throne is sustained by covenant faithfulness
The splendor of young men is their strength and the adornment of old ones is gray hair
Blows of a wound cleanse away evil and strikes the rooms of the belly

21.t: The heart of a king is channels of water in the hand of Yahweh he steers it according to all that he desires
Every way of a man is right in his eyes but Yahweh examines hearts
To do righteousness and justice is preferred to Yahweh more than a sacrifice
Height of eyes and broadness of heart the lamp of wicked ones are sin
The plans of the diligent one surely are to profit but everyone hurrying about surely is to lack
The making of treasures by a tongue of falsehood is scattered vapor seekers of death
The violence of the wicked will drag them away for they refuse to do justice
Perverse is the way of a guilty man but the pure one upright is his behavior
Better to dwell on the corner of a roof than with a woman of quarrels and a house of companionship
The soul of the wicked one craves evil his neighbor is not shown grace in his eyes
When fining a mocker a naive one becomes wise and when giving insight to a wise one he receives knowledge
A righteous one evaluates the house of a wicked one overturning the wicked to evil
One who shuts his ears from the outcry of a lowly one he also will cry out but will not be answered
A gift in secrecy subdues nose and a bribe in the bosom strong heat
A joy for the righteous is doing justice but a terror for doers of iniquity
A man wandering from the way of understanding will rest in the assembly of the spirits of the dead
A man of lack loves joy a lover of wine and oil will not become rich
A ransom for the righteous one is a wicked one and instead of the upright one who acts treacherously
Better to dwell in a land of wilderness than with a woman of quarrels and vexation
Desirable treasure and oil are in the home of a wise one but a stupid man swallows it up
A pursuer of righteousness and covenant faithfulness will find life righteousness and honor
A wise one ascends a city of mighty ones and he brings down the strength of its confidence
One who keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his life from distress
A presumptuous haughty one Mocker is his name acting with the rage of presumption
The desire of the lazy one causes him to die for his hands refuse to act
All the day he desires desire for himself but a righteous one gives and does not withhold
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination how much more when he brings it with a wicked plan
A witness of lies will perish but a listening man will speak to perpetuity
A wicked man strengthens his face but an upright one he considers his ways
There is no wisdom and there is no understanding and there is no counsel in front of Yahweh
A horse is made ready for the day of battle but the salvation is of Yahweh

22.t: A name is to be chosen more than abundant riches favor is better than silver and than gold
A rich one and a poor one meet together Yahweh is maker of all of them
A prudent one sees evil and hides himself but the naive pass on and they are fined
The result of humility the fear of Yahweh is riches and honor and life
Thorns traps are in the way of the crooked one guarding his life will stay far away from them
Train up the boy upon the mouth of his way even when he is old he will not turn away from it
A rich one rules over those who are poor and a borrower is a slave to a man who lends
A sower of iniquity will reap disaster and the rod of his rage will come to an end
The one good of eye he will be blessed for he gives from his bread to the lowly one
Drive out a mocker and strife will go out and judgment and dishonor will cease
One who loves a pure heart his lips are gracious the king is his friend
The eyes of Yahweh guard knowledge but he overturns the words of a treacherous one
A lazy one says A lion is outside I will be killed in the midst of the open areas
The mouth of a strange woman is a deep pit one who is cursed of Yahweh will fall there
Folly is bound up in the heart of a boy the rod of discipline will cause it to be far away from him
One oppressing a lowly one to increase for him one giving to the rich surely will be to lack
Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise ones and you must set your heart to my knowledge
For it will be pleasant if you keep them in your inner parts they are ready together on your lips
For your trust to be in Yahweh I have caused you to know today even you
Have I not written for you 30 things with counsels and knowledge
to cause you to know the truth of the words of trustworthiness to return trustworthy words to one who sent you
Do not rob a lowly one because he is a lowly one and do not crush an afflicted one at the gate
For Yahweh will plead their dispute and he will plunder of life those who plunder them
Do not befriend an owner of nose and do not go with a man of heat
lest you learn his paths and you take a snare for your life
Do not be among those who clasp a palm among those who pledge for loans
If there is nothing to you to make payment why should he take away your bed from under you
Do not move the ancient boundary that your fathers made
You see a skilled man in his work He will station himself before the face of kings he will not station himself before the face of obscure ones

23.t: When you sit to eat with a ruler consider carefully what is before your face
and you should put a knife at your throat if you are an owner of appetite
Do not desire his delicious morsels for it is bread of lies
Do not weary yourself to gain riches from your understanding cease
Will you cause your eyes to fly to it but it is not there For making it will make wings for itself like an eagle it will fly into the sky
Do not eat the bread of one evil of eye and do not desire his delicious morsels
For like one who calculates in his soul so he is Eat and drink he will say to you but his heart is not with you
You will vomit up your morsel you ate and you will ruin your pleasant words
Do not speak in the ears of a stupid one for he will show contempt for the insight of your words
Do not move an ancient boundary and do not enter into the fields of fatherless ones
for their redeemer is strong he himself will plead their dispute against you
Bring your heart to correction and your ear to words of knowledge
Do not withhold discipline from a boy when you strike him with the rod he will not die
You with the rod you will strike him and you will rescue his life from Sheol
My son if your heart is wise my heart even myself will be glad
and my inner parts will exult when your lips speak upright things
Do not let your heart be envious of sinners but rather in the fear of Yahweh all the day
Surely there is a future and your hope will not be cut off
Listen you my son and be wise and lead your heart in the way
Do not be among drinkers of much wine among gluttonous eaters of flesh for themselves
For one who drinks much and one who eats gluttonously will become poor and slumber will clothe with rags
Listen to your father this one begot you and do not despise your mother when she is old
Acquire truth and do not sell wisdom and instruction and understanding
The father of a righteous one rejoicing will rejoice and one who begets a wise one he will be glad in him
May your father and your mother be glad and may she who bore you rejoice
My son give your heart to me and may your eyes watch my ways
For a prostitute is a deep pit and a foreign woman is a narrow well
Surely she herself lies in wait like a robber and she adds to the treacherous ones among man
For whom is woe For whom is sorrow For whom are quarrels For whom is a lament For whom are wounds without reason For whom is dullness of eyes
For those who linger over wine for those coming to search out mixed wine
Do not look at wine when it is red when its eye gives in the cup it goes with evenness
Its end bites like a snake and it stings like a viper
Your eyes will see strange things and your heart will speak perverse things
And you will be like one who lies down in the heart of the sea and like one who lies down at the head of a mast
They struck me I was not hurt They beat me I did not know When will I awake I will add I will seek it again

24.t: Do not be envious of men of evil and do not desire to be with them
For their heart plots violence and their lips speak trouble
By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established
And by knowledge the rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant wealth
A man of wisdom is with strength and a man of knowledge strengthens power
For by guidance you make war for yourself and salvation is in an abundance of counsel
Wise things are too high for a fool at the gate he will not open his mouth
One who plans to do evil they will call him an owner of schemes
A scheme of folly is sin and a mocker is an abomination to man
If you make yourself slack in the day of distress your strength is narrow
Rescue those being taken for the death and those staggering to the slaughter if you hold back
If you say Behold we did not know this does not he the examiner of hearts understand and he the guard of your life know and he give back to a man according to his work
My son eat honey because it is good and the fresh honey is sweet on your palate
Know wisdom is thus for your soul if you find it then there will be a future and your hope will not be cut off
Do not lie in wait like a wicked one against the abode of the righteous do not assault his resting place
For seven times a righteous one falls and rises up but the wicked stumble into calamity
When your enemy falls do not be glad and when he stumbles do not let your heart rejoice
lest Yahweh see and it be evil in his eyes and he turn away his nose from upon him
Do not make yourself hot because of evildoers do not envy wicked ones
For a future is not for an evil one the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished
My son fear Yahweh and the king do not associate with ones who change
For suddenly their calamity will arise and who is knowing the destruction of the two of them
These also are of the wise ones Recognizing faces in judgment is not good
One saying to a wicked one You are righteous peoples will curse him nations will denounce him
But for the rebukers it will be pleasant and over them will come a blessing of goodness
He kisses lips who returns straightforward words
Prepare your work in the outdoors and make it ready for yourself in the field and after you will build your house
Do not be a witness without cause against your neighbor And would you deceive with your lips
Do not say Just as he did to me so I will do to him I will return to the man according to his deed
I passed over the field of a lazy man and over the vineyard of a man lacking of heart
And behold all of it went up with thorns its face was covered with weeds and the wall of its stones was torn down
And I myself looked I set my heart I saw I received instruction
A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to lie down
and your poverty will come like one who walks around and your needs like a man of shield

25.t: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied
The glory of God is to hide a matter but the glory of kings is to search out a matter
Heavens for height and earth for depth and the heart of kings is not searchable
Remove dross from silver and a vessel comes out for the refiner
Remove a wicked one to the face of the king and his throne will be established by righteousness
Do not honor yourself to the face of the king and in the place of the great ones do not stand
For better to say to you Come up here than to humiliate you to the face of a noble whom your eyes have seen
Do not go out hastily to dispute or else what will you do in its end when your neighbor humiliates you
Dispute your dispute with your neighbor and the secret of another do not uncover
lest one who hears shame you and the rumor of you not turn back
Apples of gold in sculptures of silver is a word spoken according to its circumstance
A ring of gold and jewelry of fine gold is a wise rebuke to a listening ear
Like the coolness of snow in the day of harvest is a faithful envoy for his senders and he brings back the life of his masters
Clouds and wind but without rain is the man who boasts in a gift of falsehood
By length of nostrils a commander may be persuaded and a soft tongue can break a bone
If you find honey eat enough for you lest you become satiated with it and you vomit it up
Make rare your foot from the house of your neighbor lest he become satiated with you and hate you
A hammer and a sword and a sharp arrow is a man who answers a testimony of falsehood against his neighbor
A broken tooth and a shaky foot is confidence in one who acts treacherously in the day of distress
One removing a garment on a cold day vinegar on natron so is a singer with songs to a heart of misery
If one who hates you is hungry cause him to eat bread and if thirsty cause him to drink water
for you are heaping embers on his head and Yahweh will repay to you
The wind of the north brings forth rain and indignant faces a tongue of secrecy
Better to dwell on the corner of a roof than with a wife of quarrels and a house of companionship
Cool water over a weary soul so is good news from a distant land
A spring muddied by trampling and a fountain spoiled is a righteous one swaying to the face of a wicked one
To eat much honey is not good also the searching out of their honor honor
A breached city without a wall is a man who has no restraint for his spirit

26.t: Like the snow in the summer and like the rain in the harvest so honor is not suitable for a stupid one
Like the bird for fluttering like the swallow for flying so a curse without cause does not come
A whip for the horse a bridle for the donkey and a rod for the back of stupid ones
Do not answer a stupid one according to his folly lest you yourself also become like him
Answer a stupid one according to his folly lest he become wise in his eyes
One cutting off feet one drinking violence is one sending words by the hand of a stupid one
Legs dangle from a lame one and a proverb in the mouth of stupid ones
Like tying a stone in a sling so is one who gives honor to a stupid one
A thorn goes up into the hand of a drunkard and a proverb in the mouth of stupid ones
An archer piercing everyone so is one hiring a stupid one and hiring passersby
Like a dog returning to its vomit is a stupid one who repeats his folly
You see a man wise in his eyes There is more hope for a stupid one than for him
A lazy one says A young lion is on the road A lion is between the open areas
The door turns on its hinge and a lazy one on his bed
A lazy one hides his hand in the dish he is too weary to return it to his mouth
A lazy one is wiser in his eyes than seven returning discernment
One grabbing the ears of a dog passing by is one infuriating himself over a dispute not for him
Like an insane one shooting firebrands arrows and death
so is a man who deceives his neighbor and says Was I not joking
With the end of wood pieces a fire goes out and when there is no murmurer a quarrel becomes silent
Charcoal to burning coals and wood to fire so a man of quarrels is to kindling of a dispute
The words of a murmurer are like things swallowed greedily and they themselves go down into the rooms of the belly
Silver of dross overlaid on a clay vessel are burning lips and a heart of evil
With his lips one who hates disguises himself but within him he sets deceit
When he makes his voice gracious do not trust in him for seven abominations are in his heart
Hatred is covered by guile his evil will be uncovered in the assembly
One who digs a pit will fall into it and one who rolls a stone it will come back to him
A tongue of falsehood hates its oppressed ones and a smooth mouth makes calamity

27.t: Do not boast about the next day for you do not know what a day will bring forth
Let a stranger praise you and not your mouth a foreigner and not your lips
The heaviness of a stone and the weightiness of the sand yet the vexation of a fool is heavier than the two of them
Cruelty of heat and a flood of nose but who can stand to the face of jealousy
Better is open rebuke than hidden love
Faithful are the wounds of one loving but deceptive are the kisses of one hating
A satiated appetite tramples fresh honey but for the appetite of a hungry one everything bitter is sweet
Like a bird wandering from her nest so is a man who wanders from his place
Oil and incense gladden the heart and the sweetness of his friend is from the counsel of the soul
Do not forsake your friend and the friend of your father and do not enter the house of your brother in the day of your calamity Better is a nearby inhabitant than a distant brother
Be wise my son and gladden my heart and I shall return a word to one reproaching me
A prudent one sees evil he hides himself naive ones pass on they are fined
Take his garment when he has pledged for a stranger and on behalf of a foreign woman hold it in pledge
One who blesses his neighbor with a great voice in the rising morning it will be considered a curse to him
A continual dripping on a day of steady rain and a woman of quarrels are alike
The one hiding her hides the wind and oil meets his right hand
Iron sharpens against iron and a man sharpens the face of his neighbor
One guarding a fig tree will eat its fruit and one protecting his master will be honored
As the water the face to the face so the heart of the man to the man
Sheol and Abaddon are not satisfied and the eyes of the man are not satisfied
The smelting pot is for the silver and the furnace is for the gold so is a man for the mouth of one who praises him
Even if you pound a fool in a mortar with a pestle in the midst of ground grains his folly will not turn away from on him
Know well the faces of your flock set your heart to the herds
For treasure is not to eternity nor even a crown for generation and generation
The grass disappears and fresh grass is seen and the herbs of the mountains are gathered
lambs will be for your clothing and male goats the price of a field
And there will be enough milk of female goats for your food for the food of your house and life for your young women

28.t: The wicked flee and there is no pursuer but the righteous are as confident as a young lion
By the transgression of a land many are its rulers but by a man who understands who knows so it will endure
A man who is poor and who oppresses the lowly is a rain that washes away and there is no bread
Those forsaking the law praise the wicked but those keeping the law strive against them
Men of evil do not understand justice but seekers of Yahweh understand everything
Better is one who is poor who walks in his integrity than one crooked of ways yet he is rich
One who guards the law is a son who understands but one who associates with gluttonous eaters humiliates his father
One increasing his wealth by interest and usury gathers it for one showing favor to the lowly
One turning away his ear from hearing the law even his prayer is an abomination
One leading the upright astray in the way of evil into his pit he himself will fall but the blameless will inherit good
A rich man is wise in his eyes but a discerning lowly one will search him out
When the righteous exult there is great splendor but when the wicked arise a man is searched for
One covering his transgressions will not prosper but one confessing and forsaking will be shown mercy
Happy is a man fearing continually but one hardening his heart will fall into evil
A lion growling and a bear charging is a wicked ruler over a lowly people
A leader lacking of understanding is also abundant of oppressions one hating unjust gain will lengthen days
A man oppressed by the blood of a life will flee as far as a pit let them not support him
One walking blameless will be saved but one crooked of ways will fall into one
One working his ground will be satisfied with bread but one pursuing empty things will be satisfied with poverty
A man of faithfulness has an abundance of blessings but one hurrying to become rich will not remain blameless
Recognizing faces is not good yet for a bit of bread a man will transgress
One hurrying to the wealth is a man of an evil eye but he does not know that lack will come to him
One rebuking a man afterward will find favor more than one making the tongue smooth
One robbing his father and his mother and says There is no transgression he is the companion of a man of destruction
One wide of appetite stirs up strife but one who trusts in Yahweh will be fattened
One trusting in his heart he is a stupid one but one walking in wisdom he himself will flee
One giving to the one who is poor there is no lack but one hiding his eyes an abundance of curses
When wicked ones arise a man will hide himself but when they perish righteous ones will increase

29.t: A man of rebukes who stiffens the neck will suddenly be broken and without healing
When the righteous increase the people rejoice but when a wicked one rules a people groans
A man who loves wisdom gladdens his father but one who associates with prostitutes destroys wealth
A king by justice causes the land to stand but a man of contributions tears it down
A man who makes smooth for his neighbor spreads out a net for his steps
In the transgression of an evil man a snare but a righteous one shouts for joy and is glad
A righteous one knows the legal claim of the lowly a wicked one does not understand knowledge
Men of mockery inflame a city but the wise turn away nose
A wise man goes to judgment with a foolish man but he rages and he laughs and there is no rest
Men of bloodshed hate a blameless one but upright ones seek his life
A stupid one brings out all his spirit but a wise one soothes it backward
A ruler who listens attentively to a word of falsehood all his servants are wicked ones
A poor one and a man of oppression meet together the one enlightening the eyes of the two of them is Yahweh
A king who judges the lowly with truth his throne will be established to perpetuity
A rod and rebuke give wisdom but a boy let loose causes his mother shame
When the wicked increase transgression increases but the righteous will see their downfall
Discipline your son and he will cause you to rest and he will give delights to your soul
When there is no vision the people are let loose but one keeping the law happy is he
A servant will not be instructed by words for he understands but there is no answer
You see a man hurrying in his words There is more hope for a stupid one than him
Pampering his servant from youth then his end will be insolence
A man of nose stirs up strife and an owner of heat much transgression
The pride of a man will make him low but one lowly of spirit will grasp honor
One who shares with a thief hates his life he hears the oath but does not tell
The anxiety of a man sets a snare but the one trusting in Yahweh will be set on high
Many are those who seek the face of a ruler but from Yahweh is justice of a man
An abomination to the righteous is a man of injustice but an abomination to the wicked is one upright of way

30.t: The words of Agur son of Jakeh the burden The declaration of the strong man to Ithiel to Ithiel and Ucal
Surely I am more stupid than a man and the understanding of man is not mine
And I have not learned wisdom nor the knowledge of holy ones do I know

Who has ascended to heaven and descended Who has gathered the wind in the hollow of his hands Who has wrapped waters in the cloak Who has raised up all the ends of the earth What is his name And what is the name of his son Surely you know
Every saying of God is refined he is a shield for those who take refuge in him
Do not add upon his words lest he rebuke you and you be shown a liar
Two things I ask from with you do not withhold from me before I die
Emptiness and the word of a lie put far away from me Do not give to me poverty or riches cause me to receive the bread of my portion
Lest I be satiated and I deny and say Who is Yahweh And lest I become dispossessed and steal and I seize the name of my God
Do not slander a slave to his master lest he curse you and you be found guilty
There is a generation it curses its father and does not bless its mother
There is a generation clean in its eyes but it is not washed from its excrement
There is a generation how its eyes are raised up and its eyelids are lifted up
There is a generation its teeth are swords and its fangs are knives for devouring the afflicted from the earth and the needy from man
Two daughters are to the leech Give Give There are three they are not satisfied four they do not say Enough
Sheol and the closure of the womb a land not satisfied with water and a fire it does not say Enough
An eye mocks a father and shows contempt for the obedience to a mother the ravens of the valley will peck it out and the sons of the vulture will eat it
Three things they are too wonderful for me and four I do not understand them
the way of the eagle in the sky the way of a snake on a rock the way of a ship in the heart of the sea and the way of a young man with a young woman
Thus is the way of a woman who commits adultery She eats and wipes her mouth and says I have not done iniquity
Under three things the earth quakes and under four it is not able to hold up
under a slave when he becomes king and a worthless one when he is satisfied with bread
under a hated woman when she is married and a female servant when she dispossesses her mistress
Four things they are small things of the earth but they are wise things being made wise
The ants are a people not strong but they prepare their food in the summer
Rock badgers are a people not mighty but they set their house in the cliff
There is no king for the locust but each of it goes out divided into groups
You can catch a lizard with hands yet it is in the palaces of the king
Three things they are doing well of step and four are doing well of walking
a lion mighty among the animals and it will not turn away from the face of anything
a rooster of loins or a male goat and a king against whom one does not rise up
If you have been foolish by lifting up yourself or if you have schemed a hand be to mouth
For the squeezing of milk brings out butter and the squeezing of the nose brings out blood and the squeezing of nostrils brings out strife

31.t: The words of Lemuel the king a burden that his mother had instructed him
What my son And what son of my womb And what son of my vows
Do not give to women your strength or your ways to cause kings to be wiped out
It is not for kings Lemuel it is not for kings to drink wine or for dignitaries or intoxicating drink
Lest he drink and forget what has been decreed and pervert the legal claim of all the sons of the afflicted one
Give intoxicating drink to the perishing one and wine to those bitter of soul
He will drink and forget his poverty and his trouble he will not remember again
Open your mouth for a mute one for the legal claim of all the sons of the one passing away
Open your mouth judge with righteousness and plead the legal case of the afflicted one and poor one
A woman of worth who can find And her value is far more than coral pearls
The heart of her husband trusts in her and spoil he will not lack
She does to him good and not evil all the days of her life
She searches for wool and linens and works with the delight of her palms
She is like the ships of a merchant she brings her bread from far away
And she rises while still night and gives food to her house and a portion to her young women
She considers a field and gets it from the fruit of her palms she plants a vineyard
She girds her loins with strength and she strengthens her arms
She perceives that her profit is good her lamp does not go out in the night
She stretches out her hands at the distaff and her palms grasp the spindle
She spreads out her palm to the afflicted one and she stretches out her hands to the poor one
She does not fear for her house because of snow for all her house is clothed with crimson
She makes for herself coverings fine linen and purple for her clothing
Her husband is known at the gates when he sits with the elders of the land
She makes a linen garment and sells and a belt she gives to the Canaanite
Strength and splendor are her clothing and she laughs at a future day
Her mouth opens with wisdom and the law of covenant faithfulness is on her tongue
She scans the goings on of her house and the bread of laziness she does not eat
Her sons rise up and call her blessed her husband also praises her
Many daughters have acted with worth but you yourself have ascended over all of them
The charm is falsehood and the beauty is vapor a woman fearful of Yahweh she herself will be praised
Give to her from the fruit of her hands and let her works praise her at the gates

1.t: The words of Qoheleth the son of David king in Jerusalem
Vapor of vapors says Qoheleth Vapor of vapors the whole is vapor
What profit belongs to humanity in exchange for all his toil that he toils under the sun
A generation is going and a generation is coming but the earth is standing in perpetuity
And the sun rises and the sun sets and to its place panting it is rising there
Going to the south and turning to the north turning turning the wind is going and on its courses the wind is returning
All the rivers are going to the sea but the sea there is no fullness of it To a place that the rivers are going there they are going again
All the things are wearisome a person is not able to speak An eye is not satisfied of seeing and an ear is not filled from hearing
Whatever that which was it is that which will be and whatever that which has been done it is that which will be done And there is not anything new under the sun
Is there a thing about which one says See this it is new It already existed in ages that were from before our faces
There is not a memory of the former times and also of the latter times that will be memory will not be of them along with those that will be at the latter time
I Qoheleth was king over Israel in Jerusalem
So I gave my heart to seek and to explore with wisdom concerning all that is done under the heavens It is an unpleasant business God has given to the sons of humanity to be busy with it
I saw all the deeds that are done under the sun and look everything is vapor and pursuit of wind
A bent thing one is not able to straighten it and lack is not able to be counted
I spoke I with my heart saying I look I have grown and increased wisdom over all who were before my face over Jerusalem and my heart has seen much wisdom and knowledge
So I gave my heart to know wisdom and to know madness and folly I know that also this it is pursuit of wind
for in much wisdom is much anger and when one increases knowledge he increases pain

2.t: I spoke I with my heart Come let me test you with joy and see good But look it also was vapor
To laughter I said Madness And to joy What is this doing

I explored in my heart to drag my flesh with wine and my heart was guiding me with wisdom and to seize folly until I could see where is the good for the sons of humanity that they might do under the heavens during the number of the days of their lives
I enlarged my deeds I built for myself houses I planted for myself vineyards
I made for myself orchards and royal parks and I planted in them a tree of each fruit
I made for myself pools of waters to cause to drink from them a forest of growing trees
I acquired male servants and female servants and sons of the house belonged to me Also much property of cattle and sheep belonged to me more than all who were to my face in Jerusalem
I also amassed for myself silver and gold and the treasure of kings and provinces I appointed for myself male singers and female singers and the pleasures of the sons of humanity breast and breasts
So I became great and I increased more than all who were to my face in Jerusalem Also my wisdom stood by me
And all that my eyes asked I did not refuse from them I did not restrain my heart from any joy because my heart was joyful from all my toil and this was my portion from all my toil
And I turned I to all my works that my hands had done and to the toil that I toiled to do and look everything was vapor and pursuit of wind and there was no profit under the sun
So I turned I to see wisdom and madness and folly because what can the person do who will come after the king than that which he has already done
And I saw I that there is a profit for wisdom more than folly as there is a profit of the light more than the darkness
The wise his eyes are in his head but the fool in the darkness is walking But I know even I that one happening will happen to both of them
And I spoke I with my heart As the happening of the fool even to me it will happen to me And why was I I wise then abundantly And I said to my heart that also this is vapor
For there is no memory of the wise person with the fool in perpetuity because already in the coming days both will be forgotten Alas The wise die with the fool
And I hated life because bad to me was the work that was done under the sun because everything was vapor and pursuit of wind
And I hated I all my toil that I had toiled under the sun that I will leave it to the person who will be after me
And who knows Will he be wise or a fool And he will have authority over all my toil that I toiled and for which I was wise under the sun Also this is vapor
Then I turned I to cause my heart to despair concerning all the toil which I toiled under the sun
For there is a person whose toil is with wisdom and with knowledge and with skill but to a person who has not toiled for it he will give it as his portion This also is vapor and a great misfortune
For what endures for the person in exchange for all his toil and in the striving of his heart in which he is a toiler under the sun
For all his days are pains and anger is his business even in the night his heart does not rest Also this it is vapor
There is nothing better for humanity than that he should eat and drink and cause his spirit to see good in his toil Also this I saw I that it is from the hand of the God
for who will eat and who will enjoy apart from him

For to a person who is good to his face he gives wisdom and knowledge and joy But to the sinner he gives the business of gathering and of collecting to give to the one who is good to the face of the God Even this is vapor and pursuit of wind

3.t: For everything there is a season and a time for every matter under the heavens
a time to give birth and a time to die a time to plant and a time to tear out what was planted
a time to kill and a time to heal a time to break down and a time to build
a time to weep and a time to laugh a time to mourn and a time to dance
a time to throw stones and a time to gather stones a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing
a time to seek and a time to lose a time to keep and a time to throw away
a time to tear and a time to mend a time to be silent and a time to speak
a time to love and a time to hate a time of war and a time of peace
What is the profit of the one who does in exchange for that which he is toiling
I saw the business that God gives to the sons of humanity to be busy with it
He makes everything beautiful in its time Also he gives perperuity in their heart yet so that humanity cannot find the work that the God does from beginning to end
I know that there is no good for them except to rejoice and to do good during his life
and every person who eats and drinks and sees good in all of his toil it is a gift of God
I know that everything that God does it will be enduring To it there is nothing to add and from it there is nothing to remove And God acts so that they fear from before his face
Whatever that is already it was and that which is to be already it is And the God seeks that which is pursued
But again I saw under the sun The place of justice there was wickedness and the place of equity there was wickedness
I spoke I with my heart The equitable and the wicked the God will judge because a time exists for every matter and on account of every deed there
I spoke I with my heart For the sake of the sons of humanity the God is to test them to see that they are animal s they themselves

For the happening of the sons of humanity and the happening of the animal and one happening is for them As the death of this one so the death of this one and one spirit exists for both But an advantage of humanity over the animal there is none for everything is vapor
Both are going to one place Both are from the dust and both return to the dust
Who knows The spirit of the sons of humanity it is the one going up upwards and the spirit of the animal it is the one going down downwards to the earth
So I saw that there is nothing better than that humanity should rejoice in his works for it is his portion For who will bring him to look at what that will be after him

4.t: And I turned I and I saw all the oppressions that were being done under the sun And look the tears of the oppressed and there was no comforter for them And from the hand of the ones oppressing them was strength and there was no comforter for them
So I praised I the dead people who have already died more than the living who they are still alive
But better than the two of them is the one who has not yet lived who has not seen the evil deed that is being done under the sun
And I saw I every toil and every success of the deed that it is the envy of a person from his friend This also is vapor and pursuit of wind
The fool is folding his hands and is eating his flesh
Better is a fullness of a palm with quiet than a fullness of two handfuls with toil and pursuit of wind
And I turned I and I saw a vapor under the sun

There is one person and there is not a second person even a son or brother there is not for him and there is no end to all his toil Also his eye is not satisfied with wealth So why am I toiling and causing my soul to lack from good things Even this is vapor and it is an unpleasant business
Better are the two people than the one person that there is for them a good wage in exchange for their toil
For if they fall the one person will lift up his companion but woe is his the one person that will fall but there is no second person to lift him up
Also if two people lie down then there is warmth for them But for the one person how will there be warmth
And if he will overpower him the one person the two people will stand against him and the three fold rope will not be torn in two quickly
Better is a child poor but wise than a king old but foolish who does not know how to be warned any longer
For from the house of those who are bound he came forth to become king yet even in his kingdom he was born poor
I saw all the living the ones walking around under the sun with the second child who will stand under him
There was no end to all the people to all who were to their faces Even the latter people will not rejoice in him because even this is vapor and pursuit of wind

5.t: Keep your feet when you go to the house of God And drawing near to listen is better than fools giving a sacrifice for they are not knowing that they do evil
Do not be hurried concerning your mouth and do not let your heart hurry to bring forth a word to the face of God For the God is in heaven but you are on the earth therefore let your words be few
For the dream comes with much business and the voice of a fool with many words
When you vow a vow to God do not delay to fulfill it for there is no delight in the fools That which you vow fulfill
It is better that you not vow than that you vow but do not fulfill

Do not give your mouth to cause your flesh to sin and do not say to the face of the messenger that it was an unintentional sin Why should God be angry concerning your voice and destroy the deed of your hands
For in many dreams and vaporous things and many words just fear God

If the extortion of the poor and the robbery of justice and equity you see in the province do not be amazed concerning the matter for a high one over a high one is watching and high ones are over them
And a profit of a land it is taken by all But a king is served by a field
A lover of silver will not be satisfied with silver and whoever loves increase not income Also this is vapor
When the good thing increases the ones eating it increase And what advantage belongs to its master except the sight of his eyes
Sweet is the sleep of the worker however little or however much he eats but the satisfaction of a rich person it is not allowing him to sleep
There is a sickening misfortune I have seen under the sun Wealth kept by its master to his harm
And that wealth perished in an unfortunate business And he had fathered a son but there was not in his hand anything
As he went out from the womb of his mother naked he will go again just as he came And he will not take anything in exchange for his toil that he will take in his hand
And also this is a sickening misfortune Just as he came thus he will go And what profit belongs to him who toils for the wind
Also all his days in darkness he eats and in great vexation and his sickness and anger

Look what I I have seen is good That it is beautiful to eat and to drink and to see good in all his toil that he will toil under the sun during the number of the days of his life that the God has given to him for it is his portion
Also each person who the God gives to him wealth and possessions and has empowered him to eat from it and to accept his portion and to rejoice in his toiling this it is a gift of God
For not much does he remember the days of his life because the God occupies him with the joys of his heart

6.t: There is a misfortune that I have seen under the sun and it is great on humanity

A person who the God gives to him wealth and possessions and honor so he is not lacking for his soul from anything that he desires but the God does not enable him to eat from it instead a nonnative person will eat it this is vapor and it is a sickening misfortune

If a man should father a hundred children and many years should he live and many that the days of his years may be but if his soul is not satisfied from the good thing and also a burial place is not for him I say Better than him is the stillborn child
For in vapor it came and in the darkness it will go and in the darkness its name will be covered
Even the sun it did not see nor did it know More rest belongs to this one than this one
And if he lived a thousand years twice but a good thing he did not see are not both going to one place
All the toil of humanity is for his mouth and yet the soul is not filled
For what advantage belongs to the wise more than the fool What advantage belongs to the poor person who knows how to walk before the living
Better is a sight of the eyes than the walking of the soul Also this is vapor and pursuit of wind
Whatever that is already its name has been called and it is known what a person is and he is not able to contend with he who is more powerful than him
When there are many words that are increasingly vaporous what advantage belongs to humanity

For who is knowing what is good for humanity in life during the number of the days of his vaporous life And he makes them like the shadow For who will declare to humanity what will be after him under the sun

7.t: Better is a good name than good oil and the day of death than the day of his being born
Better to go to a house of mourning than to go to a house of a banquet because it is the end of all humanity and the living will give it to his heart
Better grief than laughter for with a bad face a heart may be well
The heart of wise people is in a house of mourning but the heart of fools is in a house of joy
Better to listen to a rebuke of a wise person than a person listening to a song of fools
for like the sound of the thorns under the cooking pot so is the laughter of the fool And this also is vapor
Surely oppression crazes a wise person and a bribe destroys a heart
Better is the end of a thing than its beginning Better is length of spirit than height of spirit
Do not hasten in your spirit to become angry for anger rests in the lap of fools
Do not say What was that the former days were better than these For you do not ask about this out of wisdom
Wisdom is good with an inheritance and an advantage to those who see the sun
For as in the shadow of wisdom so in the shadow of silver And this is an advantage of knowledge Wisdom preserves her owners
See the work of the God For who is able to straighten that which he has bent
In a day of good be in good but in a day of misfortune see indeed the God has done this as well as this so that humanity cannot find anything after him
I have seen both in the days of my vapor There is a righteous person perishing in his righteousness and there is a wicked person lengthening in his evil
Do not be overly righteous and do not be exceedingly wise why should you be shocked
Do not be very wicked and do not be a fool why should you die when it is not your time
It is good that you should take hold of this and also from this do not let your hand rest For the one who fears God will go forth with both of them
Wisdom is strong for the wise more than ten rulers who are in the city
For a person there is not a righteous person on the earth who does good and does not sin
Also to all of the words that they say do not give your heart so that you will not hear your servant belittling you
For even many times your heart knows that even you have belittled others
All of this I tested with wisdom I said Let me be wise but it was far from me
Far away is that which was And deep deep who can find it
I turned I and my heart to know and to explore and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things and to know the wickedness that is folly and the foolishness that is madness
And I am finding more bitter than death the woman who she is snares and nets her heart chains her hands One who is good to the face of the God will flee from her but a sinner will be captured by her
See this I have found says Qoheleth One to one to find the scheme of things
while still my soul sought but I have not found One man from a thousand men I found but a woman among all of these people I did not find
Only see this I have found That the God made humanity upright but they they have sought out many schemes

8.t: Who is like the wise person and who knows the interpretation of a matter The wisdom of a person enlightens his face and the strength of his face is changed
As for me listen to the mouth of a king that is on account of the oath of God
Do not be terrified from his face Go Do not stand in a bad matter for everything that he pleases he will do
for the word of a king is authoritative And who will say to him What are you doing
One who listens to a command will not know a bad matter and the heart of a wise person will know the time and procedure
because for every matter there is a time and procedure because the misfortune of humanity is severe upon him
for he is not knowing whatever that will be for when it will be who will declare it to him
There is no person authorized over the wind to restrain the wind and there is no authority over the day of death and there is no discharge in the war and wickedness will not deliver its masters
All this I saw while giving my heart to every deed that was done under the sun A time that the person has authority over another person to his harm
And then I saw wicked people buried and they entered and from a place of holiness they went And they were praised in the city where thus they had done This also is vapor
that a decree against the evil deed is not made quickly therefore the heart of the sons of humanity fills in them to do evil
that a sinner is doing evil a hundred times and lengthening days for himself yet also I know that it will be good for those who fear God who fear from before his face
But it will not be good for the wicked nor will he lengthen his days like the shadow because he is not fearing before the face of God

There is vapor that is done on the earth that there are righteous people who it befalls to them like the deeds of the wicked people and there are wicked people who it befalls to them like the deeds of the righteous people I say that also this is vapor

And I praised I joy that there is nothing good for humanity under the sun except to eat and to drink and to rejoice And it will accompany him in his toil during the days of his life that the God has given to him under the sun
When I gave my heart to know wisdom and to see the business that is done on the earth for even in the day and in the night sleep in his eyes he is not seeing

then I saw every deed of the God that humanity is not able to find the deed that is done under the sun on account of which humanity toils to seek yet he will not find and even if the wise one says to know he is not able to find

9.t: Indeed all of this I gave to my heart to examine all of this That the righteous and the wise and their work are in the hand of God Either love or hate humanity is not knowing both are to their faces

Everything is as for everyone one happening For the righteous person and for the wicked person for the good person and for the pure person and for the unclean person and for the person who sacrifices and for the person who does not sacrifice As the good person so the sinner the person who swears an oath is as the person who fears an oath

This is a misfortune about everything that is done under the sun That one happening belongs to everyone And also the heart of the sons of humanity is full of evil and madness is in their heart during their lives and after him to the dead
For whoever that is joined to all the living there is hope for for a living dog it is better than the dead lion
for the living know that they will die but the dead they are not knowing anything and there is no longer for them a reward even their memory is forgotten
Even their love even their hate even their jealousy already it has perished And there is not for them a portion any longer in perpetuity among all that is done under the sun
Go Eat your bread with joy and drink your wine with a good heart because the God has already accepted your deeds
At every time let your clothes be white and do not let oil be lacking on your head

See life with the wife whom you love all the days of your vaporous life which he has given to you under the sun all the days of your vapor For it is your portion in life and in your toil that you are a toiler under the sun
Everything that your hand finds to do do it with your strength because there is no deed or scheme of things or knowledge or wisdom in Sheol where you are going to there

I again saw under the sun That not to the swift is the race and not to the mighty is the war and even not to wise people is bread and even not to discerning people is wealth and even not to understanding people is favor for a time and the occurrence will happen to all of them

For humanity does not even know his time Like the fish that are caught in a troublesome net and like the birds that are caught in the snare like them the sons of humanity are snared at a time of misfortune when it falls upon them suddenly
Also this I saw Wisdom under the sun and great it was to me
There was a small city and a few men were in it And against it came a great king and he surrounded it and he built against it great siegeworks
And he found in it a poor wise man and he himself delivered the city with his wisdom But a person did not remember that poor man
And I said I Better is wisdom than might but the wisdom of the poor person is despised and his words they are not heard
The words of wise people in quietness are heeded more than the cry of a ruler among the fools
Better is wisdom than weapons of battle but one sinner will destroy much good

10.t: Flies of death cause a perfumer s oil to putrify and bubble weightier than wisdom or honor is a little foolishness
The heart of a wise person to his right but a heart of a fool to his left
And even whenever the fool is walking on the road his heart is lacking and it says to everyone that he is a fool
If the spirit of the ruler rises against you do not leave your place for calmness will cause great sins to leave
There is a misfortune I saw under the sun like an unintentional sin that goes out from before the face of the authority
Folly is placed into many high places and rich people sit in the lowly place
I saw slaves on horses and princes walking like slaves on the ground
One who digs a pit will fall into it and one who breaks through a wall a snake will bite him
One who pulls up stones will be hurt by them one who splits wood will be endangered by them
If the iron is dull but he himself does not lighten the faces he must exert strength But a profit to succeeding is wisdom
If the snake bites without a charm then there is no profit for the master of the tongue
The words of the mouth of a wise person are favor but the lips of a fool will swallow him
The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness and the end of his mouth is evil insanity
but the fool multiplies words Humanity does not know what will be and that which will be after him who will declare it to him
The toil of foolish people wearies him so that he does not know how to go to a city
Woe to you land that your king is a youth and your princes eat in the morning
Blessed are you land that your king is a son of nobles and that your princes will eat at the time with might and not with drunkenness
With laziness the beams of the roof sink and in idleness of hands the house will leak
For laughter people are making bread and wine gladdens life but silver answers everything
Even in your thought do not belittle a king and in the room of your bed do not belittle a rich person for a bird of the heavens will carry the voice and a master of wings will declare the word

11.t: Throw your bread on the face of the waters for in many days you will find it
Give a portion to seven and even to eight for you do not know what will be a misfortune on the earth
If the clouds are filled with rain they will pour out on the earth And whether a tree will fall in the south or in the north the place where the tree will fall there it will be
One who attends to the wind will not sow and one who watches the clouds will not harvest
Just as you are not knowing what is the way of the wind as the bones come into the womb of the full woman so thus you do not know the work of the God who does everything
In the morning sow your seed and in the evening do not let your hand rest for you are not knowing whether this one will prosper this one or this one or whether two of them as one will be good
And light is sweet and it is good for the eyes to see the sun
For if the man will live many years in all of them let him rejoice But let him remember the days of darkness that they will be many Everything that is coming is vapor

Rejoice young man in your youth and let your heart make you glad in the days of your young adulthood And walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes but know that on account of all these things the God will bring you into judgment
And remove anger from your heart and take misfortune away from your flesh for youth and dark hair are vapor

12.t: So remember your Creator in the days of your young adulthood when the days of misfortune have not come and the years arrive of which you will say There is not for me pleasure in them
when the sun and the light and the moon and the stars have not darkened and the clouds return after the rain
in the day when the guards of the house will tremble and the men of valor will be bent over and the women grinders cease because they are few and those who look at the window will grow dark
and the doors will be shut in the street when the sound of the grinding is low and a person rises at the sound of the bird and all the daughters of song are stooped

also they are afraid of a high thing and terrors are in the way and the almond tree blossoms and the locusts moves along and the caper fruit fails for humanity is going to his eternal home and the mourners go around in the street
before the cord of silver is removed and the bowl of gold is broken and the pitcher is shattered at the fountain and the wheel is crushed at the cistern
and the dust returns to the earth as that it was and the spirit returns to God who gave it
Vapor of vapors says the Qoheleth Everything is vapor
More than that Qoheleth was wise again he taught the people knowledge and he weighed and he searched He ordered many proverbs
Qoheleth sought to find words of pleasure and words of truth were written rightly
The words of wise people are like goads and like nails implanted are masters of collections They are given by one Shepherd
But more than them my son be warned of the making of many scrolls there is no end and much study is weariness of flesh
The end of the matter everything has been heard Fear God and keep his commandments for this is the whole of humanity
For every deed the God will bring into judgment concerning everything hidden whether good or whether evil

1.t: The Song of Songs which is of Solomon
Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth for better is your love than wine
As for the scent of your oils they are good oil poured out is your name Therefore marriageable women love you
Draw me after you let us run The king has brought me to his bedroom Let us be glad and rejoice in you Let us profess your love more than wine rightly do they love you
I am black but lovely daughters of Jerusalem like the tents of Kedar like the curtains of Solomon
Do not look at me that I am black that the sun scorched me The sons of my mother were angry with me they appointed me as keeper of the vineyards my vineyard that is mine I have not kept
Declare to me you whom my soul loves where do you graze Where do you make your flocks lie down at noontime For why should I be like a woman who covers herself beside the flocks of your companions
If you do not know most beautiful among women go out in the footprints of the flock and pasture your young goats beside the tents of the shepherds
To a mare among the chariots of Pharaoh I liken you my darling
Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings your neck is beautiful with necklaces
Earrings of gold we will make for you with studs of silver
While the king was on his couch my nard gave off its scent
A bundle of myrrh is my beloved to me between my breasts it stays
A cluster of henna blossoms is my beloved to me in the vineyards of Engedi
Behold you beautiful my darling Behold you beautiful Your eyes are doves
Behold you You are handsome my beloved truly pleasant Indeed our couch is leafy
The beams of our house are cedars our rafters are pine

2.t: I am a wildflower of Sharon a lily of the valleys
Like a lily among thorns so is my darling among the daughters
Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest so is my beloved among the sons In his shadow I greatly delighted and I sat and his fruit is sweet to my palate
He brought me to the house of wine and his banner over me is love
Sustain me with raisin cakes refresh me with apples for sick with love am I
His left hand is under my head and his right hand embraces me
I adjure you daughters of Jerusalem by the female gazelles or the does of the field do not awaken nor stir love until it desires
The voice of my beloved Behold this one is coming leaping over the mountains jumping over the hills
My beloved is being like a gazelle or a young stag Behold this one is standing behind our wall gazing through the windows looking through the lattices
My beloved answered and said to me Get up my darling my beauty and come
for behold the winter has gone the rain has passed it went away
The blossoms have appeared in the land the time of the song has arrived and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land
The fig tree ripens its green figs and the vines are in blossom they give off a smell Get up come my darling my beauty and come
My dove in the clefts of the rock in the hiding places of the cliff show me your appearance make me hear your voice for your voice is sweet and your appearance is lovely
Catch the foxes for us the little foxes that destroy the vineyards and our vineyards are in blossom
My beloved belongs to me and I belong to him the man grazing among the lilies
Until the day breathes and the shadows flee turn resemble my beloved a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of Bether

3.t: On my bed in the night I sought him whom my soul loves I sought him but I did not find him
I will get up now and go about in the city in the streets and in the squares I will seek him whom my soul loves I sought him but I did not find him
The guards going about in the city found me Have you seen him whom my soul loves
Hardly had I passed by them when I found him whom my soul loves I held him and I would not let him go until I had brought him to the house of my mother and to the room of the woman who conceived me
I adjure you daughters of Jerusalem by the female gazelles or the does of the field do not awaken nor stir love until it desires
Who is that coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke fragrant smoke of myrrh and frankincense from all the powders of the merchant
Behold his litter which belongs to Solomon 60 warriors surround it from the warriors of Israel
All of them are grasping a sword studied in war Each one has his sword at his thigh against the terrors in the nights
He made for himself a palanquin King Solomon from the trees of Lebanon
He made its posts out of silver its back gold its seat purple cloth Its interior was fitted with love from the daughters of Jerusalem
Go out and look daughters of Zion at King Solomon at the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding on the day of the joy of his heart

4.t: Behold you You are beautiful my darling Behold you You are beautiful Your eyes are doves from behind your veil Your hair is like a flock of goats that hop down from the slopes of Gilead
Your teeth are like a flock of shorn sheep that have come up from the washing all of which bear twins and there is not among them one which is bereaved
Like a thread of scarlet are your lips and your mouth is lovely Like a slice of pomegranate are your cheeks from behind your veil
Like the tower of David is your neck built of layers a thousand shields hanging on it all the shields of the warriors
Your two breasts are like two fawns twins of a female gazelle the ones pasturing among the lilies
Until the day breathes and the shadows flee I myself will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense
All of you is beautiful my darling and there is no blemish in you
Come with me from Lebanon my bride come with me from Lebanon Descend from the top of Amana from the top of Senir and Hermon from the hiding places of lions from the mountains of leopards
You have enchanted my heart my sister my bride you have enchanted my heart with one look from your eyes with one jewel from your necklace
How your love is beautiful my sister my bride How your love is better than wine and the smell of your oils is better than all spices
Your lips drip with nectar my bride honey and milk are under your tongue and the smell of your garments is like the smell of Lebanon
A locked garden is my sister my bride a locked spring a sealed fountain
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranate trees with delicious fruits henna with nard
nard and saffron calamus and cinnamon with all trees of frankincense myrrh and aloes with all the best spices
a fountain of gardens a well of living waters and flowing streams from Lebanon
Awake north wind and come south wind blow on my garden and let its spices flow Let my beloved come to his garden and eat its delicious fruit

5.t: I have come to my garden my sister my bride I have plucked my myrrh with my spice I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey I have drunk my wine with my milk Eat friends drink and be drunk beloved ones
I am asleep but my heart is awake A sound my beloved is knocking Open to me my sister my darling my dove my perfect one because my head is full of dew my hair is full of the drops of the night
I have taken off my robe how will I put it on I have washed my feet how could I get them dirty
My beloved stretched out his hand through the hole and my belly roared concerning him
I got myself up to open to my beloved and my hands dripped with myrrh and my fingers dripped with flowing myrrh on the hands of the bolt
I myself opened to my beloved but my beloved had turned and gone My soul went out because he departed I searched for him but I did not find him I called him but he did not answer me
The guards going about in the city found me They beat me and wounded me they lifted my shawl from me the guards of the walls
I adjure you daughters of Jerusalem if you find my beloved what will you declare to him Declare to him that sick with love am I
What is your beloved more than another beloved most beautiful among women What is your beloved more than another beloved that thus you adjure us
My beloved is shimmering and red distinguished among ten thousand
His head is gold refined gold his hairs are wavy black like the raven
His eyes are like doves beside stream beds of water bathing in milk sitting beside the pools
His cheeks are like a bed of spices towers of herbal spices His lips are lilies dripping with flowing myrrh
His arms are rods of gold mounted with topaz his belly is a plate of ivory covered with sapphires
His thighs are pillars of alabaster set on bases of refined gold his appearance is like Lebanon as choice as the cedars
His mouth is most sweet and all of him is most desirable This is my beloved and this is my friend daughters of Jerusalem

6.t: Where did he go your beloved most beautiful woman among women Where did he turn your beloved and let us seek him with you
My beloved went down to his garden to the beds of spices in order to graze in the gardens and in order to glean lilies
I belong to my beloved and my beloved belongs to me he grazes among the lilies
You are beautiful my darling like Tirzah lovely like Jerusalem awe inspiring like bannered armies
Turn your eyes away from me because they excite me Your hair is like a flock of goats that hop down from Gilead
Your teeth are like a flock of ewes that have come up from the washing all of which bear twins and there is not among them one which is bereaved
Like a slice of a pomegranate are your cheeks from behind your veil
Sixty are they queens and eighty concubines and marriageable women without number
One is she my dove my perfect one one is she to her mother pure is she to the woman who bore her The daughters saw her and called her blessed the queens and the concubines they praised her
Who is that the woman who looks down like the dawn beautiful like the moon pure like the sun awe inspiring like bannered armies
To the garden of the nut tree I went down to look at the green shoots of the valley to see had the vine budded Had the pomegranates bloomed
I did not know my soul put me among the chariots of my people a noble
Return return Shulammite return return and let us look at you Why do you look at the Shulammite like the dance of two armies

7.t: How your feet are beautiful in sandals daughter of a noble The curves of your thighs are like ornaments the work of the hands of a craftsman
Your navel is the rounded bowl that never lacks spiced wine Your belly is a heap of wheat encircled with the lilies
Your two breasts are like two fawns twins of a gazelle
Your neck is like a tower of ivory Your eyes are pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bath Rabbim Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon looking to the face of Damascus
Your head on you is like Carmel and the loose hair of your head is like purple a king is held captive in the tresses
How you are beautiful and how you are lovely love with delights
This is your height it is like a palm tree and your breasts like its clusters
I said I will go up the palm tree I will grab hold of its fruit stalks And please let your breasts be like the clusters of the vine and let the smell of your nose be like apples
and let your mouth be like the best wine Going down for my beloved smoothly gliding over the lips of those who sleep
I belong to my beloved and his longing is for me
Come my beloved let us go out to the fields let us spend the night in the villages
Let us go early to the vineyards let us see if the vine has budded if the blossoms have opened if the pomegranates have bloomed There I will give my love to you
The mandrakes give off a scent and over our doors are all choice fruits new ones and also old ones My beloved I have stored these up for you

8.t: Who will give you like a brother to me who nursed at the breasts of my mother If I found you outside I would kiss you Yes they would not despise me
I would lead you I would bring you to the house of my mother she who taught me I would make you drink from the wine of spice from the juice of my pomegranate
His left hand is under my head and his right hand embraces me
I adjure you daughters of Jerusalem do not awaken and do not stir love until it desires
Who is that coming up from the wilderness leaning against her beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you there your mother was in labor with you there she was in labor she gave birth to you
Place me like the seal on your heart like the seal on your arm because strong like death is love unyielding like Sheol is zeal Its flashes are flashes of fire the flame of Yah
Many waters are not able to quench this love and rivers will not drown it If a man would give all the wealth of his house in exchange for love they would utterly despise it
A sister belongs to us a little one and breasts there are not for her What will we do for our sister on the day when it is spoken for her
If she is a wall we will build on her a battlement of silver And if she is a door we will enclose over her boards of cedar
I was a wall and my breasts are like towers then I was in his eyes like a person who finds peace
There was a vineyard for Solomon in Baal Hamon He gave the vineyard to keepers Each person brought in exchange for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver
My vineyard that belongs to me is to my face The thousand belong to you Solomon and the two hundred belong to the people who are keepers of its fruit
You who reside in the gardens companions are listening intently for your voice let me hear it
Flee my beloved and resemble a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices

1.t: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah Jotham Ahaz Hezekiah kings of Judah
Hear heavens and listen earth for Yahweh has spoken I have raised and brought up sons but they they have rebelled against me
An ox knows its owner and a donkey the manger of its master Israel does not know my people do not understand
Woe A sinning nation a people heavy of iniquity seed of evildoers sons acting corruptly They have forsaken Yahweh they have despised the Holy One of Israel they have turned away backward
On what will you still be struck Will you continue rebellion The whole head is for sickness and the whole heart is faint

From the sole of the foot and up to the head there is no soundness in it Wound and bruise and raw sore they have not been pressed out and they have not been bound up and they have not been softened with oil
Your land is a desolation your cities have been burned with fire Your ground strangers are devouring it before you indeed it is a desolation like the overthrow of strangers
And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard like a hut in a cucumber field like a besieged city
If Yahweh of Armies had not left a remnant to us according to a few we would have been like Sodom we would have compared to Gomorrah
Hear the word of Yahweh rulers of Sodom Listen to the instruction of our God people of Gomorrah
For what is the multitude of your sacrifices to me says Yahweh I have enough burnt offerings of rams and fat of fatlings and in the blood of bulls and lambs and male goats I do not delight
When you come to appear before my face who has sought this from your hand trampling my courts
Do not continue to bring an offering of worthlessness Incense it is an abomination to me New moon and Sabbath the calling of an assembly I am not able to endure wickedness and a solemn gathering
Your new moons and your annual festivals my soul hates They have become a burden upon me I am wearied from bearing them
And when you spread out your palms I hide my eyes from you Even when you multiply prayer I am not listening Your hands are full of blood
Wash cleanse remove the evil of your deeds from before my eyes Cease doing evil
Learn to do good seek justice gladden the oppressed judge for the orphan plead for the widow
